docs.title: -- Stoneskin -------------------------------------------------
docs.text: -- Stoneskin ------------------------------------------------- This Tellurian invocation will make the subject's skin as hard as granite, granting him increased protection in combat. (Note: You do not have to wear the stoneskin object. It protects you automatically.) Command: stoneskin <target> (defaults to caster) Base Cost: 60 Tellurian nwyfre Base Recovery: medium Base Effect: protection (moderate) Base Duration: long Guild Level: 3

docs.title: -- Stump ----------------------------------------------------
docs.text: -- Stump ---------------------------------------------------- Current: Tellurian Command: stump Guild Level: 10 Stump asks the earth for a quiet place to rest. The druid waves a hand, the ground rumbles, and a mossy stump grows up from below. The druid settles onto it, breathes deeply, and small woodland friends come out to keep watch. While the druid remains seated on the stump, the Tellurian current restores health in steady pulses based on Druid guild level. The stump is not a combat escape: standing, leaving, fighting, death, or the end of the working sends the animals scampering away. Use stand or stand up when you are ready to leave the stump and wave goodbye to your friends.

docs.title: -- Sunray ----------------------------------------------------
docs.text: -- Sunray ---------------------------------------------------- Current: Marken Command: sunray <target> Guild Level: 18 Sunray focuses clean Marken light into a single enemy. It is especially harsh against undead and other things that recoil from living light. Mastery improves damage and makes the ray a pivotal high-level Marken attack.

docs.title: -- Thorns ----------------------------------------------------
docs.text: -- Thorns ---------------------------------------------------- Current: Tellurian Command: thorns <target> Guild Level: 2 Thorns tears hooked growth from the earth into a single target. It is cheap, quick, and remains useful as a low-cost Tellurian opener. Mastery improves damage and keeps the invocation relevant when the druid needs to conserve stronger currents.

docs.title: -- Twin Sky Blades -------------------------------------------
docs.text: -- Twin Sky Blades ------------------------------------------- Current: Tekali Command: twinskyblades <type> Aliases: twinskyblade, twinsky Guild Level: 10 Twin Sky Blades shapes two Sky Blades at once. It costs the same Tekali nwyfre as invoking Sky Blade twice one at a time, but saves you from waiting through the cooldown between the two invocations. The available blade types follow your normal Sky Blade training and alignment restrictions. If you already have any Sky Blades, release them before invoking the twin form.

docs.title: -- Living Vines ----------------------------------------------
docs.text: -- Living Vines ---------------------------------------------- Command: vines <mode|off> Guild Level: 3 Current: Tellurian Living Vines is a sustained combat invocation. Once invoked, the vines coil around your steps and become part of your combat rhythm. During combat rounds they may lash the target you are attacking. When you are struck, they may also twist defensively around the attacker, fouling footing or punishing the blow. Use: vines Show current mode and unlocked modes. vines lash Basic striking vines. vines venom Toxic sap and poison-tinged lashes. vines barbs Stronger thorned retaliation. vines snare Entangling roots that hinder movement. vines off Dismiss the vines. Lash is available when you first learn the invocation. Venom, barbs, and snare unlock as your training and guild level grow. Mastery makes the vines more efficient and more likely to answer during combat. Mode unlocks: lash When you learn Living Vines. venom Training 2, or Druid guild level 8. barbs Training 3, or Druid guild level 14. snare Training 4, or Druid guild level 20. Living Vines spends Tellurian nwyfre when it lashes. If your Tellurian current runs dry, the vines will sink back into the earth.

docs.title: -- Living Wellspring -----------------------------------------
docs.text: -- Living Wellspring ----------------------------------------- Current: Chosen when cast Command: wellspring <current> Guild Level: 28 Living Wellspring opens a temporary spring of nwyfre inside your body. While it lasts, it restores the chosen current every nwyfre tick. Only one living wellspring can be open at a time. Use it before or during a difficult fight when you know which current you will rely on. Example: wellspring marken

docs.title: -- Whirlwind -------------------------------------------------
docs.text: -- Whirlwind ------------------------------------------------- By using the Tekali current, the druid can bind a wind spirit to create a whirlwind around an opponent, battering and disorienting them. The enemy must use some of its strength to fight the whirlwind, leaving it less able to battle the druid. Command: whirlwind <target> (defaults to attacker) Base Cost: 40 Tekali nwyfre Base Recovery: medium Base Effect: drain (strength, moderate), damage (low) Base Duration: medium Guild Level: 6

docs.title: -- Wind Walk -------------------------------------------------
docs.text: -- Wind Walk ------------------------------------------------- Current: Tekali Command: windwalk <target> Guild Level: 15 Wind Walk firms the air under the target's feet, granting temporary travel and positioning utility. It defaults to the caster. At higher mastery, the druid can carry another person on the wind and extend the duration.

docs.title: Fighter Guild Advancement
docs.text: Fighter Guild Advancement ------------------------- Fighters advance through battle. Every worthy kill earns Fighter XP, and your guild level (1 to 15) rises automatically when you have earned enough. Earning Fighter XP: - Any NPC kill where you struck the killing blow, or dealt at least a tenth of the victim's health, awards Fighter XP to everyone in the group who qualifies. - Tougher prey is worth more. Rewards taper when prey is more than five levels beneath you and reach nothing at fifteen levels beneath you. Bosses carry large bonuses. - Variety pays. Hunting the same spawn over and over decays the reward; ranging widely keeps it at full value. Guild levels: - Levels advance on their own the moment you have earned enough XP. - Your guild level can never exceed your character level, and your combined guild levels can never exceed your character level. XP earned while you are held back is banked, and the levels pop when you next advance your character. - Guild level 15 is the pinnacle. XP earned beyond it is recorded, but buys nothing further. Commands: - 'fstats' shows your guild level and Fighter XP. - 'cost' and 'advance guild' at the Grand Hall report your progress. - Skills still unlock by guild level; see 'fs' for the list. Your battle record survives leaving the guild. Should you return, your standing is restored.

docs.title: Skill: Ainspect    Timer: None         GL:  7    Cost: 20
docs.text: Skill: Ainspect Timer: None GL: 7 Cost: 20 This is the Fighter's ability to take his/her knowledge of armor and inspect a piece of armor to learn the details of it. This allows the Fighter to judge the quality of the armor on many fronts. It is said that some armor is well known throughout the lands, and often Fighters remember from whence it came. Syntax is: ainspect <armor>

docs.title: Skill: Bash        Timer: Damage       GL: 15    Cost: 25%
docs.text: Skill: Bash Timer: Damage GL: 15 Cost: 25% A basic fighter attack skill. You wind up with all your strength and bash your enemy on the head. You will be much more effective if you use a weapon (and one that would make sense to use when bashing someone over the head helps!), otherwise you will use your bare hands. When bashing a target you can sometimes hit them hard enough that it decreases their ability to fight back effectively. Syntax is: bash <target>

docs.title: Skill enhancer: Bard spell
docs.text: Skill enhancer: Bard spell A bard and a fighter make a potent team. The bard can incite a rage in the fighter which will enhance the attack capabilities of the fighter. The fighter and bard must be in the same room when the fighter uses his skill, because it's the bard who takes the fighter beyond his normal ability. The berserk increases most of your offensive skills in effectiveness, as well as reducing the cost to perform some of them.

docs.title: Skill: Cleave      Timer: Damage       GL: 13    Cost: 20%
docs.text: Skill: Cleave Timer: Damage GL: 13 Cost: 20% A Master Swordsman gains the ability to strike a mighty blow onto his enemy. Such a maneuver isn't easy, however, requiring a large, slashing, or cleaving type weapon. Syntax is: cleave <target>

docs.title: Fighter Commands
docs.text: ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Fighter Commands ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Command Description ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- fhelp <command> Will tell you more about the command. frestore tabard Fixes your guild object. fwho Version of "who" that only shows your guild members. declare <text> Declares a motto visible on "fwho". fchat Version of tell that lets you talk to all your guild members. efchat Guild channel emote. fhist This shows a history of all communi- cations on the Fighter channel. fs/fskills A current list of skills. fstats As a fighter, stats are kept on your overall career, and over just your login. fassist This allows you to call for help to your fighter brethren while fighting a tough opponent. flost This allows you to call for help to your fighter brethren when you are lost. fcrush <item> This is a fun alternative to the "junk" command which allows you to crush a given item in your hands. fgrunt <text> This command allows you to grunt the given text out in a series of grunts that only a fellow fighter, or your squire, could possibly understand. fmess <login|logout> <message> This command allows you to customize the message used when you log in and out of Darkwind. ftimers This command shows you when you can use abilities that use a specific timer. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

docs.title: Skill: Counter     Timer: None         GL:  9    Cost: NONE
docs.text: Skill: Counter Timer: None GL: 9 Cost: NONE After a certain amount of combat experience, a fighter gains the knowledge of how to turn an attack back on its attacker. This is not something that can be done often during the course of a battle but is something that a fighter with the proper skill level can do without thinking occasionally in the course of battle. Counter uses endurance when you counter-attack. Syntax is: ftoggle counter <on|off>

docs.title: Declare is a basic fighter command that allows you to make a motto visible
docs.text: Declare is a basic fighter command that allows you to make a motto visible on the "fwho" screen for other fighters to see. Syntax is: declare <text> <text> of "none" will remove your motto.

docs.title: Skill: Disarm      Timer: Trickster    GL:  6    Cost: 50
docs.text: Skill: Disarm Timer: Trickster GL: 6 Cost: 50 This is a more stylish fighter skill. You attempt to out maneuver your opponent and knock their weapon from them with your own weapon. If you are really good and the opponent has two weapons, you have a chance to also knock the second weapon from their grasp also. Syntax is: disarm <target>

docs.title: Efchat is a basic fighter command that allows you to emote to other fighters
docs.text: Efchat is a basic fighter command that allows you to emote to other fighters on the guild line. Also see "fhelp fchat", "fhelp tog", and "fhelp fgrunt." Syntax is: efchat <text>

docs.title: A list of Fighter emotes
docs.text: A list of Fighter emotes ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- farena - You invite another to the arena. fbleed - You don't have time to bleed! fcard - places an ace of spades on a corpse. (corpse required) fcot - you request a player to meet you at COT. fdance - you challenge someone to fight or "dance". fdazzle - you display your fine mastery of your weapon. feye - you eyeball someone. fflex - a fighter's way of flexing. fgrin - a fighter's way of grinning. fgrunt - you grunt. fring - challenge someone to step in the ring. fhbutt - you butt heads. Gets better with higher strength. fhug - a big bear hug. fpoint - to point at someone saying: "this is the one." fpoke - a bone crushing poke. fshake - a painful hand shake. fsmooth - Damn you're smooth... fthink - you think very carefully. fwipe - you wipe the blood off on a corpse. (corpse required) Syntax is: <emote> or <emote> <target>

docs.title: Your endurance comes from your constitution, strength, wisdom and
docs.text: Your endurance comes from your constitution, strength, wisdom and dexterity. It is used with the defensive skills you can ftoggle: counter, feint, guts and shieldblock. Each time one of the skills is successful, it will use endurance. You can recoup endurance faster using fsurge.

docs.title: Fighter Extras
docs.text: ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Fighter Extras ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Name Description ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Huge weapons* Fighters have an innate ability to be more effective when using huge weapons. While using them, your accuracy may not be the greatest, but if you land a hit you're sure to do massive damage! Shields* Fighters are able to attempt to block their opponents blows if they are using a shield. * Fighters are also able to wear a shield while using a 2-Handed or Huge weapon. Berserk If you see a bard around, ask him to party! Bards have the ability to incite a berserk rage in you, thereby enhancing most of your abilities greatly! Endurance Your endurance comes from your constitution, strength, wisdom, and dexterity. Spell Points Your SP comes from your strength, constitution, and intelligence. docs.title: This allows you to call for help to your fighter brethren while fighting
docs.text: This allows you to call for help to your fighter brethren while fighting a tough opponent. Can only be used in combat. Syntax is: fassist

docs.title: Skill: fbalance			GL: 4		Cost: 50
docs.text: Skill: fbalance GL: 4 Cost: 50 A fighter develops a keen sense for how weapons feel. They learn how to balance it to make it more effective in combat. Some weapons are already too balanced to balance any further, have magic that would be ruined if you attempted to balance it, or is simply too special to be balanced. Syntax is: fbalance <weapon>

docs.title: Skill: fbehead     Timer: None         GL:  8    Cost: 5
docs.text: Skill: fbehead Timer: None GL: 8 Cost: 5 Sever the head of a corpse to bring home as a trophy. Syntax is: fbehead <corpse>

docs.title: Skill: fcall       Timer: Support      GL:  5    Cost: 100
docs.text: Skill: fcall Timer: Support GL: 5 Cost: 100 This skill will call your Armsman to your side. You will have to RECRUIT an Armsman, first, though. This is done at the pub north of the room with the guild board. You will name your Armsman at this time. Be sure it is something easy to type, as you need to address your Armsman by name to command it. Additionally, you won't be able to name your Armsman the same as an existing player, or something offensive. If for some reason your Armsman stops following you, typing fcall again should restart the poor git's heart. Remember, after you log out, you will have to go and track your Armsman down to fcall it again. They love to hang out at the pub. If you decide to dual-guild, you will no longer be able to call your Armsman to help you. Syntax is: fcall

docs.title: Skill: fcharge     Timer: Trickster    GL:  9    Cost: 15
docs.text: Skill: fcharge Timer: Trickster GL: 9 Cost: 15 This basic fighter skill allows the fighter to charge at a target, attempting to knock the target into another room. Syntax is: fcharge <target>

docs.title: Fchat is a basic fighter command that allows you to talk to other fighters
docs.text: Fchat is a basic fighter command that allows you to talk to other fighters on the guild line. Also see "fhelp tog", "fhelp efchat", and "fhelp fgrunt." Syntax is: fchat <text>

docs.title: Skill: fconsider   Timer: None         GL:  1    Cost: 5
docs.text: Skill: fconsider Timer: None GL: 1 Cost: 5 Use this when you are not sure of an opponent. It will rate you against it in experience and stats. Syntax is: fconsider <target>

docs.title: This is a fun alternative to the "junk" command which allows you to crush a
docs.text: This is a fun alternative to the "junk" command which allows you to crush a given item in your hands. Syntax is: fcrush <item>

docs.title: Skill: fdefend     Timer: Support      GL:  2    Cost: 10
docs.text: Skill: fdefend Timer: Support GL: 2 Cost: 10 This skill allows you to jump in front of another person and defend them from their current attackers! Incredibly heroic (if painful!) Syntax is: fdefend <target>

docs.title: Skill: feint       Timer: None         GL:  1    Cost: NONE
docs.text: Skill: feint Timer: None GL: 1 Cost: NONE The simplest of all fighter techniques. You feint, causing your opponent to have a harder time landing big hits. Feint uses up your endurance while you're feinting. Syntax is ftoggle feint <on/off>

docs.title: Fgrunt is just a version of the guild chat line that only goes out to
docs.text: Fgrunt is just a version of the guild chat line that only goes out to fighters currently in the room with you. Non-fighters in the room will only see you grunting in that oh-so-intelligent fighter manner. Fgrunt is also an emote when done with no arguments, or with a player's name as an argument. Also see "fhelp fchat" and "fhelp efchat." Syntax is: fgrunt or fgrunt <target> or fgrunt <text>

docs.title: Skill: fhack       Timer: Damage       GL:  8    Cost: 10%
docs.text: Skill: fhack Timer: Damage GL: 8 Cost: 10% A basic fighter attack skill. You gather up your strength and use it to hack into your enemy without mercy. You must be wielding an edged weapon to use this skill. Syntax is: fhack <target>

docs.title: Welcome to the Fighter Guild!
docs.text: --------------------------------------------------------------------------- Welcome to the Fighter Guild! --------------------------------------------------------------------------- To learn more about a subject, use "fhelp <subject/skill>": "commands" : This shows general Fighter commands available to you. These are typically non-combat commands, but are quite useful to you during your career as a Fighter. "extras" : This screen shows you extra little "goodies" about Fighters. Such as directions to your guild halls on the other continents and any other useful insights. "emote" : This will show all the Fighter guild emotes. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

docs.title: This shows a history of all communications on the Fighter channel.
docs.text: This shows a history of all communications on the Fighter channel. You can also specify the number of history lines to display. The max is 300. Default is 36. Syntax is: fhist <number>

docs.title: Skill: fkick       Timer: Damage       GL:  4    Cost: 25
docs.text: Skill: fkick Timer: Damage GL: 4 Cost: 25 A fighter often finds himself in the throngs of anger during combat, and the best he can do is attempt to wildly kick out at his target. Sometimes you can kick your target so hard it sends him sprawling. Syntax is: fkick <target>

docs.title: This allows you to call for help to your fighter brethren when you are lost.
docs.text: This allows you to call for help to your fighter brethren when you are lost. Syntax is: flost

docs.title: This command allows you to customize the message used when you log in and out
docs.text: This command allows you to customize the message used when you log in and out of Darkwind. Syntax is: fmess <login|logout> <message|default> given without <message> returns your login/logout message. given with default sets your messages back to the default. given with <message> sets your new login/logout message. NOTE: Use $N for your name when specifying the login or logout message.

docs.title: Skill: fpunch      Timer: Damage       GL:  1    Cost: 10
docs.text: Skill: fpunch Timer: Damage GL: 1 Cost: 10 The most basic of fighter moves, punching someone as hard as you can. The damage may be minimal, but the feeling you get from punching someone as hard as you can should make up for it. Syntax is: fpunch <target>

docs.title: Skill: frage       Timer: Support      GL: 11    Cost: 50
docs.text: Skill: frage Timer: Support GL: 11 Cost: 50 A fighter builds up intense amounts of rage throughout their life. A skilled fighter can apply the knowledge gained about rage and it's pros and cons to weapons, imbuing them with some of their own rage. Some weapons are simply unable to be imbued with rage, have magic that would be ruined if you attempted to imbue it with rage, or are simply too special to be imbued with rage. Syntax is: frage <weapon>

docs.title: Skill: frenzy!     Timer: Damage       GL: 14    Cost: 120
docs.text: Skill: frenzy! Timer: Damage GL: 14 Cost: 120 An experienced fighter may work himself into a killing frenzy where he is able to fire off a quick succession of blows at everything in the room for a short period of time. Be forewarned that your foes will recover very quickly and may strike a fatal blow before you finish this maneuver. You must already be in combat to attempt a frenzy! Syntax is: frenzy!

docs.title: Skill: frenzy      Timer: Damage       GL: 10    Cost: Varies
docs.text: Skill: frenzy Timer: Damage GL: 10 Cost: Varies An experienced fighter may work himself into a killing frenzy where he is able to fire off a quick succession of blows for a short period of time. Syntax is: frenzy <target>

docs.title: Restore is a basic fighter command that allows you to update your tabard if
docs.text: Restore is a basic fighter command that allows you to update your tabard if you already have one. If you don't have one, you have to go to the guild and type "fix tabard" in the room with the old knight. Syntax is: frestore tabard

docs.title: Skill: frush       Timer: Damage       GL:  3    Cost: GL+10 Doubled
docs.text: Skill: frush Timer: Damage GL: 3 Cost: GL+10 Doubled A basic fighter attack skill. You rush forward, smashing your shield into your target. You need to be using a shield to use this skill. You get better at rushing as you increase your skills as a fighter. Syntax is: frush <target>

docs.title: Fs is a basic fighter command. It will show you the current list of skills
docs.text: Fs is a basic fighter command. It will show you the current list of skills that you know. Same as the 'fskills' command. Syntax is: fs

docs.title: Fskills is a basic fighter command. It will show you the current list of
docs.text: Fskills is a basic fighter command. It will show you the current list of skills that you know. Same as the 'fs' command. Syntax is: fskills

docs.title: As a fighter, stats are kept on your overall career, and over just your
docs.text: As a fighter, stats are kept on your overall career, and over just your login. Syntax is: fstats

docs.title: Skill: fsurge      Timer: Healing      GL: 12    Cost: GL * 10
docs.text: Skill: fsurge Timer: Healing GL: 12 Cost: GL * 10 This skill allows you to release a surge of adrenaline that boosts your endurance regeneration. After you use it, there is a 5 minute timer before you can use it again as you recover. Syntax is: fsurge

docs.title: This command shows you when you can use abilities that use a specific
docs.text: This command shows you when you can use abilities that use a specific timer. The timers are almost universally used across all guilds, so would be the same if you multi-guild. Syntax is: ftimers

docs.title: Skill: ftoggle                    GL: Varies       Cost: None
docs.text: Skill: ftoggle GL: Varies Cost: None This skill allows you to toggle on|off your various defensive techniques. The skills you can toggle are: counter, feint, guts, and shieldblock (you can also use block). You can also ftoggle the endurance bar on, off, or bar. The defensive skills use endurance, so you can toggle which you want running to help you conserve your endurance. Syntax is: ftoggle <skill> <on|off> Syntax is: ftoggle endurancebar <on|off|bar> Syntax is: ftoggle techbar <on|off> See also: fhelp counter, fhelp feint, fhelp guts, fhelp shieldblock

docs.title: Fwho is a basic fighter command. It allows you to see all the current
docs.text: Fwho is a basic fighter command. It allows you to see all the current fighters on Darkwind. It also allows you to see some information about your fellow fighters as listed below: F = fighter is currently fighting. I = fighter is currently reading or writing. M = fighter is currently muffing the fighter line. E = fighter wiz is editing. [idle] = fighter is currently idle. Syntax is: fwho

docs.title: Skill: guts        Timer: None         GL:  3    Cost: NONE
docs.text: Skill: guts Timer: None GL: 3 Cost: NONE This is the Fighter's ability to withstand, and literally absorb, pain. If no argument is given, it will tell you if you have fguts on or off. Guts uses endurance when you absorb a blow. Syntax is: ftoggle guts <on|off>

docs.title: You turn the pages of the tome to the fighters guild. It is embossed with the
docs.text: You turn the pages of the tome to the fighters guild. It is embossed with the impression of a grand tower shield. The shield has the scenes of glorious conquest by kings of legendary status wearing ancient armor and wielding powerful weapons that only a fighter could wield. This glorious guild was made in the image of these once great kings, we can wield almost anything that one would consider a weapon, and wear any armour that would protect one in battle. The only requirement to join the guild is that you be experienced in the ways of Darkwind, of at least 5th level, and possess strength befit of a warrior. As any fighter would tell you, the best quality of a true fighter is that in time of need, a fighter is never alone, there is a camaraderie among this guild of warriors. Through extensive training and much experience, one learns skills useful only to a true fighter, skills that are used mostly in combat! A fighter's standing in the guild is earned in battle. Every worthy kill grants Fighter experience, and your guild level rises on its own as that experience accumulates - no coin, no study, only combat. Read 'fhelp advancement' for the details. For further assistance, ask any fighter to help you. The guild is located in a keep just outside the City of Darkwind. From COT, go: six north, exit, four east, south, southeast, enter.

docs.title: Skill: make <shield|torch> Timer: Support GL:  2 Cost: VARIES
docs.text: Skill: make <shield|torch> Timer: Support GL: 2 Cost: VARIES Makes a shield or torch. See 'fhelp shield' or 'fhelp torch' for more specific details. Syntax is: make <shield|torch>

docs.title: Restore is a basic fighter command that allows you to update your tabard if
docs.text: Restore is a basic fighter command that allows you to update your tabard if you already have one. If you don't have one, you have to go to the guild and type "fix tabard" in the room with the old knight. Syntax is: restore tabard

docs.title: Skill: make shield Timer: Support      GL:  2    Cost: VARIES
docs.text: Skill: make shield Timer: Support GL: 2 Cost: VARIES This skill lets you try to make a shield from the nearby terrain. The Fighter's shield is a very good shield that improves as you gain skill as a fighter. Type "destroy shield" to get rid of it. Syntax is: make shield

docs.title: Skill: shieldblock Timer: None         GL:  1    Cost: NONE
docs.text: Skill: shieldblock Timer: None GL: 1 Cost: NONE As a Fighter, your skill with a shield will often let you block incoming hits totally. You need to be using a large or huge shield to make sure you can totally block the hit. Shieldblock uses your endurance when you block a hit. Syntax is: ftoggle shieldblock (or block) <on|off>

docs.title: Skill: thrust      Timer: Damage       GL:  6    Cost: 5%
docs.text: Skill: thrust Timer: Damage GL: 6 Cost: 5% A skilled warrior can perform this maneuver. The fighter finds a weak spot in the victim's physical protection and thrusts his weapon in. You must be using a piercing weapon to perform this maneuver, and even then, success is not guaranteed. Syntax is: thrust <target>

docs.title: Skill: make torch  Timer: Support      GL:  2    Cost: VARIES
docs.text: Skill: make torch Timer: Support GL: 2 Cost: VARIES This skill lets you try to make a torch from nearby materials. The torch lasts a long time. Type "destroy torch" to get rid of it, or just throw it away. Syntax is: make torch

docs.title: Skill: Winspect    Timer: None         GL:  5    Cost: 20
docs.text: Skill: Winspect Timer: None GL: 5 Cost: 20 As a fighter, you begin to understand the weapons you use. You will be able to learn much about the weapon, but it's subject to your personal interpretation. You must wield the weapon in order to inspect it. Syntax is: winspect <weapon>

docs.title: Aura of Running Water
docs.text: ================================================================ Aura of Running Water ================================================================ Blessed by the Spirit of Water Anu, a Warrior may invoke her name. While under the effect of this additional healing, one's wounds will mend themselves at random during combat. Usable in Form: All Cost: 100 Restricted to: Warrior Timer: Large Syntax: aura Type: Heal

docs.title: Garou Guild : Auspice
docs.text: ==================================================================== Garou Guild : Auspice ==================================================================== Whether waxing or waning, your auspice will grant a boon for each visage. Masule for Dailos, Eurus for Tekal, and increased healing for Markas. Beyond this, when one's visage is matched by the choosen phase, the transformation from human comes without effort. Please see: http://www.tengutech.net/tarot/auspice.php for more information.

docs.title: Balance
docs.text: ================================================================ Balance ================================================================ Balance shows you the current state of your spirit nature. It lists your current spiritual level(guild level), your auspice, your current levels of Masule and Eurus, and the state of your alignment. If your alignment remains pure neutral, you will receive additional Eurus. As it drifts far from neutral, you will be penalized Eurus. Syntax: balance

docs.title: Garou Guild : Basics
docs.text: ================================================================ Garou Guild : Basics ================================================================ "Gaea is around us, in us, above us, below us. She keeps us sane, and she keeps us healthy. We came from Gaea, and when we die, we shall return. Hers is the unending cycle of life. She makes the wind cool and the sun warm. Nothing is beyond her, but us. Her body is the very elements. Our howls reflect her song. We, as the sentient life here on this planet, must defend her from ourselves. We cannot afford to destroy our cradle, no more than the bird can destroy his nest, or the baby its womb. This is our task then: to protect Gaea from the Evil and the Corrupt." -The Old Man Garou are the defenders of Gaea, nature, and balance. For centuries Garou have protected the world from destruction, and for centuries more the hunt will continue. Along with Gaea's other followers, the Druids, Garou defend the earth and seek out those who destroy balance. Gaea empowers her Druids by granting them direct control over the elements and beasts; her Garou, on the other hand, are directly infused with her Strength and Spirit. As a Garou, you have the ability to shift between three distinct forms -- man, crinos, and wolf. Each form has its own strengths and weaknesses, so learning to utilize all forms equally is a key to success. In addition to physical forms, Garou are also able to dedicate themselves to a specific aspect of Gaea's nature. Check out 'ghelp dedication' for more information. While in man form, a Garou is able to wield and wear traditional equipment. Keep in mind, however, that using equipment that Gaea shuns will result in total loss of all Garou abilities and powers. Information regarding such equipment restrictions can be found in 'ghelp equipment'. The man form is also the only form in which a Garou can communicate fully without restriction. Sociable Garou and Garou who enjoy spending time with non-Garou will choose this form often. This form is also the most adept at having access to Gaea's Spirit. A Garou who dedicates herself to the Spirit and becomes a Shaman will find man her most useful form. The crinos form is a mix between both man and wolf. This is the form that non-Garou refer to as werewolves and wolfbeasts. In this form Garou are capable of wielding many types of weapons but are restricted to wearing only certain types of armor. Furthermore, weapons that restrict a Garou in man form are completely unwieldable in crinos. Once again, information regarding equipment restrictions can be found in 'ghelp equipment'. In relation to man, crinos is a stronger form with powerful natural attacks and defenses. Crinos are also able to communicate, however their speech is generally broken and heavy accented. Garou who has chosen the path of the Guardian will find this form most appealing. The wolf form is the dominant fighting form of the Garou. This form is most in tune with Gaea's Strength, and has access to extremely powerful natural attacks and defenses as well as the greatest number of combat abilities. Warrior Garou excel in this form, while Shamans will find it less useful after achieving great mastery of the Spirit. This form can only carry a single item, in the mouth, and is completely incapable of using any form of equipment. Furthermore, wolves are unable to communicate outside the world of Gaea and are also unable to purchase or sell items in shops and businesses.

docs.title: Stance : Berserker
docs.text: ================================================================ Stance : Berserker ================================================================ The berserker stance is Gaea's gift to her warriors that completely master the usage of her Strength. In the berserker stance, one is capable of inflicting a great number of hits against an enemy, although each of these hits is weaker than one's normal attacks. Since the berserker stance is an all-out offensive strike, one's ability to dodge incoming attacks is greatly reduced during its usage. Usable in Form: Wolf Cost: 15 SP Restricted to: Warrior Syntax: stance berserker

docs.title: Blend
docs.text: ================================================================ Blend ================================================================ A wolf has incredible powers of camouflage. Using blend, he may become invisible to normal perceptions, although certain spells and all immortals can detect his presence. Many commands will reveal a hidden wolf, so take care or you could find your cover blown. Blending is a good first step to surprise an opponent, and is often used in conjunction with leap. This is also usable in man form, although it is not as effective. Syntax: blend Cost: 10 sp wolf or crinos / 20 sp in man form

docs.title: Burst
docs.text: ================================================================ Burst ================================================================ Burst is the basic attack power of the crinos form. When in a burst, the crinos form has the potential to do more damage than normal for a short time. However, this comes at the price of a penalty to dodge incoming blows. Syntax: burst [<target>] Cost: 20 sp

docs.title: Bury
docs.text: ================================================================ Bury ================================================================ Bury allows you to hide an item under the ground for later use (or later sale). Only you can retrieve the buried item, by using the dig command. The maximum number of items you can have buried at any one time is 15. After that, you must use the forget command, or dig up a few items before you can bury any more. Items will carry over between logins, but not between reboots. You cannot bury items inside buildings. Syntax: bury <target> Cost: 5 sp

docs.title: Carry
docs.text: ================================================================ Carry ================================================================ Carry allows a wolf to carry one item in his mouth. The wolf will be unable to engage in combat while holding an item in his mouth. Use 'spit' to spit out the item so you can transform or fight. Coins are an exception. You can carry as many coins as you want, regardless of form, and will not be penalized even if the inventory listing says you have a pile of coins in your mouth. Syntax: carry <target>

docs.title: Chase
docs.text: ================================================================ Chase ================================================================ Chase is a toggle that indicates whether you wish to pursue your prey should he leave the room. The prey may move in a way you cannot handle, such as through magical teleportation, and you will be unable to follow. Otherwise, when he flees, and you pursue him, you will be able to track his scent. Syntax: chase

docs.title: Spirit Claws
docs.text: ================================================================ Spirit Claws ================================================================ Spirit claws are a potent weapon that can be called forth by shamans with enough skill. They will remain for a good amount of time, but are not usable in wolf form. By default the claws are Medium. If you want Large claws, try "claws large" or "claws blarge". If you would like Small claws, try "claws small" or "claws bsmall". The "b" signifies blunt claws, and will cause you to wield the Spiritual Paw, instead of the Spiritual Claws. NOTE: Shaman may summon and wield two claws/paws. Usable in form: Crinos & Man Cost: 150 sp Restricted to: Shaman Timer: Medium Syntax: claws Type: Support

docs.title: Consider
docs.text: ================================================================ Consider ================================================================ Consider can be used to get a general idea of the strength of a possible opponent relative to your power. Generally, you should try and fight opponents who are equal in power to you or slightly stronger. Note that consider does not take into account any spiritual powers or party help you may use, nor does it weigh the spells or special attacks of the target. Thus, discretion is advised when using this power. Syntax: consider <target> Cost: 5 sp

docs.title: Create Charm
docs.text: ================================================================ Create Charm ================================================================ An experienced garou can create a charm fetish to aid and protect himself or one of his friends. The charm will last for a short duration, or until the owner breaks it or logs off. The charm types are listed below. A player may only have one charm fetish at a time. The recipient must be either another Garou, or a wolf pet. This power is usable on the caster in all 3 forms, but may only be bestowed upon another when the garou is in man form. Bear - +10 STR Dragonfly - +10 DEX Moose - +10 CON Dolphin - +10 INT Raven - +10 WIS Peacock - +10 CHR Owl - +5 INT, +5 WIS Monkey - +5 DEX, +5 INT Elephant - +5 WIS, +5 CON Wolf - +6 DEX, +4 STR Woad - +10% Magic Resist Usable in Form: Man only on others, all forms when self-targeted Syntax: create <type> [for <target>] Cost: 100 sp Timer: Medium Type: Support

docs.title: Crinoslong
docs.text: ================================================================ Crinoslong ================================================================ Crinoslong allows you to change the long description of your crinos form. This is what the players will see when they 'look' at you. Please keep descriptions consistent with the crinos form. Inappropriate descriptions will be removed. Syntax: crinoslong <description>

docs.title: Garou Guild : Dedication
docs.text: ================================================================ Garou Guild : Dedication ================================================================ As you might have heard from the old man already, Garou are able to choose between increasing their masule or their eurus with each level advance. Masule represents the level of Gaea's Strength that a Garou has obtained, while eurus represents the level of Gaea's Spirit obtained. Masule comes from the elements of Chauf and Terre. It is the source of feral strength and determines one's fighting ability as a wolf. Eurus, on the other hand, is hard to explain. It is more than wisdom or knowledge. It is an inner awareness of one's own spirit. The power of Eurus comes from the elements of Bise and Seros. The very nature of a Garou is founded upon her masule and eurus. Masule increases the offensive capabilities of a Garou in wolf and crinos form while also influencing natural defenses. Eurus also influences natural defenses, but more importantly aids a Garou's regenerative abilities and spiritual powers. In addition, a Garou will be considered dedicated to one of three paths depending upon her masule and eurus. A Garou whose eurus is greater than twice her masule will be considered a Shaman, one who commands Gaea's Spirit. A Garou whose masule is greater than twice her eurus will be considered a Warrior, one filled with Gaea's Strength. Lastly, a Garou who is not considered a Shaman or a Warrior will be considered a Guardian, one both wise and strong. Dedications are very important and you should choose one that best matches your desired playing style. Shamans make fairly weak wolves and crinos, possessing only moderate defenses and a poor offense. Shamans, however, have the highest regenerative ability and command very powerful spiritual powers. Warriors have very few spiritual abilities, but are very powerful wolves. Warriors have the highest offensive ability, with moderate defenses. Warriors also possess a large number of stances that allow them to fight differently depending upon the situation. Guardians have a large number of spiritual powers and yet still make great wolves. As a wolf or crinos, a Guardian sports a moderate offense and the strongest defenses. See 'ghelp shaman', 'ghelp guardian', and 'ghelp warrior' for a list of abilities and stances.

docs.title: Stance: Defensive
docs.text: ================================================================ Stance: Defensive ================================================================ The defensive stance is known only by those Garou who are both wise and strong. The defensive stance provides an increase in dodging and absorbing enemy attacks while lowering one's offensive capabilities in the process. Usable in Form: Crinos Cost: Varied Restricted to: Guardian Duration: Long Syntax: stance defensive

docs.title: Dig
docs.text: ================================================================ Dig ================================================================ Dig allows you to retrieve an item you buried earlier. You must, of course, be in the same room you buried them in. Buried items do not carry over between reboots, and you may have a maximum of 15 items buried at one time. If you can't recall where you buried your loot, use the remember command. Syntax: dig

docs.title: Directed Rage
docs.text: ================================================================ Directed Rage ================================================================ Directed rage is one of the most potent combat abilities possessed by the Garou. Building up her inner anger, a Garou howls terribly at her foe, inspiring great fear in him and preventing him from taking action. Time of paralyzation is variable. Usable in Form: Wolf & Crinos Cost: 20% MAX SP Restricted to: Warrior and Guardian Lvl Required: 65 Timer: Huge GL Required: 12 (Warrior) Type: Stun 15 (Guardian) Syntax: drage <target>

docs.title: Earthbond
docs.text: ================================================================ Earthbond ================================================================ A shaman who has obtained the title of Hero is able to perform the Ceremony of Earthbonding. Summoning the powers of both Gaea and Luna, such a shaman is capable of enchanting metallic weapons and armor purifying the metallic components and restoring the item's harmony with nature. Such items, formerly restricted from use by Garou due to the metallic impurity, will then by usable by Garou. [NOTE: Earthbond can't make unusable armor types usable by Garou. For example, Garou can't wear platemail (Earthbond'ed or not). Garou can, however, use Earthbond'ed chainmail.] Usable in Form: Man Restricted to: Shaman Level Required: 45 Syntax: earthbond <item> Cost: 235 SP

docs.title: Eat Corpse
docs.text: ================================================================ Eat Corpse ================================================================ A Garou in crinos or wolf form can eat the bodies of her fallen foes, regaining both physical and spiritual energy from the flow of life. The size of the corpse determines how much energy can be regained. Syntax: eat corpse

docs.title: Emergency
docs.text: ================================================================ Emergency ================================================================ The Garou in wolf form is unable to use tells or shouts, and thus could have a situation where they will be unable to contact a wizard for assistance. The emergency command will send a message to all wizards currently on Darkwind. Please do not use it for casual conversation, and be aware that all use of this command is logged. Syntax: emergency <msg>

docs.title: Garou Guild : Emotes
docs.text: ================================================================ Garou Guild : Emotes ================================================================ Your emotes in wolf form are: ack bark belly bite blink chops gcircle crotch drool flash glare grin growl grumble hackle inhale jump lag leglove lick listen lowhead mark nip nlick nudge nuzzle pant play point prickle proud press puzzle sleep snag snarl sneeze stretch toss tug wag whimper whine wink yawn yelp At this point none of these emotes work on players not in the room with you.

docs.title: Empower
docs.text: ================================================================ Empower ================================================================ A learned shaman is capable of empowering her fellow Garou, increasing the duration of their wolf and crinos form attack maneuvers such as lunge and harry. Usable in Form: Man Cost: 45 SP Restricted to: Shaman Syntax: empower <person>

docs.title: Enrage
docs.text: ================================================================ Enrage ================================================================ A warrior is able to enrage themselves, increasing the duration of their wolf and crinos form attack maneuvers such as lunge and harry. Usable in Form: All Cost: 15 SP Restricted to: Warrior Timer: Small Syntax: enrage Type: Support

docs.title: Garou Guild : Equipment
docs.text: ==================================================================== Garou Guild : Equipment ==================================================================== While a wolf has no need for sword or shirt, a Garou who decides to hunt in man or crinos form will naturally desire equipment to make the hunt easier. As a creature of Gaea, however, a Garou must take great care to stay away from equipment that the beloved goddess hates and abhors. A Garou using such equipment will lose all touch with Gaea and thus be unable to utilize any abilities. Weapon Restrictions: -------------------- A Garou may not use magical weapons of any kind. A Garou may not use missile weapons of any kind. A Garou may not use silver weapons of any kind. A Garou may not use metallic weapons of any kind. Exception: A Garou may use metallic polearm weapons provided they are not magical or composed of silver. Armor Restrictions: ------------------- A Garou may not wear magical armor of any kind. A Garou may not wear silver armor of any kind. A Garou may not wear metallic armor of any kind. A Garou may not wear plate-type armor of any kind. Exception: A Garou may use plate and/or metallic finger and amulet class armor provided such is not magical or silver. Crinos Restrictions: -------------------- Since crinos are massive and powerful beasts, there are additional restrictions to what a crinos can wear. All of these restrictions are in addition to those listed above. Crinos may not use shields. Crinos may only wear greaves as leg armor. Crinos may only wear armguards, bracelets, and bracers as arm armor. Crinos may not wear helmets of any kind. Crinos may not wear torso armor of any kind. Crinos may not wear boots of any kind. Exceptions: There are exceptional/special armors throughout the MUD that are specifically allowed for crinos use despite being restricted normally.

docs.title: Garou Guild: Eurus
docs.text: ============================================================= Garou Guild: Eurus ============================================================= There are many who think the Garou nothing but fierce warriors. But that is only half of it, for we are far more than we seem. Beyond the power of the wolf is the inner power of the spirit. We call this eurus. Eurus is hard to explain. It is more than wisdom or knowlege. It is an inner awareness of ones own spirit. The power of Eurus comes from the elements of Bise and Seros. For the Garou, it is the complement and opposite of one's masule. A Garou that chooses to gain awareness of their inner spirit is always treated with respect. Many powerful rites and rituals allow these choosen to do anything from summon the winds to enter a mystical dream world. Eurus affects a Garou's spiritual powers, defense, and regeneration. It can also affect the duration and effectiveness of other skills.

docs.title: Fangs of the Cobra
docs.text: ================================================================ Fangs of the Cobra ================================================================ By focusing upon the fangs of the king cobra and concentrating upon the structure of its fangs, a Garou is able to undergo a startling transformation. He is able to secrete venom through his canines, much like a cobra does through its fangs. Usable in form: crinos and wolf only Restricted to: Warrior Syntax: fangs Cost: varied NOTE: This ability shows in the 'buffs' command. It can be ended early with 'clearbuff'. Also, fangs cannot be used in conjuction with the skill talons.

docs.title: Fenris' Bite
docs.text: ================================================================ Fenris' Bite ================================================================ Granted the power of the Great Wolf Fenris, a Warrior can ferociously bite the opponent. Usable in Form: Crinos & Wolf Syntax: fbite <taraget> Cost: Varied

docs.title: Fenris' Claw
docs.text: ================================================================ Fenris' Claw ================================================================ Granted the power of the Great Wolf Fenris, a Warrior can ferociously claw the opponent. Usable in Form: Crinos & Wolf Syntax: fclaw <taraget> Cost: Varied

docs.title: Long ago, before the humans learned to bend the world to their will,
docs.text: Long ago, before the humans learned to bend the world to their will, Gaea created the Changing Breeds. Powerful beings borne of flesh and spirit, the Changing Breeds had the task of safeguarding Gaea's creations, both from the ravages of the spirit world and from their own selfish desires. She created the Garou to be Her warriors, the Bastet to be her eyes, and the Gurahl to be her protectors. The Bastet are a collected group of Changing Breed who are based on the felines of the world. These cats being most of the Big Cats: Panthers/Leopards, extinct Cave-Lions, Jaguars, Tigers, Lions and Cheetah, to a handful of small cats: Puma/Mountain Lion and Lynxes . The term Collected Group is used, due to fact that unlike the Garou, whose tribes, though different in ideals and some physical characteristics, are varied based on the different number of cats that have been presented and for the Eyes of Gaea, whose very purpose is to learn and keep secrets, that suits them just fine. After all, what goes on behind a cats eyes should be his own business. Bastet are blessed by Gaea with agility, and many other traits of their feline cousins. The Gurahl are werebears. According to their lore, the Gurahl are Gaea's original protectors, created to ward off the destructive power of the Wyrm, but when it grew too powerful for them they petitioned Gaea for help, and she created the Garou. Slower to anger, the Gurahl are protectors rather than warriors. Gurahl are blessed by Gaea with strong wills, and many of the traits of their bear cousins.

docs.title: Kiss of Helios
docs.text: ================================================================ Kiss of Helios ================================================================ It was in the middle of the great warrior's visionquest that Helios, the God of the Sun, came to Refa. He explained to the Garou how to invoke the spirit of the sun. With this skill, a Garou can invoke the sun's power to ignite a portion of his body and keep it burning for extended periods. Most commonly the Garou will light his mane during the ritual, without suffering ill effect. The blessing conferred is short-term, and is only useful in a Garou's wolven form. A fire elemental or a sun-spirit teaches this Gift currently. Usable in Form: Crinos and Wolf only Restricted to: Guardian Syntax: flames Cost: varied NOTE: This ability shows in the 'buffs' command. It can be ended early with 'clearbuff'. This ability cannot be used in conjunction with the skill 'quills'.

docs.title: Fog
docs.text: ================================================================ Fog ================================================================ A Garou who wishes to cloak an area and cause confusion to her foes may summon forth a thick fog. This fog will make vision impossible in the room, and those leaving the room may find themselves somewhere unexpected. Usable in Form: Man, Crinos & Wolf Syntax: fog Cost: 50 sp

docs.title: Forget Item
docs.text: ================================================================ Forget Item ================================================================ Forget will clear your list of buried items, and allow you to bury 15 new items. There is no way to forget some items and remember others. All items you had previously buried will be irretrievable. Syntax: forget

docs.title: Gate
docs.text: ================================================================ Gate ================================================================ Gate is Luna's gift to those Garou who choose to form a pack and fight against the unnatural together. The power to gate is granted to experienced Pack Shamans. Using this ability, a Pack Shaman is able to call forth a moongate that can teleport all members of her pack to her. Usable in Form: Man Cost: 150 SP Restricted to: Pack Shaman Required level: 25 Required GL: 15 Syntax: gate pack

docs.title: Greater Create Charm
docs.text: ================================================================ Greater Create Charm ================================================================ A very experienced Garou can create a charm fetish to aid and protect himself or one of his friends. The charm will last for a short duration, or until the owner breaks it or logs off. The charm types are listed below. A player may only have one charm fetish at a time. This power is usable on the caster in both forms, but may only be bestowed upon another when the Garou is in man form. Bear - +25 STR Dragonfly - +25 DEX Moose - +25 CON Dolphin - +25 INT Raven - +25 WIS Peacock - +25 CHR Owl - +12 INT, +13 WIS Monkey - +12 DEX, +13 INT Elephant - +12 WIS, +13 CON Wolf - +15 DEX, +10 STR Woad - +20% Magic Resist Usable in Form: Man only on others, all forms when self-targeted Lvl Required: 45 Cost: 200 sp Syntax: gcreate <type> [for <target>] Timer: Medium Type: Support

docs.title: Garou Guild : General Commands
docs.text: ================================================================ Garou Guild : General Commands ================================================================ In addition to the combat abilities and spiritual powers listed in 'ghelp shaman', 'ghelp guardian', and 'ghelp warrior', all Garou have access to the following commands regardless of dedication. [Usable in all forms] gsc - Display your stats and other information balance - Display your spiritual state ws - Communicate with other Garou gaea - Communicate with both Garou and Druids pt - Communicate with your fellow pack members transform - Shift between physical forms consider - Size up an opponent wsmell - Sniff around for nearby opponents sense - Sense who or what a person or wolf really is scent - Find a particular foe, or path to guildhall remember - Display the locations of your buried items forget - Forget about your buried items wolflong - Set your wolf long description crinoslong - Set your crinos long description gupdatehist - Display a list recent guild updates howl - Communicate with a great howl dig - Dig up loot you have already buried [Usable in wolf/crinos] chase - Toggle off/on chasing of foes eat - Eat a corpse to restore health bury - Bury an item in the ground [Usable only in wolf] carry - Pickup an item in your mouth spit - Spit out an item that you are carrying blend - Blend into the scenery hiding from foes emergency - Send out an emergency message to all Immortals

docs.title: Luna's Armour
docs.text: ================================================================ Luna's Armour ================================================================ Luna's Armour is a ritual that grants the garou protection from harm. The blessing conferred is short-term, but is useful in any form the Garou may adopt. The effectiveness of the ritual may be affected by the Garou's relationship with the aspects of Luna and the current configuration of the moons. Usable in Form: All Syntax: luna, gluna, or wluna [on] Cost: Varied

docs.title: Garou Scorecard
docs.text: ================================================================ Garou Scorecard ================================================================ This command will list all important attributes for your character, including most of those listed in score. It will also list guild attributes such as your pack, rank, auspice, Masule, Eurus, and form. Syntax: gsc

docs.title: Garou Guild : Gswitch
docs.text: ================================================================ Garou Guild : Gswitch ================================================================ Garou in wolf form can choose whether their natural attacks focus on claws or bite. Use gswitch to toggle between those two attack focuses. When your focus is on bite attacks, gswitch changes it back to claws. When your focus is on claw attacks, gswitch changes it to bite attacks. Syntax: gswitch Type: Support Cost: None Form: Wolf ================================================================

docs.title: Grandmother's Touch
docs.text: ================================================================ Grandmother's Touch ================================================================ Blessed by Gaea and beseeching her name, a Shaman can heal her major wounds simply by laying her hands on the injured areas. Usable in Form: Man Cost: Varied Restricted to: Shaman Timer: Large Syntax: mtouch Type: Heal

docs.title: Harry
docs.text: ================================================================ Harry ================================================================ Harry was intended to be a power to distract and confuse a foe, allowing others to kill it more easily. It does little damage, but allows others to inflict damage more effectively. This is a great power to use in a party or a hunting pack. Syntax: harry Cost: 6 sp

docs.title: Stance: Heroic
docs.text: ================================================================ Stance: Heroic ================================================================ The heroic stance is usable only by great Garou warriors who have claimed the title of Hero. This stance represents the skill obtained through countless battles and struggles along the path to becoming a great Garou Hero. This stance increases both one's offensive abilities as well as one's defensive abilities. Even a great Hero, however, can only maintain this stance for a short period of time, and must recover before he can use it again. Usable in Form: Wolf Cost: 20 SP Restricted to: Warrior Duration: Limited Level Required: 45 Syntax: stance heroic

docs.title: The elegant but simple runes tell:
