docs.title: Garou Guild : Howls
docs.text: ================================================================ Garou Guild : Howls ================================================================ Howl allows the wolf to communicate particular emotions to other players around Darkwind. This is the primary means of communication in wolf form. It is also possible to howl to all Garou, by leaving off the intended target. Current howls include: Appreciation Anger Agreement Admiration Bloodlust Beckoning Confusion Danger Distress Disagreement Farewell Fear Fondness Fatigue Frustration Greed Greetings Happiness Home Hunger Joy Lust Loneliness Loathing Laaggg Laughter Moonlust Patience Passion Revenge Reluctance Suspicion Sorrow Sickness Success Sadness Surprise Suffering Triumph Understanding Warning Weakness Syntax: howl <type> [to <target>] Cost: 5 sp

docs.title: Intensify
docs.text: ================================================================ Intensify ================================================================ Intensify increases a garou's natural vision. With an expanded vision, the garou can see things which they might not otherwise see. Usable in form: All Cost: 100sp Syntax: intensify Timer: Small Type: Trick

docs.title: The large tome's page is weathered, and torn around the edges.  You are
docs.text: The large tome's page is weathered, and torn around the edges. You are obviously not the first person to have stumbled onto it. A charcoal drawing of a dark-haired, dark-eyed woman leaning against a tree fills the upper portion of the paper. Below the woman are two wolves, both sitting stock- still. Their eyes almost appear to stare right out of the paper. Underneath the picture, in bold letters, reads: GREETINGS BOLD HUMAN! Underneath the title, the paper begins in earnest. It reads: So, you heard about us, eh? The Garou, werewolves, servants of Gaea: this we are called. Humans fear us, for we have the power to terrorize them, and in the past, we have done just that. Perhaps we deserve their loathing, for we have often over-stepped our bounds in maintaining the balance of Gaea. Some within our ranks still feel we have not gone far enough. This is, however, a minority view. The balance of Gaea is all. We cannot complete our duties if we are feared by all, yet we must maintain balance at all costs, even our own destruction if needs be. This is who we are. You have read this far. Perhaps you will read further. If so, mayhap you will find a glimmer of the Wolf in you. If you join us, you will enter a world unlike that you presently experience. You will assume the two-sided nature that consumes all of us. Man and Wolf reside in every Garou, each beckoning and tearing us. It gives us great power in all things physical, and broadens our spiritual awareness; but it gives us terrible responsibility. The unnatural is our foe, and we must fight to destroy it. The Kindred, evil spirits who should be dead, decay amidst those we strive to protect. They are our worst enemies. Representations of all that is evil, and all that is chaos: that is what the Kindred are, and what we must destroy. Gaea has not made us defenseless in our struggle. To aid us, Gaea has given us a fast healing rate. Regardless of what form we are in, we heal our bodies at rates unbelievably faster than ordinary mortals. We cannot consume alcohol. It is only a tool of the force behind the chaos which tries to destroy the balance Gaea created. As humans, our will-power restored itself much as our bodies do. However, as wolves, we must eat the freshly dead to restore our spirit. But Gaea also sees fit to give us a surge of healing when we eat, so that we can continue our quest to protect the balance. At the bottom of the page, someone has handscribbled a note. It reads: Come visit an old man, and keep him company. I will gladly answer any questions you ask, if I can. To those who would find me, I am not far from this thriving metropolis. Leave the town by its western exit, and follow the river road south until you enter the safety of the forest. Then look for a clearing to the west along the northmost path. I will be there waiting. Signed, M-r-h?l

docs.title: The old man looks you over.
docs.text: The old man looks you over. He says: To join a pack is a privilege. A new Garou will not start in one unless they are powerful enough to start their own. Being a <LONE> wolf is a natural period for a Garou. But when you feel the need to join a pack you must find a pack <LEADER> or <KEEPER> to allow in. Don't always try for the big packs though as they must sacrifice more gold to <GAEA> in order to advance.

docs.title: The old man says: I was an alcoholic once.  I do not know why.  Or even
docs.text: The old man says: I was an alcoholic once. I do not know why. Or even how it began. But I remember this: my life was lead from day to day, moment to moment. All thoughts were on how to get the next drink. I didn't even care if it was good. This was my low point in life. He pauses for a moment, staring at the sky. He continues: Were in it not for the kindly tendings of my first Leader, I would still be living in the bottom of bottles. Keep away from Alcohol; it will poison and destroy you.

docs.title: The old man suddenly seems to disappear.
docs.text: The old man suddenly seems to disappear. Then he speaks, and you can see him once more. He says: Blending in is an old technique. We all have done it at one time or another. However, Gaea helps us along, and helps us disappear into the surroundings. It's not perfect, and the less experienced of us can only do it right half the time. To make things even more disturbing, once we act, or do anything, except look around, we are visible. On one hand, it's a great ability, but it is only useful in defense.

docs.title: The old man stands straight:
docs.text: The old man stands straight: As the danger to <GAEA> increases, the packs have become more selective. A Garou can no longer be tainted by lure of magic and power. Thus, a Garou can no longer join other guilds except those that also fight for the same cause. A pack can still bond with some other guilds and adopt members, but once the ointment is applied the path is chosen. The old man sits back down.

docs.title: The old man says: The Cave, eh?  Heh heh, yes, yes...it is a mystery.  Only
docs.text: The old man says: The Cave, eh? Heh heh, yes, yes...it is a mystery. Only the Garou can see it. Only the Garou enter it. He points towards a stump. He says: Odd. I can physically show a non-Garou right where it is, and still, he cannot see it. Well, no matter. It is all the better for us, I suppose. He smiles widely. He says: The surprises of the Cave are not only on the outside. Inside, the stone has been carved and polished, so tht it shines in the dimmest light. Walls and Blocks are used as Bulletin Boards, so that the many members can speak with each other, even if they never see each other. There's even a place inside, where only the Garou may dine. Even as a wolf. He points at himself. He says: I go there myself sometimes, when times are slow. He thinks for a moment. The old man says: You'll have to go in to see for yourself. There is no more I can tell you from here. He returns to his meditation.

docs.title: The old man sighs.
docs.text: The old man sighs. He says: Wolves are masters of communication. At least for animals. Their body language and howls can carry quite a bit of information. But not nearly as much as human speech. Put simply, we cannot communicate as well as wolves. Wolves can still speak but only another Garou or maybe a Druid can understand their jumbled language. The old man smiles. He continues: Of course, when we're human, we can tell our Pack members almost anything through our <SPIRIT>. We also know where our comrades are at any time. Not too shabby, eh? He grins, and returns to his meditation.

docs.title: The old man says: The Council is made up of all the Leaders of all the Packs.
docs.text: The old man says: The Council is made up of all the Leaders of all the Packs. There is a special Council room in the <CAVE>, dedicated for just this purpose. He points at himself. He says: I used to take part in the debates myself, before I became too old to effectively intimidate my peers. The old man grins. He says: The stories I could tell you. He sighs wistfully. He says: No matter. What's important for you to know, is that the Council's decision on matters is final. Only the Diety known as Malcolm can override it. Great fights have occurred over silly issues; it is up to the Council to make sure that such destructive splits do not occur again. He smiles. The old man says: If I can help you with anything else... He then returns to his meditation.

docs.title: The old man licks his lips.
docs.text: The old man licks his lips. He says: Yeah, nothing like a freshly killed steak! He grins evilly. He says: Seriously, eating gives Garou some of their power back. As <WOLF>, we do not regenerate our <SPIRIT>. Our healing does continue to rise quickly, but our Spirit stands still. Thus, we need to eat. The more powerful the foe, the better we feel after consuming its corpse; this is the wish of <GAEA>. He grins again. The old man says: Anything more I can help you with?

docs.title: The old man looks up.
docs.text: The old man looks up. He says: As we follow <GAEA>, so do we draw our power from the elements of the Earth. The flaming Chauf, the blowing Bise, the solid Terre, and the flowing Seros. These are the bases and source of all things. For the Garou, our feral strength comes from Chauf and Terre to make the <MASULE>. While our power of spirit comes from Bise and Seros to make the inner <EURUS>.

docs.title: The old man thinks deeply.
docs.text: The old man thinks deeply. He starts to speak then stops. Then starts... He says: Eurus is hard to explain. It is more than wisdom or knowlege. It is an inner awareness of ones own spirit. The power of Eurus comes from the <ELEMENTS> of Bise and Seros. For the Garou, it is the compliment and opposite of <MASULE>. A Garou warrior needs little Eurus, but to follow the <SPIRITUAL> path, much is required.

docs.title: The old man spreads his arms wide.
docs.text: The old man spreads his arms wide. He says: Gaea is around us, in us, above us, below us. She keeps us sane, and she keeps us healthy. We came from Gaea, and when we die, we shall return. Hers is the unending cycle of life. She makes the wind cool and the sun warm. Nothing is beyond her, but us. Her body is the very <ELEMENTS>. Our howls reflect her song. We, as the sentient life here on this planet, must defend her from ourselves. We cannot afford to destroy our cradle, no more than the bird can destroy his nest, or the baby its womb. This is our task then: to protect Gaea from the Evil and the Corrupt. He smiles warmly. He says: This is important to me. Take this to heart; without Gaea, we are like dust. With that, he turns back to his meditation.

docs.title: The old man chuckles slightly.
docs.text: The old man chuckles slightly. He says: So you want to know about the Garou, do ya? You came to the right place ya know. Not too many people even know we exist. Those that guess our existance call us werewolves. Fear and hatred consume them, so they do not see what is obvious. But you see, don't you? Of course you do! If you didn't, you would not be here, speaking with an old man. The old man smiles gently. He says: So, what do you want to know about us? We're quite the diversified bunch, ya know. We've got many <PACKS> within our domain. Or, perhaps you'd like to know about our <POWERS>. We've got quite a few. Or perhaps you're more interested in talking about <PHILOSOPHY>. The Garou, like the Holy Men of Nature, strive to protect the natural balance given to us by <GAEA>. The old man coughs fitfully. After he recovers, he smiles warmly at you. He says: My apologies. Where were we? Oh yes, feel free to [ASK] me about anything. If I can answer you, I shall. (Usage: ask about <TOPIC>)

docs.title: The old man chuckles slightly.
docs.text: The old man chuckles slightly. He says: So you want to know about the Garou, do ya? You came to the right place ya know. Not too many people even know we exist. Those that guess our existance call us werewolves. Fear and hatred consume them, so they do not see what is obvious. But you see, don't you? Of course you do! If you didn't, you would not be here, speaking with an old man. The old man smiles gently. He says: So, what do you want to know about us? We're quite the diversified bunch, ya know. We've got many <PACKS> within our domain. Or, perhaps you'd like to know about our <POWERS>. We've got quite a few. Or perhaps you're more interested in talking about <PHILOSOPHY>. The Garou, like the Holy Men of Nature, strive to protect the natural balance given to us by <GAEA>. The old man coughs fitfully. After he recovers, he smiles warmly at you. He says: My apologies. Where were we? Oh yes, feel free to [ASK] me about anything. If I can answer you, I shall. (Usage: ask about <TOPIC>)

docs.title: The old man says: Harry is another one of our <SKILLS>.  It is a defensive
docs.text: The old man says: Harry is another one of our <SKILLS>. It is a defensive manuever consisting of circling and making feinting attacks. It is most useful to draw the enemy into attacking you while your allies do the damamge. The old man says: Good tactic in pack hunting.

docs.title: The old man points to the ointment bowl.
docs.text: The old man points to the ointment bowl. He says: To become one of the Garou, all you need to do is apply the ointment. The Spirit of the Wolf will help you from there. This is an important decision, and should not be made lightly, for the life of the Garou is not like the life of the others. Much is gained and lost in the process. He says: You will not start in a pack, but will be a <LONE> wolf. You must ask for a pack <LEADER> or <KEEPER> to <ADOPT> you in. The old man continues: Of great importance is the <BOND> of a pack. He then returns to his meditation.

docs.title: The old man stretches his arms.
docs.text: The old man stretches his arms. He says: I was once a pack Keeper. A Keeper is both pack guardian and the acting Leader when the true Leader is abscent. The Keeper is <APPOINT>ed by the Leader and can then also <ADOPT> packless Garou into the pack or <DRIVE> members out. He grins then continues: The Keeper is also allow in <COUNCIL>, both to voice his or her own option and to speak for a missing Leader. Careful though. A Keeper that speaks out of place will soon find herself packless or worse.

docs.title: The old man grins evilly at you.
docs.text: The old man grins evilly at you. He says: So you want to be a Leader, huh? Well, don't you worry; you'll be a Leader before ya know it. When you get powerful enough, it is tradition to leave the Pack to start another one. Then, my friend, it's your turn to be Leader. He says: A Leader can <ADOPT> packless Garou into his or her pack. She can also <DRIVE> members out and <APPOINT> a pack <KEEPER>. The old man sighs. He says: I only hope that you can wisely lead your Pack. You will be in charge of not only yourself, but of your Pack. Not only that, but you will be part of the <COUNCIL>. This duty should not be underestimated. With another sigh, he returns to his meditation.

docs.title: The old man says: Ah yes.  Licking our wounds.  It's not the most powerful
docs.text: The old man says: Ah yes. Licking our wounds. It's not the most powerful healing around, but our natural healing powers do make our saliva a precious commodity. Use it wisely, and do not make the mistake of healing our enemies. They remember our trespasses, but never our gifts.

docs.title: The old man looks tired.
docs.text: The old man looks tired. He says: A lone wolf is simply a packless Garou. They may be this way because they are young and noone has <ADOPT>ed them in a pack. Or, like many, they perfer the solo life. Once in a pack, a Garou can always leave and become lone again.

docs.title: The old man says: Lunge is just one of our <SKILLS>.  It is one of the
docs.text: The old man says: Lunge is just one of our <SKILLS>. It is one of the maneuvers that allows us to tear our opponents apart. Although we expose ourselves to enemies in this attack, we also do incredible damage when we strike. He pounds his fist into his other palm. He grins. He says: And then we squash them like grapes.

docs.title: He turns to you and says: Magic?  Is that what you're interested in?
docs.text: He turns to you and says: Magic? Is that what you're interested in? He turns away in disgust. He says: I'll tell you about Magic. He spits on the ground. He says: It destroys. Every spell takes away from Gaea, and does not return. Burning and destruction; that is all the users of Magic know. They bind creatures to their will, and force them to do their evil bidding. It is magic that keeps the undead from their rightful graves. We must destroy these evils, or at least be wary of them. Be careful, for they desire nothing but power and destruction! He points his finger at you. He says: Do you do magic? Are you the servant of evil? Do you drink the water of evil? If you do, then beware, for the path is short, and the way is narrow. Death and doom are all that await the servants of evil! He turns away from you.

docs.title: The old man points to you and says: Do not underestimate that part of us.
docs.text: The old man points to you and says: Do not underestimate that part of us. He grins. He says: As human, we may not have the strongest attacks, but we can think. And talk. And our arms can carry. We can purposely move towards saving Gaea, instead of reacting like an animal. We can call for others, or dirrect our comrades. This part of us can not be underestimated. He says: The man form is more in touch with ones <EURUS> and the powers gained through the <SPIRITUAL> path. He returns to his meditation.

docs.title: The old man growls.
docs.text: The old man growls. He says: As the Garou is both wolf and man, we are also Masule and <EURUS>. Masule comes from the <ELEMENTS> of Chauf and Terre. It is the source of our feral strength and determines our fighting ability as a wolf. It is the path of Garou warriors.

docs.title: The old man says: Ah Ha!  You want to know about our Packs!
docs.text: The old man says: Ah Ha! You want to know about our Packs! He points behind you, to an old tree. He says: Behind you is a list of our Packs. It keeps track of who's in what pack, and who the leaders are. It is wise to ask a <LEADER> about his <PHILOSOPHY> before <JOINING> though. Each leader has different expectations of those in the Pack. He grins at you. He says: The Packs are each self-contained. No fussing about with too many people. And even though the <CAVE> is used by all, most of your duties are done within and for your Pack. The spiritual link between you and your Packmates allow a non- verbal communication...at least while you're human. The old man nods to you, and returns to his meditation.

docs.title: The old man rubs his hands together.
docs.text: The old man rubs his hands together. He says: Philosophy, philosophy, philosophy. Where to begin? Where to end? These are questions that also belong under Philosophy. The old man thinks for a moment. He says: I'll just tell ya the basics. What more is to tell, right? We are the Garou, different by our very nature. We are split between two world, and have little desire of reconciliation. We are the <WOLF> and the <MAN>, striving to protect <GAEA> at all costs. He pauses for a moment. He continues: <MAGIC> is corrupt and unclean. Only the <SPIRIT> is truly clean. We must listen to our Spirit in all we do. Even as the Wolf, we are guided by our Spirit. Do not fall prey to the evil influences of the Magic Users, or the Undead. They strive to bend you to their evil purposes. And lastly, the individual philosophies of the Packs are to be adhered to, without exception. He takes a deep breath. The old man says: Anything else?

docs.title: The old man stretched his arms.
docs.text: The old man stretched his arms. He says: This may take a bit, so relax for a moment. He begins to chant and sudden realization hits his face. He says: Much better. Now let's see: Well we can split the powers up into three distinct groups: The ones our <WOLF> side can use, the one out <MAN> side can use, and the ones that both sides can use. Let's see now... He thinks for a moment. He says: As a human, we can talk freely, and take as much as we can carry. We can carry weapons and armor to protect ourselves, but only those that Gaea provides. We can <SUMMON> wolves to help protect us, and <COMMUNICATE> with our fellow pack members. There is also a <SPIRITUAL> path that brings many sacred abilities. He says: As a wolf, we have natural fighting <SKILLS>. We resist <MAGIC> without even thinking. We cannot carry or speak well, but we can destroy the foes of <GAEA> with ease. We can find the <SCENT> of prey, and <EAT> the corpses of our fallen enemies to regain strength. We can <LUNGE> at our opponents and tear them apart! We can also <HARRY> our prey or <RAGE> against them. The old man smiles.

docs.title: The old man lifts back his head, but then coughs loudly.
docs.text: The old man lifts back his head, but then coughs loudly. He says: The raging howl is one of our most difficult <SKILLS>. The very sound of it will paralyse our foes making it impossible for them to fight back. It is an outlet for all ones feral rage, but is not as difficult as the slamming attack of our greatest warriors.

docs.title: The old man lifts his heads and inhales deeply.
docs.text: The old man lifts his heads and inhales deeply. He says: A wolf can tell much from the odors in the air and on the ground. In that form, a Garou can find the scent of nearby prey. With experience, the scent path can be quite long. Even as a human, a Garou can smell into an adjoining area to determine what is there.

docs.title: The old man grins widely.
docs.text: The old man grins widely. He says: Let me give you a brief list of our skills. We can <SCENT>, <HARRY>, <BLEND>, resist <MAGIC>, <LUNGE>, <EAT>, and have natural AC and WC. This is what is nice for me. He stretches. He says: Even at my old age, the natural weapons and armor kick butt. And it's nice not having to lug around a heavy weapon. I don't think I could do it at my age. He smiles. He says: Even with the natural Healing, I won't live forever, but at least I can take a few more Undead with me. He winks at you.

docs.title: The old man smiles widely.
docs.text: The old man smiles widely. He says: Now this is a subject I love to talk about. The Spirit of the <WOLF>. We are not totally <MAN> anymore. We have sworn allegiance to the Spirit of the Wolf, and accepted the pledge to protect <GAEA> at all costs. Do not forget this, for it is the cornerstone of our <PHILOSOPHY>. Beware the evils of <ALCOHOL> and <MAGIC>. They strip you of your Spirit and leave you with but a shell. The old man grunts. He says: If you do not understand the Spirit, then you will never succeed in understanding yourself. This is the truth, and the only way of full understanding. He turns back toward his meditation.

docs.title: The old man looks at you.
docs.text: The old man looks at you. He says: There are many who think the Garou nothing but fierce warriors. But that is only half, for we are far more. The old man looks away. He says: Beyond the power of the wolf is the inner power of the spirit. We call this <EURUS> and consider it sacred and powerful. A Garou that chooses to follow this path is always treated with respect. Many powerful rites and rituals allow these choosen to do anything from summon the winds to enter a mystical dream world. Like most warriors, I have only learned the most basic rites as there are many sacrifices to pursue this role.

docs.title: The old man smiles.
docs.text: The old man smiles. He says: It takes time to master the art of calling the <WOLF> to our side, but once mastered, the power is quite useful. Even after we <TRANSFORM>, they stay by our side to fight the enemies of <GAEA>. After time, though, they revert back to their animal instincts and run back to the wild. He smiles again. The old man says: Is there anything else I can help you with?

docs.title: The old man grins evilly.
docs.text: The old man grins evilly. He says: Well well well. It is certainly the most distinctive power we have. It take both time and willpower to transform from <MAN> to <WOLF> and back. It can prove difficult to quickly move between your forms. But it is not impossible. While you are transforming, you are completely vulnerable, so be careful. Only the most brave or stupid will be caught by an enemy while transforming. He smiles at you, and returns to his meditations.

docs.title: The old man says: Ah, the Wolf part of us is the strong part of us.  It is
docs.text: The old man says: Ah, the Wolf part of us is the strong part of us. It is the side we use to exact Justice on those who destroy Gaea. The power of the wolf is determine by a Garou's <MASULE>. He smiles.

docs.title: Judge Aligment
docs.text: ================================================================ Judge Aligment ================================================================ Judge compares another creature's alignment. This can be useful to Garou wishing to keep their Eurus high, and therefore their alignment near neutral. It will show both alignment and ethics. Usable in form: All Cost: 100 sp Syntax: judge <target> Timer: Small Type: Trick

docs.title: Padwa says "I use to be the 'shaman' for the garou that lived in this
docs.text: Padwa says "I use to be the 'shaman' for the garou that lived in this network of caves. At first we consisted of the noble 'were-panther'. Soon after the were-panthers made this place their home the 'were-wolf' moved in. For a time we lived in perfect harmony, but that was not to last long. The natural war between dogs and cats began gnawing at our people. A vicious and pointless 'war' broke out between the two groups of garou. After years of pointless killing the were-panthers left the guild hall for other lands."

docs.title: Padwa says 'My name is Padwa.'
docs.text: Padwa says 'My name is Padwa.'

docs.title: Padwa says "Yes I was the their mystical teacher.  Unfortunatly the
docs.text: Padwa says "Yes I was the their mystical teacher. Unfortunatly the 'were-panther' tribe fled from our homeland of Kerei. I have not heard from any of them in a very long time."

docs.title: Padwa says "Yes there was a terrible war.  It started with arguments and
docs.text: Padwa says "Yes there was a terrible war. It started with arguments and violence amongst the younger garou. The shamans from both the 'were-wolf' and the 'were-panther' tribes saw the wrongness of the war and tried to stop it. We tried to teach them the balance and harmony with nature that Gaia has tried to teach us. The young garou would not listen. They assumed balance and harmony meant harmony of not living with the opposite tribe. The violence started with simply stealing the other tribes hunts. Then it moved to actual killing of a member of the opposite tribe. These strikes and random killings went on for years. The leaders of the tribes tried to stop it, but soon found themselves attacking each other as well. Finally bloodshed occurred in the guild halls themselves. This escalation continued until the 'were-panther' tribe realized that this would only end in extinction. They decided to leave. I stayed behind in hopes of teaching the garou this sad tale and hopefully one day we will learn from our mistakes and reunite the garou once again.

docs.title: Padwa says "The were-panthers were a noble and powerful tribe of the
docs.text: Padwa says "The were-panthers were a noble and powerful tribe of the garou. Like your wolfen kind they could transform from man into were-panther and into a full panther. Most of their tribe spent their time in the were-panther form. They found this allowed them to get closer to their mystical being. It's too bad they have all fled. I do miss them."

docs.title: Padwa says "Ah yes the were-wolf tribe.  You should know more about this
docs.text: Padwa says "Ah yes the were-wolf tribe. You should know more about this tribe since you are the were-wolf form of the garou."

docs.title: Umbral Klaive
docs.text: ================================================================ Umbral Klaive ================================================================ The Umbral Klaive is a Guardian's most powerful weapon. Forged through manifesting a Guardian's eurus, via the Umbra, and binding a bane into the blade. By default, an Umbral Klaive will be bound by an Earth bane. This will cause the Klaive to be (chaotic), like Spirit Claws. If you want to bind a different bane, here are the following banes to choose from and their syntax: klaive: An Earth Elemental is bound to the klaive, causing vines to lash out from it. klaive huge: An Earth Elemental is bound to the klaive, causing vines to lash out from it. This is a Grand Klaive. klaive living: A Wyld Spirit is bound to the klaive, causing the klaive to appear to be living. klaive flaming: A Fire Elemental is bound to the klaive, causing the klaive to have flames consuming it. klaive frozen: An Ice Elemental is bound to the klaive, causing ice crystals to form along the length of the blade. klaive humming: An Umbral Bane is bound to the klaive, cause it to vibrate endlessly. klaive shocking: A Lightning Elemental is bound to the klaive, causing the blade to course with electricity. klaive wildrage: A Rage Spirit is bound to the klaive, causing the blade itself to sear it's enemies flesh. klaive poisoned: A Toxin Bane is bound to the klaive, causing the blade to be coated in various posions. Usable in form: Man & Crinos Cost: 150 sp Restricted to: Guardian Timer: Medium Syntax: klaive <type> Type: Support

docs.title: Leap
docs.text: ================================================================ Leap ================================================================ Leap allows a Garou to jump onto a surprised opponent and get a free attack. It must either be used from an adjacent room, or by a blended wolf. Success is not guaranteed. Syntax: leap at <target> or leap <dir> at <target> Cost: 25 sps

docs.title: Stance: Legendary
docs.text: ================================================================ Stance: Legendary ================================================================ The legendary stance is Gaea's gift to her beloved Legendary Warriors. In this stance, a Garou's entire body is filled with Gaea's Strength and the full power of his inner ability is released. Usable in Form: Wolf Cost: 20 SP Restricted to: Warrior Duration: Limited Level Required: 65 Syntax: stance legendary

docs.title: Luna's Armour
docs.text: ================================================================ Luna's Armour ================================================================ Luna's Armour is a ritual that grants the garou protection from harm. The blessing conferred is short-term, but is useful in any form the Garou may adopt. The effectiveness of the ritual may be affected by the Garou's relationship with the aspects of Luna and the current configuration of the moons. Usable in Form: All Syntax: luna, gluna, or wluna [on] Cost: Varied

docs.title: Lunge
docs.text: ================================================================ Lunge ================================================================ Lunge is the basic attack power of the wolf form. When lunging, the wolf has the potential to do more damage than normal for a short time. However, this comes at the price of a penalty to dodge incoming blows. Syntax: lunge [<target>] Cost: 10 sp

docs.title: Garou Guild: Masule
docs.text: ============================================================= Garou Guild: Masule ============================================================= As we follow Gaea, so do we draw our power from the elements of the Earth. The flaming Chauf, the blowing Bise, the solid Terre, and the flowing Seros. These are the bases and source of all things. For the Garou, our feral strength comes from Chauf and Terre to make the masule. Masule is the source of our feral strength and determines our fighting ability as a wolf. Masule affects a Garou's offensive powers and their stances. It can also affect their defense and the duration and effectiveness of other skills.

docs.title: Master Create Charm
docs.text: ================================================================ Master Create Charm ================================================================ A very experienced Garou can create a charm fetish to aid and protect himself or one of his friends. The charm will last for a short duration, or until the owner breaks it or logs off. The charm types are listed below. A player may only have one charm fetish at a time. This power is usable on the caster in both forms, but may only be bestowed upon another when the Garou is in man form. Bear - +40 STR Dragonfly - +40 DEX Moose - +40 CON Dolphin - +40 INT Raven - +40 WIS Owl - +20 INT, +20 WIS Monkey - +20 DEX, +20 INT Elephant - +20 WIS, +20 CON Wolf - +30 DEX, +10 STR Woad - +30% Magic Resist Usable in Form: Man only on others, all forms when self-targeted Lvl Required: 90 Cost: 300 sp Syntax: mcreate <type> [for <target>] Timer: Medium Type: Support

docs.title: Mend
docs.text: ================================================================ Mend ================================================================ Gaea's gift known as mend allows a worthy shaman to request additional healing from the winds themselves. While under the effect of this additional healing, one's wounds will mend themselves at random during combat. Usable in Form: Man Cost: Varied Restricted to: Shaman Syntax: mend [<person>]

docs.title: Luna whispers to you:
docs.text: Luna whispers to you: The Garou have long held my grace and drawn <POWER> from my light. With each of my three <VISAGES>, the power is changed but not diminished. An auspice is the combination of visage and <PHASE> which best suits the spirit of a Garou. It determines one's roles in Garou society and influences one's personality and tendencies. I can show you the auspice <PATTERN> if you wish. When you are ready, simply 'choose <visage> <phase>'.

docs.title: Luna raps:
docs.text: Luna raps: The wild Beo are often considered insane by other Garou. They embrace the path of chaos, breaking traditions, and acting as self-appointed tricksters. Though sometimes honorless and usually foolish, they bring laughter to our ofter too serious struggle.

docs.title: Luna chants:
docs.text: Luna chants: These moonless Garou are rarely in packs, but have still found a useful role in Garou society. Acting as scouts and explorers, the Cialls wandering the world searching for and alerting the packs to new dangers and challenges.

docs.title: Luna shouts:
docs.text: Luna shouts: The Curaid is a berserker. Savage and deeply feral, they live to fight and to kill. Death is not a fear for these wild warriors. For the Curaid, the fight for Gaia is waged through slashing teeth and the glory of blood.

docs.title: Luna giggles:
docs.text: Luna giggles: Dailos is the eternal maiden. Eager and mischievous, she is filled with an exuberance of life and boundless energy. Good or bad, her emotions have no bounds and range from vigorious mirth to selfish madness. Too free for many, her followers are the foolish <BEO>, the dissenting <SAOB>, the creative <DANSAIR>, and the savage <CURAID>.

docs.title: Luna purrs:
docs.text: Luna purrs: The Dansair are the artists, poets, and of course the dancers of the Garou. They have almost complete freedom in what they create, and create they do. Thought the Dansair embrace the chaotic Dailos, most still follow the tradition of honoring the past.

docs.title: Luna moans:
docs.text: Luna moans: Those of the dark wisdom are often the most reclusive of the Garou. Living in the remote forest, a Fasaich both hunts and sings alone. Rarely speaking out, their thoughts and path are a mystery to others. Though this deep solitute, a Fasaich sometimes forms the deepest bonds with earth and sky.

docs.title: Luna sings:
docs.text: Luna sings: The Fennid are the warriors and heros of the Garou. They protect the sacred forests and search out the foes of nature. Both solo adventurer and pack follower, a Fennid balances feral strength with the need for cunning.

docs.title: Luna roars:
docs.text: Luna roars: Glorious in its power, my full face shines with the valor and courage of the warrior. All Garou can feels its strength as all Garou are truly warriors. Through my three <VISAGES> follow the <CURAID> berserkers, the heroic <FENNID>, and the leading <MILIH>.

docs.title: A faint halo forms around Luna as she speaks:
docs.text: A faint halo forms around Luna as she speaks: Markas, the mother and closest to Gaia, is the favored moon of the Garou. Balancing will and honor, strength and thought, and lasting justice, her path promises both success and survival. The children of Markas are the scouting <CIALL>, the <TEGAIS> scholars, the crafting <ONSACH>, and the honorable <FENNID>.

docs.title: Luna announces:
docs.text: Luna announces: The Milih are the natural leaders of the Garou usually leading many but sometimes only themselves. While they often take the role of war chief, they just as often strive for the wisdom of peace. Fiercely protective of their people, a true Milih guides the way rather than dominates.

docs.title: Luna whispers:
docs.text: Luna whispers: Dark and silent, when my face is hidden it touches only the outcast of the Garou. For the trickster <BEO>, the searching <CIALL>, and the <FASAICH> hermit, the new moon is far more than a time of ill omen.

docs.title: Luna chants in a strong rhythm:
docs.text: Luna chants in a strong rhythm: The Onsach are the skilled crafters. From smiths and architects to jewlers and tanners, these honored Garou build for and supply the needs of the packs. They do so with a unique Garou style that both mimics and enhances the natural forms without damaging waste.

docs.title: Luna hmms softly and a pattern of knowledge fills your mind:
docs.text: Luna hmms softly and a pattern of knowledge fills your mind: Dailos(magenta) Markas(red) Tekal(green) (|()|) ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ *************** ================ New Beo(trickster) Ciall(seeker) Fasaich(hermit) Waning Saob(heretic) Tegais(teacher) Taliad(seer) Waxing Dansair(artist) Onsach(smith) Thoir(judge) Full Curaid(berserker) Fennid(hero) Milih(chief)

docs.title: Luna's musical voice fills your mind:
docs.text: Luna's musical voice fills your mind: There are four phases, dividing my <VISAGES> like the seasons. My glorius <FULL>, my celestial <WAXING>, my secretive <WANING>, and my hidden <NEW>. Each phase represents a life path, or role of the choosen Garou.

docs.title: Luna asserts:
docs.text: Luna asserts: Whether waxing or waning, your auspice will grant a boon for each visage. Masule for Dailos, Eurus for Tekal, and increased healing for Markas. Beyond this, when one's visage is matched by the choosen phase, the transformation from human comes without effort.

docs.title: Luna sings:
docs.text: Luna sings: The Saob are another wild lot. Seekers of new ways, gathers of knowledge and myth, they range from powerful mystics to rich city dwellers. Wanting to find their own answers, the Saob sometimes go beyond the natural ways and into darkness.

docs.title: Luna sings in a strong voice:
docs.text: Luna sings in a strong voice: Most of the great Garou shamans are Taliad. These Garou focus on the spiritual path of Gaia and strive to master all of the inner Eurus powers. By study of complex rituals and the constant pursuit of wisdom, the Taliad seek the highest form of Gaia's balance.

docs.title: Luna instructs:
docs.text: Luna instructs: A Tegais takes on the difficult and honered role of the teacher. From instructing young Garou in the ways to spreading new knowledge to the packs, the Tegais must be both scholar and guardian. For them, the waxing light of my visage must never fail.

docs.title: Luna murmurs:
docs.text: Luna murmurs: Tekas the crone is the moon of wisdom and final understanding. With a calmness Dailos could never attain, her light illuminates the pattern behind all things and all times. With this knowledge, her chosen <FASAICH>, learned <TALIAD>, remembering <THOIR>, and royal <MILIH>, find the resolve to embrace the Garou destiny. Luna continues: From this wisdom, the followers of Tekal can gain honor for their pack faster than others.

docs.title: Luna recounts:
docs.text: Luna recounts: The Thoir are both judges and historians for the Garou. They record the great events as they occur and remember the chronicles of the past. With their knowledge of Garou law and traditions, a thoir is well suited for counsel on disbutes and chief descisions.

docs.title: Luna glows and knowledge fills your eyes:
docs.text: Luna glows and knowledge fills your eyes: Each moon in the sky is one visage of my being. The magenta moon, <DAILOS>, is the maiden of my spirit. The red moon is <MARKAS> the mother, strong and just. Last is <TEKAL> the green crone, oldest and wisest. Each Garou can choose one moon to guide her path and destiny.

docs.title: Luna sings:
docs.text: Luna sings: My waning light is filled with deep knowledge and spiritual energy. It guides the way for the <TALIAD> seers, the instructing <TEGAIS>, and even the <SAOB> heretics. Though often the way to natural Eurus, it can also lead to other truths.

docs.title: Luna speaks:
docs.text: Luna speaks: To create, to form, to record. As my light waxes, new wonders are created and past events remembered. The Garou crafters, whether artistic <DANSAIR>, skilled <ONSACH>, or watching <THOIR> gain power from this most fertile light.

docs.title: Mother's Touch
docs.text: ================================================================ Mother's Touch ================================================================ Blessed by Gaea and beseeching her name, a Shaman can heal her wounds simply by laying her hands on the injured areas. Usable in Form: Man Cost: Varied Restricted to: Shaman Timer: Large Syntax: mtouch Type: Heal

docs.title: Stance: Normal
docs.text: ================================================================ Stance: Normal ================================================================ The normal stance is the default stance a Garou is in when not using any more specialized stances. In this stance, a Garou fights normally not increasing or decreasing any particular aspect of his attacking style. Usable in Form: Wolf Syntax: stance normal

docs.title: ***************************** GAROU GUILD UPDATE ****************************
docs.text: ***************************** GAROU GUILD UPDATE **************************** The new Garou guild code that has been in the works for nearly 5 months is now in the game. Many of you know little about what is changing, others might know a little but are lacking in details. This notice is here to clear that up. First and foremost, please read 'ghelp'. It's completely new. Read all of it. There are only 4 or so main parts to the new 'ghelp' and reading them will explain nearly everything about the guild. If something is unclear, ask a fellow Garou. If still unclear, ask James. Secondly, be aware that you can adjust your masule/eurus using the 'adjustgarou' command. NOTE: YOU ARE ONLY ALLOWED TO ADJUST 2 TIMES. ADDITIONAL NOTE: 'adjustgarou' isn't available to new members of the guild. The command exists solely to help old Garou transition to the new devotion structure. Lastly, please, please report via bug/idea or discuss directly with James anything that seems unusual or broken. This transition should happen without any real problems, but the possibility is still there nevertheless. Enjoy the changes. I've tried my best to make the new things bring fun rather than frustration to the guild. --James

docs.title: Stance: Offensive
docs.text: ================================================================ Stance: Offensive ================================================================ The offensive stance is known only by those Garou who have embraced Gaea's Strength above all else. This stance has no set duration and is completely free of cost and timers. The offensive stance provides an increase in hitting and damaging one's enemies while lower one's own defense in the process. Usable in Form: Wolf Restricted to: Warrior Syntax: stance offensive

docs.title: Garou Guild : Pack Commands
docs.text: ================================================================ Garou Guild : Pack Commands ================================================================ In addition to the combat abilities and spiritual powers listed in 'ghelp shaman', 'ghelp guardian', and 'ghelp warrior', Garou in packs have access to the following commands. [Usable by all members] pt - Talk on the pack line ept - Emote to the pack line pack - Shows all member of the pack pack on - Shows members and their location lone - Leave the pack [Usable by leader/keeper] adopt - Adopt a lone wolf into the pack drive - Drives a member from the pack [Usable only by leader] appoint - Appoint a member as Keeper/Shaman disbandpack - Disbands the pack

docs.title: Garou Guild : Pack Creation
docs.text: ================================================================ Garou Guild : Pack Creation ================================================================ To create a pack, you must be level 20 or higher. Additionally, the pack must be approved by the Garou Council. The Council is run by the current Garou pack leadership, with each pack getting one vote on the issue of new pack creation. The first step in creating a new pack is to submit a request using the the 'requestpack' command. As part of your request, you will have to enter a description of your pack's philosophy. Think carefully on this issue. This is the only place you get to enter your pack's philosophy. After the pack is approved and created, you cannot change its philosophy. Your only option would be to disband your pack and request/create a completely new one. Once a request has been completed, it is sent to the Council. The Council has 3 weeks to vote on the issue. At the end of the 3 weeks, the pack is automatically approved if it has not received 4 or more 'no' votes. If at any time during those 3 weeks it becomes impossible to get 4 'no' votes, the pack is automatically approved. For example, if there are only 4 packs and one has already voted 'yes', then it is impossible to get 4 'no' votes and the request would immediately be approved. Only packs which have atleast 2 members, one being a leader, keeper, or shaman, login within the past 45 days are eligible to vote. Ineligible packs can become eligible if enough members login before the deadline. Ineligible packs do not count as pending votes; thus if there are less than 4 active packs, any request for a new pack would automatically be approved since there would be no way to receive 4 eligible 'no' votes. The same holds true if there is simply less than 4 actual packs, active or not. Once a request has been approved or rejected, a mudmail confirmation of the decision is automatically sent to the prospective leader. If the pack is approved, the Garou will now be able to create his/her pack by using the 'createpack' command.

docs.title: Pack Talk
docs.text: ================================================================ Pack Talk ================================================================ Pack talk sends a message to all members of your pack currently on Darkwind. It is essentially the same as talking on a channel that only your pack can see. Usable in forms: All Syntax: pt <message> Cost: Free

docs.title: Quills of the Porcupine
docs.text: ================================================================ Quills of the Porcupine ================================================================ By focusing upon the spirit of the porcupine and concentrating upon the structure of its quills, a Garou is able to undergo a startling transformation. Her fur becomes elongated, bristly and sharp like the quills of a porcupine, inflicting aggravated damage on anyone that attempts to hit her. Usable in form: crinos and wolf Restricted to: Guardian Syntax: quills Cost: varied NOTE: This ability shows in the 'buffs' command. It can be ended early with 'clearbuff'. This ability cannot be used in conjunction with the skill "flames".

docs.title: Rage
docs.text: ================================================================ Rage ================================================================ Rage is one of the most potent combat abilities possessed by the Garou. Building up her inner anger, a Garou howls terribly at her foes, inspiring great fear in them and preventing them from taking action. It affects all monsters in the room with the Garou. Time of paralyzation is variable. Usable in Form: Wolf & Crinos Cost: 30% MAX SP Restricted to: Warrior and Guardian Lvl Required: 20 Timer: Huge GL Required: 7 (Warrior) Type: Stun 10 (Guardian) Syntax: rage

docs.title: Rejuvenate
docs.text: ================================================================ Rejuvenate ================================================================ Rejuvenate provides a shaman the ability to heal her fellow brethren, Garou and Druids. This ability only works in a party, but will heal a small amount of HP of all Garou and Druid members of said party. Usable in Form: Man Cost: 35 SP Restricted to: Shaman Syntax: rejuvenate

docs.title: Remember
docs.text: ================================================================ Remember ================================================================ Use remember when you wish to know the locations of the items you have currently buried. It will display a short description of the item and its location. You must go to the location to dig up the item. You can only remember 15 items at a time. To clear the list of items you have remembered, use forget. Syntax: remember

docs.title: Return
docs.text: ================================================================ Return ================================================================ Magical items are an affront to Gaea, as magic is an abomination and is unnatural. The shaman may return the power of a magic item to the earth mother, and receive her blessing in return. Only magical or exceptional items can be returned, and the reward is somewhat random. Usable in Form: Man, Crinos, & Wolf Syntax: return <target> Cost: Free

docs.title: Sanctify
docs.text: ================================================================ Sanctify ================================================================ By calling on the power of Sanctify, a shaman can return the spirit of a fallen foe to Gaea's embrace. Gaea will reward the shaman with spirit energy, which the shaman may keep or give to another in the same room. Garou in wolf form will receive extra energy from a sanctified corpse due to their close connection with Gaea. Usable in Form: All forms Syntax: sanctify [into <target>] Cost: 2 sp

docs.title: Scent
docs.text: ================================================================ Scent ================================================================ Scent allows you to determine the direction you need to travel to reach a particular foe. The range is short, so you must be near the target for it to be of any use. You must also know the name of the foe you are seeking. You cannot simply find the nearest enemy. The range increases slightly with higher levels. You can also 'scent guild' to find a path back to the Darkwind guild hall. The range is quite long when seeking out the guild hall, regardless of level. This form of scent can only be used while in the Darkwind mainland. Syntax: scent <target> Cost: 15 sp

docs.title: Sense
docs.text: ================================================================ Sense ================================================================ Sense allows you to detect the real player name of a particular player, which may be different from the name that is displayed. As this power cannot affect invisible people, it is only really useful to tell who a particular Garou in crinos or wolf form is. Syntax: sense <target> Cost: 10 sp Only Garou level 10 and over may use this power.

docs.text: ================================================================ Garou Guild Abilities : Shaman Path ================================================================ The various abilities granted to Gaea's shamans are listed below. docs.title: Slam
docs.text: ================================================================ Slam ================================================================ Slam strikes a foe with an incredibly powerful blow, sending the enemy flying into the next room. The blow is not intended to cause massive damage so much as pushing the enemy back, thus it causes minimal damage. Some monsters cannot be slammed. Syntax: slam <target> Cost: 20 sp This power is only usable by Garou of level 20 and higher.

docs.title: Garou Guild : Stance
docs.text: ================================================================ Garou Guild : Stance ================================================================ Stances are essentially combat forms that alter the way in which a Garou does battle in wolf form. A stance, for example, may increase the offensive nature of a wolf's attacks, while subsequently lowering his defensive ability. Some stances can be toggled on and off at will, while others last for only a set duration. The effectivness of all stances except for the heroic stance and legendary stance can be increased by fighting while in a party, and even more so if fighting in a party consisting solely of fellow pack members. This is something all wolves should keep in mind when going out to hunt. Even the normal stance is affected by partying. For a list of stances check out the ability list for each of the dedication forms -- 'ghelp shaman', 'ghelp guardian', 'ghelp warrior'. For more information on a given stance check out 'ghelp <stance>'.

docs.title: Garou Guild
docs.text: ================================================================ Garou Guild ================================================================ The Garou guild is both complex and rewarding. Garou experience Darkwind in a way that other players do not, and understanding what it truly means to be a Garou can be a challenge. Those who are new to Gaea's pack should read through 'ghelp basics', 'ghelp dedication', and 'ghelp general'. Those documents will point out where to find further information if such is needed. Lastly, always remember the new life that Gaea has given you and be proud of your dedication to her cause.

docs.title: Summon Wolves
docs.text: ================================================================ Summon Wolves ================================================================ Summon Wolves is used to summon assistance for combat situations. You will always summon a single wolf, but its strength will be increased as the garou gains experience. The wolves will remain with you regardless of form, and are immune to rage. Any experience gained from hits by the wolves is lost to you. Usable in form: All Syntax: summon wolves Cost:35 sp

docs.title: Talons of the Eagle
docs.text: ================================================================ Talons of the Eagle ================================================================ By focusing on the spirit of the eagle, a Garou may gain the knowledge to sharpen his claws to a deadly razor sharp edge. By using the item at the Garou's disposal, he will inflict additional damage on any foe that attacks him. Usable in form: crinos and wolf only Restricted to: Warrior Syntax: talons Cost: varied NOTE: This ability shows in the 'buffs' command. It can be ended early with 'clearbuff'. Also, talons cannot be used in conjuction with the skill fangs.

docs.title: Tether the Umbra
docs.text: ================================================================ Tether the Umbra ================================================================ By focusing on the Umbra and the spirits within, a Warrior can make a spiritual tether connecting them to the Umbral power. Usable in Form: Man, Crinos & Wolf Syntax: tether Cost: 200 sp

docs.title: Tradeoff
docs.text: ================================================================ Tradeoff ================================================================ One of the most powerful shaman abilities, Tradeoff allows a shaman to become one with the Spirit. While in this state, a shaman will randomly absorb enemy attacks during combat, sacrificing SP in place of HP damage. Usable in Form: Man Cost: 85 SP Restricted to: Shaman Syntax: tradeoff

docs.title: Transfer
docs.text: ================================================================ Transfer ================================================================ Using Transfer, a skilled shaman can channel her energy through the will of nature and energize her fellow Garou, healing their SP. The Rite of Transfer, however, is slightly taxing and thus a small amount of spirit energy is lost during the transfer. Usable in Form: Man Cost: 40 SP Restricted to: Shaman SP Transfered: 30 SP Syntax: transfer <person>

docs.title: Transform
docs.text: ================================================================ Transform ================================================================ Transform is one of the most important commands for a Garou, as it allows you to shift between the physically powerful wolf, the hulking crinos, and the spiritual man. The cost in spiritual energy is quite high for most transformations, save for when your auspice is matched by the moons of the night sky. See the help files on each form for more information on their powers. Syntax: transform <form> Cost: Variable

docs.title: Umbral Key
docs.text: ================================================================ Umbral Key ================================================================ Using her plentiful spiritual knowledge, a Garou may step into and out of the Umbra at will, without need of a reflective surface. The Garou simply wills herself to step sideways and into the Penumbra. Once there, she needs to merely step in any direction she wishes. Usable in form: man only Restricted to: Shaman Syntax: ukey Cost: varied

docs.title: Umbral Step
docs.text: ================================================================ Umbral Step ================================================================ Using his plentiful spiritual knowledge, a Guardian may piece the veil of the Umbra, slip through the Penumbra, and be returned to the guild hall. Usable in form: man and crinos Restricted to: Guardian Syntax: ustep Cost: 100 sp

docs.title: Vision
docs.text: ================================================================ Vision ================================================================ The power to invoke a spiritual vision is only granted to the upper echelon of shamans, those who have proved their dedication to Gaia. The vision through the spirit world can be very confusing, but also very powerful. The shaman has three options for the focus of his vision. He may choose 'narrow' and see all items and rooms nearby. He may choose 'wide' and get general information on various players around the world. He may also choose a specific player, and get a vision of that player's location and some of her equipment. Usable in Form: Man Only Syntax: vision wide, vision narrow, or vision <target> Cost: 75 sp

docs.title: Wind
docs.text: ================================================================ Wind ================================================================ The Wind spirits will assist a shaman learned enough to command their power. They will either blow loose objects out of a room, or distract an opponent, allowing the Garou to better combat him. A shaman cannot summon the wind spirits in the midst of combat. Usable in Form: Man, Crinos & Wolf Syntax: wind <target> or wind <direction> Cost: 20 sp

docs.title: Ritual of Winter
docs.text: ================================================================ Ritual of Winter ================================================================ The Ritual of Winter allows a shaman to ease the loss of dying. The ritual will attempt to preserve the dead character's old stats. The ritual must be begun on a ghost, and will bring the character back to life. If the character prays during the ritual, the effort will be wasted. As the shaman is tapping into the strength of Gaea, the more powerful the shaman, the better the chance of regaining stats will be. Leaders and Keepers are also better attuned to Gaea's Will than the normal pup, but Shamans have an even better ability. Usable in Form: Man only Syntax: winter <target> Cost: 300 sp

docs.title: Luna's Armour
docs.text: ================================================================ Luna's Armour ================================================================ Luna's Armour is a ritual that grants the garou protection from harm. The blessing conferred is short-term, but is useful in any form the Garou may adopt. The effectiveness of the ritual may be affected by the Garou's relationship with the aspects of Luna and the current configuration of the moons. Usable in Form: All Syntax: luna, gluna, or wluna [on] Cost: Varied

docs.title: Wolflong
docs.text: ================================================================ Wolflong ================================================================ Wolflong allows you to set the long description of your wolf form. This is what players see when they 'look' at you. Please make custom descriptions consistent with the wolf form. Inappropriate descriptions will be removed. Syntax: wolflong <description>

docs.title: wolfsong
docs.text: ================================================================ wolfsong ================================================================ The wolfsong links the Garou together, allowing leaders to communicate with new wolves, and those who wish to socialize to do so rather than fight. You should not attempt to communicate with a wizard through this channel if it is an important matter, rather use tell. Syntax: ws <message>, ews <message>

docs.title: LCHEST

docs.title: LIFT

docs.title: Lunar Magi are the mages with the widest array of knowledge available
docs.text: Lunar Magi are the mages with the widest array of knowledge available to them. They draw their power from the Moons, each moon has a differant effect and each moon will give the caster certain spells for them to cast. For more info about the Moons and their powers, <lmhelp moons>. Lunar Magi must remain disciplined at all times. If a Lunar Mage should become chaotic, that Mage will lose all ability to cast spells. As you may realize, it is to your advantage to have spells available to you. Remember to maintain a positive ethics score. If you would like to know whether you are lawful or not, type <statme>. Lunar Magi have a wide variety of spells that they may draw upon, each one having a disctinct flavor and power. For a quick list of spells and the Guild Level (gl) needed to cast them, see <lmhelp spells>. For a full description, type <lmhelp> followed by the spell's name. To report a spell idea to Duuktsaryth, use <lmspell> plus the idea. However, only ideas that are in theme will be added. Lunar Magi have several unique emotions to represent the effects of having a reputation as a lesser magical guild. For a full list of emotions, enter <lmhelp emotes>. To contribute an idea to Duuktsaryth, enter <lmemote> followed by the emote. Spells fail. Even the greatest of Mages can get unlucky. One of the unique aspects of this guild is spell failure. Once a spell fails, you will recieve a report of exactly what effect, if any, your spell has had. To report an idea for a new failure message, please use <lmfail> plus the idea. Communicating with fellow guild members is a very easy process. To say something to all Lunar Magi, type <lm> plus a message. To emote over that line, use <elm> plus a message. Example: <lm Hi!> [Lunar] Duuktsaryth: Hi! <elm says Hi!> [Lunar] Duuktsaryth says Hi! Also, in order to help you to know who your compatriots are in the world, at any time you may type <lms> for a list of all Lunar Magi active in the world. This will display their names, levels, guild level, and motto. In addition, upon reachin Guild Level 15 (Master Status), you will gain access to the Guild Master chat line. This line can be used in th esame manner, except using the commands <hilm> and <ehilm>. The final command you must be aware of it <lmbug>. This command will report to Duuktsaryth any erros you may find in the Guild. Please make use of this command if you feel that there is a problem withe the guild code. Remember that not all bugs produce a 'sensitive mind' message, they may just be a typo that Duuk overlooked. Enjoy your Guild. 15-December-1995 Duuktsaryth

docs.text: LUNACY By focusing the rays of the green moon onto a target, the caster forces them to be overcome with an effect easily recognized by Lunar Magi, lunacy. The affected target will be overcome by emotions that he or she cannot contain. GL: 8 COST: 50

docs.title: BEAM
docs.text: BEAM By means of this spell, the caster focuses a beam of moonlight to burn a target horribly. The beam will focus in a huge burst of light from the finger tips of the caster. GL: 2 COST: GL*5

docs.title: MOONLIGHT FORCE FOCUS
docs.text: MOONLIGHT FORCE FOCUS Using this spell, the lunar mage can call on the ultimate power of the Blood Moon, to devastating effect. He can unleash the energy as an explosive burst of crushing force on the general vicinity with the command 'mfocus', or he can use the force to crush two chosen targets together with the power of gravity, using 'mfocus <target> and <target2>'. This second use is more deadly due to the greater concentration of force, and also takes less time to recover from, due to the narrower range of effect. GL: 15 COST: 200

docs.title: MLIGHT
docs.text: MLIGHT By means of this spell, the user will temporarily cause his/her face to glow with a lunar light. This will brighten the room temporarily. GL: 3 COST: 10

docs.title: MISTS OF THE MOONS
docs.text: MISTS OF THE MOONS By means of this spell, the caster causes pillars of mist, illuminated by moonlight, to rise out of the ground. The shadows the moonlight casts make the images resemble the mage, increasing his chance to dodge enemy attacks! The images will slowly vanish over time, reducing the bonus; when the last image is gone, the spell is ended. GL: 6 COST: 10+(GL*4)

docs.title: MOONBLADE
docs.text: MOONBLADE Available to all Lunar magi are the mystical MoonBlades in the Lunar forge below the Guild. The smithy Clifnord forges them of mithril and magic to the Lunar magi's exact specifications. They may only be used while Lunar powers are active, but will never restrict Lunar powers. All other guild restrictions apply. Clifnord demands a modest charge for the use of the MoonBlades, but also gives partial recompensation to the Lunar who returns a Blade to him in working order. COST: Monetary -- Varies. GL: Any.

docs.title: METEOR SWARM
docs.text: METEOR SWARM Meteor swarm is really a combination of two attacks in one. The caster may simply call down a meteor swarm, attacking all npcs in a room ('mswarm'), or it can be targeted against a specific foe ('mswarm <target>'). It is a truly deadly spell. GL: 10 COST: 100

docs.title: Barrage prepares one combat working to cast automatically beside ordinary
docs.text: Barrage prepares one combat working to cast automatically beside ordinary attacks. Mana Shard, Missile, Fireball, Icestorm, and Bolt are eligible. Without a FOCUS weapon, the page must be Practiced and each automatic cast spends SP. With FOCUS, even a Copied page can be prepared and fires for zero SP. AURA completes battlemage resonance and improves cadence and power. Mastery and Falx can quicken the rhythm, but two combat rounds is the ordinary floor. At Arcane 16, a real wielded FOCUS opens a more severe exchange. The prepared page fires every combat round and produces multiple complete barrages. Their count is based on the FOCUS weapon's WC and item level, not the Mage's ordinary number of swings: barrages = 1 + floor((10 * WC + item level) / 100), from 2 to 6 The same weave removes weapon swings according to player level: one below 50, two at 50, three at 100, four at 150, five at 200, and six at 250 or above. Investiture's borrowed FOCUS cannot enable this exchange. Releasing the prepared barrage removes the penalty. Concentration pauses cadence without erasing the page. Silence or paralysis collapses it. Automatic casts still teach mastery and can earn rate-limited field GXP. Use "barrage <working>", "barrage off", and "battlemage".

docs.title: Battlemage resonance joins ordinary weapon attacks to a prepared barrage.
docs.text: Battlemage resonance joins ordinary weapon attacks to a prepared barrage. A wielded FOCUS may prepare a known barrage page even while it is still Copied, and pays zero SP for its automatic casts. A worn AURA adds another cadence and power improvement. Wearing both completes resonance. Investiture may supply one missing half temporarily, but cannot create both halves by itself. Mana Shard, Missile, Fireball, Icestorm, and Bolt can become barrages. Without FOCUS they require Practiced mastery and spend SP. Their cadence improves with mastery and Falx but ordinarily never becomes faster than once every two combat rounds. Concentration pauses the prepared page; silence and paralysis collapse it. Beyond Arcane 15, a real wielded FOCUS changes the bargain. Barrage fires every round and produces two to six complete barrages according to the weapon's WC and item level. It does not copy the Mage's weapon-swing count. Instead, the Mage gives up one swing below player level 50, then another at each 50-level threshold, to a maximum of six at level 250. Investiture does not qualify. The visual battlemage display condenses the FOCUS weapon's combined WC and item level rating into a short Weave Power bar and shows how much remains before the next barrage. Screen-reader output gives the same progress numerically. Use "barrage <working>" to prepare a page, "barrage off" to release it, and "battlemage" for the live FOCUS, AURA, cadence, SP, Overchannel, Grand Revision, multibarrage exchange, and Recollection readout.

docs.title: The Mage Guild defines several unique emotes for the enjoyment of its
docs.text: The Mage Guild defines several unique emotes for the enjoyment of its members. Some of these allow you to do standard emotions in a different way than other players, while others are mage guild originals that no other players have. You are always free to post your ideas for new emotes on the guild bulletin board and they might get put into the game. Bow You bow with a flourish. Can be done at a person and afar. Chin You stroke your chin thoughtfully. Curtsey You curtsey with a flourish. Same as bow. Eureka! You get an idea! Fumble You botch a spell and are enveloped in an explosion. No SP used and no damage is done. Fumble is purely for fun. Other people will see you coughing and brushing off your robes. Fumble is a color emote. Glow You glow with magical energy. Glow is a color emote. Grin You grin disarmingly. Can be done at a person and afar. Gronk Just a fun emote. Meaningless, but fun nonetheless. Know You are very knowledgeable. If 'know <subject>' is typed then you will be very knowledgeable about <subject>. Motion Motion to someone that they will shortly be receiving some goodies from you. This is best used with gate or the Darkwind UPS service. Mthink Requires input. You think about . o O ( what you input ) Think is a color emote. Nimbus You wave your hands, and then you're surrounded by a glowing nimbus of energy. Nimbus is a color emote. Nod You nod understandingly. Can be done at a person and afar. Spark Give someone a really big jolt in the butt! Tag Sneak up behind someone and tag them IT! Tuna Slap someone in the face with a big, slimy, wet tuna. Whatever Let someone (or the room you're in) know that you don't believe them.

docs.title: Peering into the Dark Wind, Magi learn to notice the patterns beneath ordinary
docs.text: Peering into the Dark Wind, Magi learn to notice the patterns beneath ordinary things. Heat has a shape. Distance can be folded. Memory leaves an untouched copy of itself somewhere behind the mind. Even death and a stolen moment of time can be written down, studied, and changed. A Mage keeps those discoveries in a leather-bound spellbook and tests them where theory becomes real. The first pages are deliberately practical. Mana Shard and Missile are reliable attacks, while Analyze, Detect, and Blaze give a new Mage useful ways to examine and move through the world. Fighting level-appropriate enemies supplies Mage guild XP, called GXP. Useful field casting awards 10 GXP for a utility working or 20 for a combat working, at most once per working every thirty seconds. As that study raises Arcane rank, the spellbook reveals more ambitious workings. Each working also remembers how often it has mattered. It begins Copied, then becomes Practiced, Fluent, Inscribed, and finally Instinctive. Practice lowers spell costs and opens rune sockets. Combat workings can become automatic barrages at Practiced mastery, firing from the spellbook alongside ordinary attacks while the Mage remains free to cast something else. A FOCUS weapon turns that technique into the battlemage style. While one is wielded, even a freshly Copied barrage working can fire automatically for no SP. Wearing AURA equipment at the same time deepens the resonance, making those casts faster and stronger. The same equipment also helps shorten Recollection, the Arcane 3 working that restores every missing spell point after a brief, vulnerable weave. Investiture opens at Arcane 4 and borrows either half of that resonance for a time. It can write FOCUS over an ordinary wielded weapon or surround the Mage with a temporary AURA. Only one Investiture can be sustained, so it can complete a real piece of battlemage equipment but cannot replace both. Runes let two Magi take the same page in different directions. Seven patterns arrive through ordinary Arcane study; the rest are earned through mastery, elemental practice, and discoveries on the ruined Isle of the Magi. The oldest pages there still carry the names Arcanarton and Bodach, while Trivlian's green grimoire waits in the Darkwind attic. Open with "research" to see where your Arcane stands, "spellbook" to follow mastery and rune bindings, and "battlemage" to inspect equipment resonance. "spells" gives the full working index, while "magehelp" returns to this guide.

docs.title: Magi peer into the Dark Wind to understand and alter the hidden fabric of the
docs.text: Magi peer into the Dark Wind to understand and alter the hidden fabric of the world. Your spellbook records that understanding as workings, mastery, runes, and notes gathered in the field. New pages begin with dependable magic and grow toward fire, frost, distance, memory, forbidden death-work, and moments that do not pass until you permit them. Magi call the art as a whole gramarye and a single spell a working. A working may be as slight as a cantrip, as patient as a charm, or as cruel as a malison; the word describes magic made real, not merely the words used to cast it. Arcane is the guild's rank and rises through Mage GXP. Level-appropriate combat and useful field casting both advance it. A useful utility working awards 10 GXP, while a useful combat working awards 20, at most once per working every thirty seconds. A working has its own history as well. Fifty useful casts make it Practiced, one hundred fifty Fluent, two hundred fifty Inscribed, and one thousand Instinctive. Practiced workings gain a rune socket and eligible combat workings can be prepared with "barrage". Inscribed pages gain a second socket, while deeper mastery steadily improves efficiency and barrage speed. Battlemagi wield FOCUS weapons. The weapon channels a known barrage working beside normal attacks even while that working is still Copied, and those automatic casts cost no SP. A worn piece of AURA equipment completes the resonance, adding speed and power. Automatic casts still improve their page and can earn rate-limited field GXP. "battlemage" shows the exact cadence, cost, equipment state, and current Recollection timer. Ordinary barrage cadence has a floor of two combat rounds. Fireball barrage leaves a light Burning effect, Icestorm barrage reaches nearby hostile targets and Chills them, and Missile lands as a visible two-missile volley rather than every page using the same impact. At Arcane 16, preparing a barrage with a real wielded FOCUS trades weapon swings for a barrage every round. The penalty is one swing below player level 50 and rises by one each fifty levels, reaching six at level 250. Each round produces two to six complete barrages based on the FOCUS weapon's WC and item level, not on the Mage's remaining swing count. Investiture cannot enable it. The battlemage display reduces that combined weapon rating to a short Weave Power bar, with numeric progress in screen-reader output. The battlemage style also permits practical shields. Magi may use small and medium shields of any composition, plus the lightweight wood-and-natural fighter shield. Large conventional shields and tower shields remain too restrictive for working magic. At Arcane 8, "overchannel" can press five percent of maximum SP into each manual damaging working. Arcane 16 opens ten percent and Arcane 32 opens twenty percent. Arcane 500 opens twenty-five percent and Arcane 1000 opens thirty percent. This added cost is not reduced by mastery or Mezari; it becomes additional spell power and gives deep reserves a deliberate combat use. The exchange gains another half point of damage per SP for each whole cube-root step of true Arcane, in addition to effective-rank scaling. Overchannel lasts for the current play session and never modifies barrage or automatic echoes. Traditional spell and guild-level unlocks end at Arcane 15, but Arcane study itself continues to rank 1000 on a sharply rising cost curve. Ordinary spell scaling gains only the square root of ranks beyond 32, giving prestige severe diminishing returns. Marginalia measures that long study cumulatively. While any cooldown is active, the spellbook has a rare heartbeat chance to revise every cooldown away at once. This rises from 1 in 10,000 to 25 in 10,000 at Arcane 500 and 100 in 10,000 at Arcane 1000. "mageaura" selects purely cosmetic prestige effects earned along the way. Arcane study also cuts through magical resistance, using the same heavily diminished effective rank after Arcane 32. At Arcane 4, Investiture can temporarily supply one missing half of that resonance. "investiture focus" lends FOCUS to an ordinary wielded weapon; "investiture aura" writes an AURA around the Mage. Only one may be sustained at a time, which makes the working a bridge into battlemage equipment rather than a permanent substitute for it. Recollection appears at Arcane 3.
