It restores all missing SP after a four-second weave, costs ten percent of maximum health, and cannot settle during combat. Its private timer begins at ten minutes. Recollection mastery can remove as much as four minutes, while FOCUS and AURA each remove another minute; the timer never falls below five minutes. Ashkenazy, Falx, Saloman, Talek, James, Rodney, and Aiken are taught through Arcane study. Rodney opens at Arcane 7, can only be placed on a buff or control working with a real duration, and extends it by twenty-five percent through two minutes, thirty-five percent over two minutes, or fifty percent over five minutes. It can lengthen concentration blocks, Freezing, and Bodach Powerup, but not Burning. Falx shortens a bound working's manual cooldown by twenty percent as well as quickening its barrage cadence. Marsellus, Mezari, and Ravidel reveal themselves when the spellbook records the right feats of mastery or elemental practice, but each still has the Arcane threshold shown by "runes". Elemental and forbidden damage runes add ten percent apiece to the working's primary hit and merge their damage types into it. Mezari lowers the inscribed working's SP cost by ten percent. Saloman's damaging return is capped at one quarter of a manual working's discounted ordinary cost; utility workings return ten percent of discounted base cost. Free barrage impacts cannot generate SP. At Arcane 9, the broken Tower of Arcanarton on the old Isle of the Magi begins a more dangerous line of research into the Arcanarton and Bodach runes. Once either pattern is known, a green-spined grimoire in the Darkwind Mage attic can reveal Trivlian's evil-and-acid rune. James's Whimsy rune gives Mage Eye and Teleport harmlessly ridiculous manifestations. Aiken opens at Arcane 8 and can only be bound to damaging workings. It halves normal armor absorption without bypassing elemental resistance, intrinsic reduction, shields, or Mana Barrier. Fireball lands lightly and writes most of its harm into the flames that follow. Burning may stack to fifty times an NPC's level. Against players it remains capped at the target's level. Mana Barrier opens at Arcane 7. While active, each damaging hit has a chance to spend SP in place of HP after ordinary defenses. Its chance improves with true Arcane rank, while mastery makes the conversion more efficient. "battlemage" reports the exact current values. Concentration blocks pause a prepared barrage without discarding it; the same cadence resumes when the block lifts. A manual Bolt is independent of the prepared barrage and scales as a dedicated lightning strike. Bodach changes Powerup into a guarded fifteen-pulse HP-to-SP buff. Touch uses a fourteen-second base cooldown. Its final page has unusually deep margins; forbidden runes can make the working answer to older names, and paired inscriptions do not always settle for the name either rune would choose alone. Some such workings refuse to end when the hand draws back. Useful commands include: research / mstudy Arcane GXP and the next open page spells [working] working index and Arcane thresholds spellbook [working] mastery, rune sockets, and prepared barrage barrage <working|off> prepare automatic combat casting overchannel [off|5|10|20|25|30] spend maximum SP for added spell power mageaura [style|off] select a cosmetic prestige aura battlemage inspect FOCUS and AURA resonance runes [rune] known patterns and clues for sealed runes inscribe / unbind change a working's rune bindings marginalia [style] choose an Arcane 15 casting flourish showoff spend 3 SP on a prismatic armor flourish mage <message> speak on the guild channel magi list visible Magi Individual guide pages include: magehelp spells working progression and combat relationships magehelp mastery practice thresholds and socket progression magehelp runes every rune and its compatible kinds of working magehelp barrage automatic casting rules magehelp battlemage FOCUS, AURA, and resonance magehelp overchannel extra-SP settings and scaling magehelp marginalia long-study cosmetic writing hands magehelp emotes guild emotes Use "help <command>" when you want the exact syntax of one ability. Both "help tport" and "help teleport" open the travel working. Its fixed destinations accept dw, hyper, souv, and vi as common shorthand.

docs.title: Marginalia is the cosmetic hand surrounding completed workings after Arcane 15.
docs.text: Marginalia is the cosmetic hand surrounding completed workings after Arcane 15. It does not change damage, cost, timing, permissions, or rune behavior. Continued study opens: Unadorned immediately Silverline 5,000 long-study GXP Ember Script 15,000 long-study GXP Aurora Hand 35,000 long-study GXP Void Palimpsest 75,000 long-study GXP Use "marginalia" to review the illuminated index and "marginalia <style>" to select an open hand.

docs.title: Every useful working keeps its own practice history.
docs.text: Every useful working keeps its own practice history. Copied 0 casts ordinary casting Practiced 50 casts first rune socket; barrage access if eligible Fluent 150 casts better efficiency and quicker barrage Inscribed 250 casts second rune socket; better efficiency Instinctive 1000 casts best ordinary efficiency and barrage cadence A useful cast normally adds one point. Repeating the same page faster than the spellbook can settle it, or attacking something far below your level, does not teach the working. Delayed workings count when they resolve successfully, not when their geometry first opens. Use "spellbook" for every known page, "spellbook <working>" for one page, and "runes" for the patterns that can occupy its sockets.

docs.title: Peering into the Dark Wind, Magi study the patterns beneath matter, memory,
docs.text: Peering into the Dark Wind, Magi study the patterns beneath matter, memory, light, distance, heat, death, and spellwork itself. They keep those patterns in leather-bound spellbooks and carry them into the field, where a good idea can become a fireball, a hidden path, a stolen moment, or a way home. Mage is a broad spellcasting guild with a gentle first page and considerable room to grow. Mana Shard and Missile give a new member dependable attacks; Analyze, Detect, and Blaze make the same character useful while exploring. Fighting suitable enemies earns Mage GXP, and useful field magic awards 10 GXP for a utility working or 20 for a combat working, at most once per working every thirty seconds. That GXP raises Arcane through fifteen ranks and reveals new workings along the way. The spellbook grows through use as well as rank. Individual workings become Practiced, Fluent, Inscribed, and Instinctive, opening lower costs, rune sockets, and automatic barrage casting. A Mage can prepare a Practiced combat working to fire alongside ordinary attacks. Wielding a FOCUS weapon opens that style immediately and channels the automatic spell for no SP; adding worn AURA equipment creates full battlemage resonance, improving its speed and force. Investiture, learned at Arcane 4, can temporarily supply either quality but not both at once. Runes change the character of a familiar working. Some are part of ordinary study, while others appear only after the spellbook has witnessed enough mastery, fire, or stranger discoveries. The deepest trail returns to the ruined Isle of the Magi, where the broken Tower of Arcanarton still remembers the war that separated Mage and Necromancer lore. GXP continues to matter after the fifteenth Arcane rank. Long study opens new styles of marginalia, giving completed workings a visible signature without turning those flourishes into another compulsory source of power. Prospective Magi need at least 6 Intelligence. Speak with Merlin here to join; afterward, open the new spellbook with "spellbook" and let "research" point toward the next page.

docs.title: Overchannel commits extra maximum SP to each manual damaging working.
docs.text: Overchannel commits extra maximum SP to each manual damaging working. Arcane 8 5 percent Arcane 16 10 percent Arcane 32 20 percent Arcane 500 25 percent Arcane 1000 30 percent Use "overchannel <percent>" to select an open setting and "overchannel off" to release it. The added SP is not discounted by mastery or Mezari. It becomes additional spell power using effective Arcane and a smaller true-Arcane prestige term. Overchannel lasts for the current play session. It does not affect utility workings, automatic barrage, or Echoform. A resisted or interrupted working still spends the power committed to the attempt.

docs.title: Runes personalize a Practiced working. Practiced mastery opens one socket and
docs.text: Runes personalize a Practiced working. Practiced mastery opens one socket and Inscribed mastery opens a second. Use "inscribe <rune> on <working>" to bind a known pattern and "unbind <rune> from <working>" to lift it without losing mastery. "Runes <rune>" lists every working that pattern can actually change; an incompatible rune cannot consume a socket. Ashkenazy -- Exaltation Damaging workings only. Raises their raw power by fifteen percent. Falx -- Alacrity Every working. Shortens its manual cooldown by twenty percent and may also quicken a compatible prepared barrage, subject to the ordinary two-round floor. Saloman -- Bastion Every SP-costing working. Damaging workings return a small amount based on damage, capped at one quarter of discounted ordinary cost. Utility workings return ten percent of discounted base cost. Recollection has no SP cost and cannot use Saloman. Automatic barrage does not generate a return. Talek -- Boreal Damaging workings only. Adds ten percent and cold to the primary hit, plus Chilled. James -- Whimsy Every working. Adds harmlessly unnecessary casting punctuation; Mage Eye and Teleport also gain their own ridiculous manifestations. Marsellus -- Augmentation Damaging workings only. Adds a little raw power and a chance for a second force impact. Mezari -- Amity Every SP-costing working. Lowers ordinary SP cost by ten percent. Recollection has no SP cost and cannot use Mezari. Ravidel -- Igneous Damaging workings only. Adds ten percent and fire to the primary hit, plus Burning. Rodney -- Continuance Duration-bearing buffs and controls only: Echoform, Illuminate, Insane, Investiture, Invisibility, Levitate, Mana Barrier, Phase, Powerup, Armor, Stasis, and Wrath. Extends durations through two minutes by twenty-five percent, durations over two minutes by thirty-five percent, and durations over five minutes by fifty percent. Aiken -- Severance Damaging workings only. Halves normal armor absorption without bypassing resistance, intrinsic reduction, shields, or Mana Barrier. Arcanarton -- Entropy Damaging workings, plus Insane. Adds ten percent, chaos, and disease to the primary hit; Insane gains its forbidden variation. Bodach -- Demise Damaging workings, plus Insane and Powerup. Adds ten percent and death to the primary hit, plus a small life return. It changes Insane's malison and turns Powerup into a guarded, pulsing HP-to-SP conversion. Trivlian -- Putrefaction Damaging workings only. Converts their native damage to evil and acid while preserving other rune damage types merged into the hit. Ordinary Arcane study teaches some patterns. Others require mastery, repeated fire practice, or discoveries on the old Isle of the Magi. Use "runes" for your current concordance and the exact clue attached to each sealed pattern.

docs.title: The Mage spellbook begins with simple, dependable ideas and becomes stranger as
docs.text: The Mage spellbook begins with simple, dependable ideas and becomes stranger as Arcane rises. Mana Shard and Missile carry the early fighting load. Analyze and Detect reward curiosity, while Blaze turns an ordinary exit into a thoroughly immodest departure. Recollection arrives early enough to shape a young Mage's adventuring rhythm, and the later pages introduce delayed workings, shared status effects, travel, forbidden research, and finishers built for a group. Detect reveals verbs registered by the current room. Authored magical clues can expand a verb into exact syntax when the action needs an argument. Workings appear at these Arcane ranks: Arcane 1 Analyze, Blaze, Detect, Mana Shard, Missile Arcane 2 Find, Illuminate Arcane 3 Fireball, Recollection; Ashkenazy and Falx runes Arcane 4 Icestorm, Insane, Investiture; Saloman and Talek runes Arcane 5 Teleport; James rune Arcane 6 Armor, Echoform, Mage Eye Arcane 7 Bolt, Mana Barrier; Rodney rune Arcane 8 Levitate, Stasis; Aiken rune Arcane 9 Invisibility, Mage Unlock, Necrosis Arcane 10 Phase Arcane 11 Gate, Glassstorm Arcane 12 Inferno Arcane 13 Powerup Arcane 14 Wrath Arcane 15 Singularity, Touch, Grand Mage channel, marginalia Fireball lands lightly but kindles deep flames; most of its harm arrives as Burning rather than in the first impact. Inferno also leaves its victims Burning. Icestorm chills a room, while Statis closes a delayed frost equation around one target and applies Freezing. Glassstorm waits in the air before shattering across nearby enemies and leaving them Exposed. Singularity is the natural conclusion: it consumes hostile statuses from the room and gains fifteen percent damage from each condition, up to seventy-five percent. Echoform approaches the same problem differently, copying the next direct attack for a smaller strike two seconds later. Necrosis begins with a blackleaf impact and leaves a short heartbeat-driven disease behind to keep damaging the target. Area workings gain some total force as more hostile patterns enter their geometry, up to twice their one-target total, and still divide that total among their targets. Sometimes a working finds a perfect line through its target and critically converges, striking with half again its usual force before ordinary defenses blunt it. Equipment and an Exposed enemy can make that moment more likely. Every missile and every separate barrage seeks its own line, as does the working against each enemy caught in its area. Overchannel opens at Arcane 8. "overchannel 5" spends five percent of maximum SP in addition to the normal cost of each manual damaging working. Arcane 16 opens ten percent and Arcane 32 opens twenty percent. Mastery and Mezari do not discount the added amount. Use "overchannel off" to return to ordinary casting. Arcane 500 opens twenty-five percent and Arcane 1000 opens thirty percent. Spell unlocks end at Arcane 15, but prestige study continues to rank 1000 with sharply increasing costs and square-root spell scaling beyond rank 32. Overchannel's added damage also gains half the integer cube root of true Arcane as an additional damage-per-SP multiplier, so deep ranks make the exchange more worthwhile. While any cooldown is active, each heartbeat has a rare chance to revise all cooldowns away: 1 in 10,000 at low ranks, 25 in 10,000 at Arcane 500, and 100 in 10,000 at Arcane 1000. "mageaura" lists cosmetic prestige auras. Recollection restores every missing SP after a four-second weave. It costs ten percent of maximum health and uses a private ten-minute timer, so it does not occupy ordinary support recovery. Practice shortens that timer; FOCUS and AURA equipment shorten it further, down to a five-minute floor. Investiture temporarily borrows one battlemage equipment quality. It can lend FOCUS to a currently wielded non-FOCUS weapon or write an AURA around the Mage. The two modes share one effect, so Investiture can complete equipment the Mage already owns but cannot create full resonance by itself. Mana Shard, Missile, Fireball, Icestorm, and Bolt have barrage forms. They can be prepared once Practiced and will then cast lighter versions of themselves beside ordinary attacks. A wielded FOCUS can prepare a known working while it is still Copied and pays the automatic cast's SP cost itself. Wearing AURA at the same time completes battlemage resonance, improving cadence and damage. These automatic casts continue to teach the spellbook. Missile lands as a visible two-bolt volley, Fireball leaves a light Burning effect, Icestorm divides its damage among nearby hostile targets and Chills them, and Bolt emphasizes one heavier impact. A manually cast Bolt is now a standalone lightning working with stronger scaling and does not depend on the prepared barrage. A concentration block pauses barrage cadence without erasing the prepared page; the cadence resumes where it left off when concentration returns. Silence and paralysis still collapse it. An ordinary barrage cannot fire more often than every two combat rounds. The exception opens at Arcane 16 with a real wielded FOCUS. Its prepared page fires every round and produces two to six complete barrages based on the FOCUS weapon's WC and item level. In exchange, it removes one weapon swing below player level 50, then one more at each fifty-level threshold, up to six at level 250. The barrage count never reads or copies ordinary weapon swings, and an Investiture FOCUS does not qualify. Mana Barrier lasts from forty-five seconds upward and gives each damaging hit a chance to spend SP instead of HP after ordinary defenses have reduced the blow. That chance rises with true Arcane rank on a diminishing curve, while Mana Barrier mastery reduces the SP spent per point absorbed. Costs round up; if SP cannot cover the whole hit, the barrier absorbs as much as the remaining reserve permits. "battlemage" reports the exact current chance and efficiency. Powerup normally converts chosen HP immediately at 175 percent. When Bodach is bound, it becomes a visible fifteen-pulse buff instead: each pulse spends the chosen HP amount without taking the Mage below ten HP and restores three times that amount as SP. Touch has a fourteen-second base cooldown. Use "spells <working>" or "spellbook <working>" for the details of one page. "battlemage" reports the exact behavior of your current equipment and barrage. "overchannel" reports its current percentage and added SP. Falx shortens a bound working's manual cooldown by twenty percent and also quickens eligible barrage cadence. Talek, Ravidel, Arcanarton, and Bodach each add ten percent to the working's primary hit and merge their damage types into that hit. Prepared barrage copies use the same rule. Rodney can only be bound to a duration-bearing buff or control working. It extends that working by twenty-five percent through two minutes, thirty-five percent over two minutes, or fifty percent over five minutes. This includes Insane and Wrath concentration blocks, Stasis freezing, and Bodach Powerup pulses, but not Burning. Aiken can only be bound to a damaging working. It uses the established armor piercing path, halving normal armor absorption while leaving resistance, intrinsic reduction, shields, and Mana Barrier intact. Trivlian converts a damaging working's native damage to evil and acid. Other elemental rune types remain part of the unified hit when they share the page. Its pattern waits in the Darkwind Mage attic and will only open after Bodach or Arcanarton. James's Whimsy rune is harmless; Mage Eye sends absurd little scouts, and Teleport portals acquire colors that responsible geometry would refuse. The spellbook will not spend a socket on a rune that has no effect on that working. Use "runes <rune>" to list compatible workings or "spellbook <working>" to list compatible runes. Falx and James can annotate every page. Saloman and Mezari fit SP-costing workings. Rodney fits only real buff or control durations. Damage runes fit damaging workings, with the intentional forbidden exceptions shown under "magehelp runes". Saloman also returns ten percent of discounted base cost from utility workings. Teleport answers to both "tport" and "teleport". The fixed destinations accept "dw" for Darkwind, "hyper" for Hyperborea, "souv" for Souvrael, and "vi" for Volcano Isle.

~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ALCOHOL ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ A monk's body is a temple. Monks do not willingly cloud it with foreign substances. When they do drink, their training rejects the intoxication immediately, and the backlash is painful. Monks rely on discipline, food, and meditation for recovery, not drink. ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~

~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ MONK ARMOR ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ Monks cannot wear armor. Monks believe that putting anything of substance between their physical being and the outside world is unnatural. Because of which, monks' only ability to defend and toughen comes from their ability to strengthen their body through the manifestation of their chi. Their walking staff carries and stabilizes this inner state, and the monk soul directly applies that discipline as defense. ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~

docs.title: THE BROTHERHOOD OF MONKS
docs.text: ================================================================ THE BROTHERHOOD OF MONKS ================================================================ 'Desire is a treasure map. Knowledge is the treasure chest. Wisdom is the jewel. Yet without action they all stay buried. Hope is the pillar that holds up the world' - Pliny the Elder 'When you reach the end of what you should know, you will be at the beginning of what you should sense.' - Kahlil Gibran They come from over the seas, an island of unknown source, they stand apart from society, and order unto themselves. Violator spoke and they were. Cygor fashioned the first master in his own image. They came to the shores, masters of time itself, Maelstrom, the First, guards the Holy monastery. He prepares for the time when the denizens of these lands are ready to follow the true path to enlightenment. Combat will be taught, exploration will be praised, mastery will be encouraged. The path shall not be easy; a Monk must hold no earthly pleasures, nor may they take gain in material wealth. Only the disciplined shall reach the rank of Grand Master. So as it comes to pass, as surely as time allegedly advances, now is the time of the Brotherhood. ================================================================

docs.title: ACUPUNCTURE
docs.text: ================================================================ ACUPUNCTURE ================================================================ 'The flow of a body's energy is manipulatable.' - Master Yun-Fat Chow Acupuncture is a method of inserting small gauge needles under the skin and into junctures of energy paths in the human body. This technique stimulates these energy nodes causing relief to flood to an injured area. This is a Master of the South Wind power. ================================================================

docs.title: AID
docs.text: ================================================================ AID ================================================================ 'The bond of Ancient Energy is like no other.' - Master Maelstrom A Monk can transfer their Ancient Energy to another Monk. The energy is an intangible force that can cover any distance adding strength to those of the brotherhood. This is a Master of Summer power. ================================================================

docs.title: ALCOHOL
docs.text: ================================================================ ALCOHOL ================================================================ 'Dont Drink and Fight.' - A Monks Community Service Announcement A Monks body is a finely tuned machine. A Monk does not require to partake in alcohol to sustain themselves. Alcohol is banned by the order. ================================================================

docs.title: BAMBOO BLOW
docs.text: ================================================================ BAMBOO BLOW ================================================================ 'When you see a rattlesnake poised to strike, you do not wait until he has struck before you crush him.' - Proverb At the Master of Autumn rank, the Monk should have perfected the next walking stick technique. The Monk takes a step back and flings the walking stick around in a wide arc so quickly the staff bends until it snaps forward striking the target with a terrific blow. This is a Master of Autumn power. ================================================================

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ BANISHMENT ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ 'Be gone with you!' - Grand Master Violator A lot of time has gone into the development of this guild. It is here for you to enjoy and for others to do so as well. If you break the rules of the mud. Banishment will occur and you will not be allowed back into the guild. Have respect for yourself, your guildmates and the admin who have worked on this product for you. ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

docs.title: SPIDER BURROW
docs.text: ================================================================ SPIDER BURROW ================================================================ 'The trapdoor spider is an ingenious creature able to bury itself in foliage to create the illusion of invisibility.' - Ultimate Master Li Cek In forest terrain, a Monk may lie in the underbrush pulling surrounding refuse over their body and hide from those who would wish to attack them. This is a Disciple rank power. ================================================================

docs.title: ZEN FISHING
docs.text: ================================================================ ZEN FISHING ================================================================ 'Give a man a fish, feed him a day. Teach a man to fish, feed him for the rest of his life.' - Ancient Proverb A Monk should not be reliant on commerce and economy for the basic needs in life. Zen Fishing is the art of throwing a line into the water and willing large fish in the area to offer themselves for the Monk's nourishment. A fishing rod is necessary in order to utilize this skill. When you are finished you just need to Reel the line in. This is a Master of Autumn power. ================================================================

docs.title: MONK CHALLENGES
docs.text: ================================================================ MONK CHALLENGES ================================================================ 'Accept the challenges so that you can feel the exhilaration of victory.' - Master Garg Patun As an aspiring Monk progresses through the ranks they will face many challenges determined to test their skills, ability, endurance and patience. A Monk will be required to advance through a combat trial to advance through the ranks of the guild. [See Ranks for more info] If the trial is passed the Monk will progress to the next rank within the guild. Once the rank has been achieved by passing the trial the Monk may advance to the next guild level. Monks must seek out the appropriate training master and challenge for the right to progress in the order. At any time a Monk may choose to escape the challenge. If they have not defeated their opponent at this time a severe penalty shall be applied. Challenges should be prepared for carefully as they can result in much pain for those who fail. ================================================================

docs.title: TIGER CHASE
docs.text: ================================================================ TIGER CHASE ================================================================ 'Like the Tiger at a meal, do not leave work unfinished.' - Initiate Master Lon If a Monk is forced to fight an opponent, allowing that person to run free to warn others of the Monk's presence is not a good idea. A Monk who is one with the Tiger pounces after their cowardly prey. This is a Master of Winter rank power. ================================================================

docs.title: COBRA HOOD
docs.text: ================================================================ COBRA HOOD ================================================================ 'Meditation interrupted is not meditation at all. It is simply time wasted.' - Master Hu Fong The quietness that anonymity brings is sometimes necessary not only for spiritual peace, but for survival. A Monk in tune with the snake is able to slip their robe's hood over their head to stop distinguishing themselves as anyone but a simple Monk. This is a Master of the North Wind power. ================================================================

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ FORM OF THE CRANE ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ 'Grace is natural, form can be taught.' - Master Phat Chick Few have the style and grace of a Crane. Calm, yet powerful, at peace, yet combating pain. A Monk who masters the Crane style is one with themselves and capable of achieving amazing things. This form unlocks several powers which can ONLY be used while in the form of the Crane. These powers are: Shatter, Cast, Crane Dance and Crane Kick. ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

docs.title: CRANE KICK
docs.text: ================================================================ CRANE KICK ================================================================ 'Grace and power can lead to a foes pain.' - Master Maelstrom This Crane form attack allows you to lash out suddenly with a powerful combination kick which can leave an opponent dazed. The speed and surprise angle of the kick make it highly effective. This is a Master of Winter power. ================================================================

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ SKILL OF CRIT ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ 'Once a target is struck its force that brings the pain.' - Lord Sal Matis Crit is a Monk specific stat. It relates primarily to the damage one can deal to a foe. The greater the damage, the faster speed with which a foe can be dispatched. All Monks gain a rudimentary knowlege of this skill, but it requires study to take full advantage of it. ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

docs.title: COBRA STRIKE
docs.text: ================================================================ COBRA STRIKE ================================================================ 'Strike fast and few can deflect it.' - Master Maelstrom The Cobra's strike is one of the worlds fastest. In the blink of an eye a powerful blow can be struck to a foes mid section, which they do not see coming. This is a Master of the West Wind rank power. ================================================================

docs.title: CRANE DANCE
docs.text: ================================================================ CRANE DANCE ================================================================ 'The best way to not be struck after a battle has ensued is to attack from all directions.' - Master Chan The graceful Crane form is lithe enough to swim through the field of battle unhindered. The Monk flows gracefully from stance to stance battering their enemy from all sides in an overwhelming flood of strikes. This devestating series of blows takes quite a bit of mental concentration, but the damage is near unparalleled. This is a Master of Winter power. ================================================================

docs.title: DETONATE
docs.text: ================================================================ DETONATE ================================================================ 'It is good to face one's foe at close range, but if one can accomplish the same from far away...' - Master Munkeybutt Using their mastery over the flow of chi, a highly trained Monk can set an object to vibrating at such a frequency that it *explodes* when thrown. This is a Master of Spring power. ================================================================

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ SKILL OF DODGE ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ 'The easiest way to avoid being hit, is to not be the target.' - Lord Sal Matis Dodge is a Monk specific stat. It relates primarily to a Monks ability to avoid being hit in a physical confrontation. The greater the dodging ability of a Monk, the less likely they are to take blows. All Monks gain a rudimentary knowlege of this skill, but it requires study to take full advantage of it. ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ FORM OF THE DRAGON ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ 'Fear is distilled, Strength is displayed.' - Lord Sal Matis The most powerful beast of all, the Dragon exceeds all others. An elite Monk can focus the power beyond human comprehension to become a perfect machine. This form unlocks several powers which can ONLY be used while in the form of the Dragon. These powers are: Aid, Dragon Hurl, Dragon Fear, Dragon Kick and Dragon Scale. ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

docs.title: DRAGON HURL
docs.text: ================================================================ DRAGON HURL ================================================================ 'The strength of a dragon can shake the world.' - Master Nyuk Nyuk A Monk who has mastered the form of the Dragon can physically pick up and throw an opponent. This is an amazing feat of strength and a true reflection of these incredible beasts. ================================================================

docs.title: DRAGON KICK
docs.text: ================================================================ DRAGON KICK ================================================================ 'The tiniest of blows is amplified by a Dragon.' - Master Maelstrom While in tune with the mighty Dragon, a Monk can take a flying leap into the air, gather every ounce of Dragon strength, and EMBED their foot into a foe's main body. This is a Grand Master power. ================================================================

docs.title: DRAGONSCALE
docs.text: ================================================================ DRAGONSCALE ================================================================ 'Few animals have ever existed as powerful as the Dragon.' - Madam Ki Chim The powerful Dragon form brings more with it than a harder body and larger muscles. While one with the Dragon, a Monk is able to harden their skin akin to the scales of a mighty Dragon. This skill turns the Monk into somewhat of a juggernaught; while toughening themselves up and possessing the ability to withstand fire attacks, they will not be able to move quite as fast before. This is a Grand Master power. ================================================================

docs.title: EAGLE CLAW
docs.text: ================================================================ EAGLE CLAW ================================================================ 'To be one with the eagle is to seek great heights and to deal great pain.' - Master Maelstrom The Eagle Claw is a basic attack. The Monk lashes at their target to deal a short sharp blow. Monks are generally taught this attack first as a means of self defence. This is an Initiate rank power that is struck by an unarmed Monk. ================================================================

docs.title: ENERVATE
docs.text: ================================================================ ENERVATE ================================================================ 'What use is a body if the mind is vacant?' - Master Gi Kwan Monks require a great deal of wisdom in order to perform their duties. This is often at the cost of their physical health. Enervate is an ability that allows a Monk to quickly slip in and out of a deep meditative trace, coming out of it with their body hurting, but their spirit replenished. This is a Master of the East Wind power. ================================================================

docs.title: EVALUATE
docs.text: ================================================================ EVALUATE ================================================================ 'The tallest of trees will not bend if it is not meant to fall.' - Master Sweeper A Monk can use this ability to guage their chances of defeating an opponent. A wise Monk will not fight a battle which is clearly beyond them, but will take note to ensure that eventual victory will be theirs. This is an Initiate rank power. ================================================================

docs.title: TIGER FANG
docs.text: ================================================================ TIGER FANG ================================================================ 'Watch me put my hand in its mouth.' - Master One Arm This Tiger form attack uses a powerful attacking blow which can potentially devastate a foe. It's very difficult to keep up a fight with a punctured jugular! This is a Master of Winter power. ================================================================

docs.title: DRAGON FEAR
docs.text: ================================================================ DRAGON FEAR ================================================================ 'Weakness is the greatest weakness of all.' - Master Maelstrom In the form of the Dragon, a Monk can channel the all powerful Dragon fear which can drive a foe insane. This can lead them to freeze on the spot or to run away. This is a Master of Summer power. ================================================================

docs.title: FLIP
docs.text: ================================================================ FLIP ================================================================ 'A fall for even the smallest fraction of time can lead to disasterous results for a foe.' - Master Aiko Being a master of hand to hand combat, the Monk has combined both offensive and defensive fighting styles. The Monk uses superior balance and timing to throw their opponent onto their back allowing free strikes while they are down. This is a Disciple rank power. ================================================================

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ MONK FIGHTING FORMS ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ 'The power to challenge ones beliefs lies within us all, only when we awaken it do we truly advance.' - Master Shal Wei Monks are highly capable fighters and can change their fighting stance to accomodate different fighting situations. There are 8 forms available and some powers are only usable when that form has been activated. Further details on each form are found under the helpfile for the creature. The monkforms command provides current cost and levels at which each respective form is achieved. As well as the command syntax. All forms can be ceased by utilizing the Endform command. These forms are: Rat, Spider, Monkey, Snake, Crane, Tiger, Phoenix and Dragon. ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

docs.title: RATS FURY
docs.text: ================================================================ RATS FURY ================================================================ 'The anger in one so small can turn the tide when all seems lost.' - Grand Master Tao Lin A Monk utilising the form of the Rat can strike with incredible speed, inflicting multiple blows upon their opponent. This is an Initiate rank power that must be struck with a bare hand. ================================================================

docs.title: PHOENIX GAZE
docs.text: ================================================================ PHOENIX GAZE ================================================================ 'The eyes are the window to the soul.' - Master Maelstrom A Monk can utilise the terrifying Phoenix force to burn the very soul of their foe. It is an intensely draining process for the Monk, but incredibly painful for his enemy. This is a Grand Master power. ================================================================

docs.title: GMONK COMMAND
docs.text: ================================================================ GMONK COMMAND ================================================================ 'The talk of the wise isn't for children.' - Chinese Proverb This command allows you to speak to your Brothers and Sisters who are Grand Monks and are on at the moment. ================================================================

docs.title: INFUSE ENERGY
docs.text: ================================================================ INFUSE ENERGY ================================================================ 'The Energy of the Ancients can be obtained by many means.' - Master Munkeybutt Once trained properly, a Monk having an excess of chi energy is able to rechannel that chi into the Energy of the Ancients. This is a Master of the North Wind power. ================================================================

docs.title: INTUITION
docs.text: ================================================================ INTUITION ================================================================ 'Let go of your senses....' - Master Larry Kenobi A Monk utilising the Tiger form can drop into a meditative state and sense the environment around themselves. They often discover foes and challenges as yet unseen, just as a Tiger can sense danger in the air. This is a Master of the West Wind rank power. ================================================================

docs.title: JUDGEMENT OF THE MIND
docs.text: ================================================================ JUDGEMENT OF THE MIND ================================================================ 'He who merely knows right principles is not equal to him who loves them.' - Sage Confucius A Monk can determine the mental state of a friend or foe by taking a few seconds to relax their spirit and reach out with their emotions. It can be useful in determining what course should be taken with those not as disciplined as the Monk. This is a Master of the East Wind power. ================================================================

docs.title: SPIDER LEAP
docs.text: ================================================================ SPIDER LEAP ================================================================ 'If the ground exerts a force on ones self, then the favour can be returned.' - Master Zing Wa A Monk can leap a great distance, often leaving their foes wondering where they have gotten to. This is a Disciple rank power. ================================================================

docs.title: LILY BLOW
docs.text: ================================================================ LILY BLOW ================================================================ 'When an enemy gets used to the rhythm of a battle, strike on the offbeat.' - Master Bonham As a Monk rises in rank, so will their skill with the walking stick. The Lily Blow is a more complicated move than the Plum Blossom Blow, requiring more skill and chi control. The Monk will feint at the opponent before actually dealing the blow, making it hard to see it coming. A Monk MUST wield their walking stick to initiate this attack. This is a Master of the West Wind power. ================================================================

docs.title: LORE
docs.text: ================================================================ LORE ================================================================ 'Hey, where'd you get that?' - Pretty much every player at some time Monks seek knowledge and as an organisation, the guild members have extensive knowledge of items and their strengths and weaknesses. In the form of the Phoenix, a Monk can readily draw on this information. This is a Master of Summer power. ================================================================

docs.title: MEDITATE
docs.text: ================================================================ MEDITATE ================================================================ 'Meditation is not simply time to be still; seeking inner peace recharges the mind, and inner peace can knit the body.' - Master Hu Fong Monks excel at keeping their minds and bodies in a balanced state. When they sit and concentrate, they are able to recuperate their physical and mental health in a faster than average fashion. This skill increases significantly with proper training and eventually a Monk can learn to ignore all distraction in their environment. This is a Master of the South Wind rank power. ================================================================ In addition, Meditate is a skill that relates directly to this power. ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ SKILL OF MEDITATE ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ 'Patience is gained through internal reflection.' - Lord Sal Matis Meditate is a Monk specific stat. It relates primarily to a Monks ability to focus internally and harness spiritual energy. The greater the Meditate ability of a Monk, the greater their ability to utilise this internal reflection. All Monks gain a rudimentary knowlege of this skill, but it requires study to take full advantage of it. ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

docs.title: MEND
docs.text: ================================================================ MEND ================================================================ 'When ones soul is truly healed the body will follow.' - Master Lute Zhu Mend is a basic healing power. A Monk is in harmony with his body and soul, and is quite capable of restoring his own health. This is an Initiate rank power. ================================================================ In addition, Mend is a skill that relates directly to this power. ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ SKILL OF MEND ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ 'Pain must be endured for healing to begin.' - Lord Sal Matis Mend is a Monk specific stat. It relates primarily to a Monks ability to heal both themselves and their allies. The greater the Mend ability of a Monk, the greater their knowledge of the healing arts. All Monks gain a rudimentary knowlege of this skill, but it requires study to take full advantage of it. ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

docs.title: MONEY
docs.text: ================================================================ MONEY ================================================================ 'To worship gold is folly; a Monk troubles themselves not with such things.' - Master Oronus A Monk shall hold no earthly possessions, and it is expected that a Monk donates their money to the abbey. Possessing too much money distracts a Monk, and having a large bank balance is distracting. Your tithes shall be recorded, and one who has donated more is generally more favoured. ================================================================

docs.title: MONK COMMAND
docs.text: ================================================================ MONK COMMAND ================================================================ 'A single conversation across the table with a wise man is worth a month's study of books.' - Chinese Proverb This command allows you to speak to your Brothers and Sisters are on at the moment. ================================================================

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ FORM OF THE MONKEY ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ 'Its easy to imitate one who is so like ourselves.' - Master Shal Wei The Monkey is a creature whose only true peers are humans. They have incredibly powerful acrobatic skills that can cause great pains and leave opponents stunned. This form unlocks several powers which can ONLY be used while in the form of the Monkey. These powers are: Monkey Whip, Monkey Slam, Study and Monkey Driver. ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

docs.title: MONKEY DRIVER
docs.text: ================================================================ MONKEY DRIVER ================================================================ 'The great ape possesses the strength of five men and knows it.' - Master Chan The third and most powerful of the Monkey form attack is the Monkey Driver. The Monk leaps forward with knuckles dragging, grabs their foe, jumps high into the air, turning the enemy upside down. The Monk then slams the enemy into the ground headfirst telescoping the spine. This move is not able to be executed successfully if the foe is not already stunned. This is a Master of the North Wind power. ================================================================

docs.title: MONKEY SLAM
docs.text: ================================================================ MONKEY SLAM ================================================================ 'Bring on the pain.' - Master Munkeybutt While one with the form of the Monkey, a Monk can quickly lift a stunned opponent up with their feral strength and slam them into the ground on their back. This move can cause a foe to be unable to attack for a few moments. A Monk wielding a weapon may not make this attack. This is a Master of the West Wind rank power. ================================================================

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ MONK HELP ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ This command provides access to the guilds help files. All powers and skills have help files, as well as many other monk related topics. A list of topics can be gained by reading the topics help file. ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

docs.title: MONKPOWERS COMMAND
docs.text: ================================================================ MONKPOWERS COMMAND ================================================================ 'A wise man never loses anything, if he has himself.' - Michel de Montaigne This command provides a list of all current powers that the Monk can use. It will only show those powers that you have attained, amd those you hope to have. It provides the syntax, and costs to use the powers. ================================================================

docs.title: MONKS COMMAND
docs.text: ================================================================ MONKS COMMAND ================================================================ 'Communication with your Masters is often the shortest path to enlightenment.' - Master Gi Kwan This command lists all currently active Monks. It displays Level, Guild Level, Monk Title and Rank of each active Monk. ================================================================

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ MONK TITLE ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ 'Make a statement about yourself with your actions.' - Master Maelstrom The monktitle command allows you to set a title that will appear on the Monks list ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

docs.title: MONK SCORE
docs.text: ================================================================ MONK SCORE ================================================================ 'Know thyself.' - Sage Socrates This command provides detailed information about a Monks studies. It lists the skills and abilities specifically related to a Monk's training. ================================================================

docs.title: PHOENIX NIMBUS
docs.text: ================================================================ PHOENIX NIMBUS ================================================================ 'Be still and surround yourself in the protection of the Phoenix.' - Mistress Kim Chi The burning Phoenix form grants a flaming protective nimbus surrounding the Monk from all sides. The Phoenix uses this aura to deflect blows and defend the Monk in combat in general. This is a Master of Summer power. ================================================================

docs.title: ORCHID BLOSSOM
docs.text: ================================================================ ORCHID BLOSSOM ================================================================ 'The core of a man's body is well protected by bone and muscle. Both can be broken.' - Grand Master Maelstrom A Monk of this level of mastery has developed this formidable attack skill with their walking stick. The Monk utilizes the walking stick like a pole vault, lifting them above and behind the target. This places the Monk behind their foe to crack their skull with a mighty blow. This is a Master of Winter power. ================================================================

docs.title: ORIGIN
docs.text: ================================================================ ORIGIN ================================================================ 'To understand where one is going, one must know where one has been.' - Master Sweeper A Monk can use their arcane knowlege to determine where an object comes from based on whom its creator was. This is an Initiate rank power. ================================================================

docs.title: QUIVERING PALM
docs.text: ================================================================ QUIVERING PALM ================================================================ 'Chi is a flowing force; thus it may be disrupted like any stream.' - Master Hu Fong A Monk is able to channel their Ancient Energy into a chi-disrupting wave emanating from the Palm. When a foe is struck with this wave, their whole chi balance is thrown off for a time. This is a Master of the West Wind power. ================================================================ In addition, Palm is a skill that relates directly to this power. ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ SKILL OF PALM ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ 'Disrupt the soul and you own the body.' - Lord Sal Matis Palm is a Monk specific stat. It relates primarily to a Monks ability to reach a harmonic balance with the universe and to translate that balance into a destructive force. The greater the Palm ability of a Monk, the more dangerous the results of this skill will be. All Monks gain a rudimentary knowlege of this skill, but it requires study to take full advantage of it. ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ FORM OF THE PHOENIX ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ 'Eternal life springs from a life thats been lived.' - Master Cwack Hore Mythical or reality, the Phoenix is carried in the heart of all Monks. Their power comes from the ability to rise above adversity. This form unlocks several powers which can ONLY be used while in the form of the Phoenix. These powers are: Phoenix Rising, Phoenix Gaze, Phoenix Egg, Phoenix Nimbus and Lore. ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

docs.title: PHOENIX EGG
docs.text: ================================================================ PHOENIX EGG ================================================================ 'A creature that can not die has no need for its eggs.' - Chi Lan The most powerful Phoenix attack. The Phoenix egg is pure concentrated Ancient Energy which obliterates whatever it hits. The Monk coalesces the energy into a powerful energy ball to hurl at their foes. This is a Grand Master power. ================================================================

docs.title: PHOENIX RISING
docs.text: ================================================================ PHOENIX RISING ================================================================ 'You may strike down the Phoenix, but he will be reborn from his ashes to repay your hostility.' - Grand Master Xian Yung The ultimate definition of the Phoenix is their ability to rise from the death, every bit as powerful as they were. While a Monk is one with the Phoenix, they will be granted the same ability. A Monk may be struck down, but they will rise. This is a Grand Master power. ================================================================

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ PK ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ 'Responsibility for ones actions is important." - Master Violator As with all guilds registering PK is totally an individual choice. There is no requirement for a monk to become PK. It is expected that PK monks do take responsibility for their own actions, and that the guild will not support them in the event they are at fault. The other side of this being that you should protect your Brothers and Sisters IF they are unfairly targeted. ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

docs.title: PLUM BLOSSOM BLOW
docs.text: ================================================================ PLUM BLOSSOM BLOW ================================================================ 'Your stick may resemble a floating blossom, but it should strike like a fist.' - Master Kung Lo This is a novice's move Monks are taught to execute with their walking stick. It is a simple yet effective method of dealing a quick blow to an opponent. A Monk MUST wield the walking stick to make this attack. This is a Master of the East Wind power. ================================================================

docs.title: POSSESSIONS
docs.text: ================================================================ POSSESSIONS ================================================================ 'A Monk needs not these things..'- Master Vio to Master Angst all the time A monk has no need for material wealth. Gold should be donated to Maelstrom. It only confuses the mind. A monk needs not own a boat. They are a perversion of the natural order. A monk needs not own a business. Living life is a business in itself. A monk needs only his robe and stick. Warmth and defence they provide. ================================================================

docs.title: TIGER POUNCE
docs.text: ================================================================ TIGER POUNCE ================================================================ 'Thats a lot of weight to land on you.' - Master Chan This Tiger form attack drives your opponent to the ground. Your weight dealing damage and stunning your foe. A Tiger attacking a Gazelle attacks in the same manner. This is a Master of Winter power. ================================================================

docs.title: PURGE
docs.text: ================================================================ PURGE ================================================================ 'There is little as insidious or deadly to the body purity as a good subtle poison. And I know poison. *(;=' - Angst NimbleFingers Monks control their bodies as a master blacksmith controls their own tools. Every aspect of this complicated tool is under their mastery. When foreign bodies are introduced to the body by any vehicle, they can be rejected outright as impurities. This is a Master of the West Wind power. ================================================================

docs.title: MONK RANKS
docs.text: ================================================================ MONK RANKS ================================================================ 'If an inexperienced one has no idea who the wise are, the entire Order will die.' - Mistress Jin Lotus A Monk, unlike the other professions of Darkwind only learns new skills upon progression through the ranks. To advance in rank a Monk must achieve the required guild level and defeat a challenge master. The ranks have the following titles Initiate, Disciple, Master of the East Wind, Master of the South Wind, Master of the West Wind, Master of the North Wind, Master of Autumn, Master of Winter, Master of Spring, Master of Summer, and Grand Master. ================================================================

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ FORM OF THE RAT ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ 'Of all the creatures, there is only one who has such power, yet is so despised.' - Master Shal Wei The Rat, a creature of shadow and speed. A Monk can utilise a fighting form based upon the skills associated with such a creature. This form unlocks several powers which can ONLY be used while in the form of the Rat. These powers are: Rats Fury, Rats Scurry, Rats Strike, Evaluate and Flip. ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ REPUTATION ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ 'Its whether your actions today are remembered tommorrow thats important' - Master Maelstrom Through a monks actions and experience he earns a reputation across the world. Many a foe is defeated by a fear of a legendary monk. Your generosity, skill and experience all contribute to your reputation ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

docs.title: RESONATE
docs.text: ================================================================ RESONATE ================================================================ 'A weapon is a device for making your enemy change his mind.' - Lois Bujold Monks are able to utilize their chi manipulation powers to set a weapon to vibrating at such a high intensity, it becomes able pierce through the strongest of armours. The downside of this is the weapon will literally shake itself apart after an amount of time. This is a Master of Winter power. ================================================================

docs.title: RAT STRIKE
docs.text: ================================================================ RAT STRIKE ================================================================ 'Even the smallest blow can prove effective.' - Master La deh A Monk in the Rat form can make a rapid darting blow at a foe dealing a quick effective blow to the throat which may render the target speechless. This is a Disciple rank power. ================================================================

docs.title: Remote Tithe
docs.text: ================================================================ Remote Tithe ================================================================ 'Gold pieces? A Monk needs not these things.' - Pliny the Elder As a Monk, we all know we feel that it is unnecessary to be distracted by too much money. It is far more appropriate to simply tithe this money to the Abbey. However, in our travels, it is difficult to make it all the way back to get rid of a troublesome amount. Remote Tithe allows a Monk to tithe just how it sounds; without having to be sitting at Maelstrom's feet. This is a Master of the East Wind power. ================================================================

docs.title: RATS SCURRY
docs.text: ================================================================ RATS SCURRY ================================================================ 'The little things are often ignored.' - Grand Master Tao Lin A Monk utilising the form of the Rat can appear so non-descript that they may often leave without being seen. This is an Initiate rank power. ================================================================

docs.title: SEASNAKE
docs.text: ================================================================ SEASNAKE ================================================================ 'A snake glides upon the ground as if they are not subject to friction or gravity.' - Lady Tung A trained Monk in the Kir Brotherhood is able to make their own body light enough that they actually walk on water. This often amazes the untrained, as they believe that this is impossible. This skill would indeed be impossible if one is not able to channel the Energy of the Ancients. This is a Master of the South Wind power. ================================================================

docs.title: SHATTER WEAPON
docs.text: ================================================================ SHATTER WEAPON ================================================================ 'Failure to prepare is preparing to fail.' - Unknown A wise Monk recognizes when an opponent is going to prove to be most difficult to best in combat. The walking stick can be used to strike a foe's weapon so hard, it is rendered useless. This is a Master of Autumn power. ================================================================

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ FORM OF THE SNAKE ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ 'Never stare into the eyes if evil.' - Teac Arun The legendary creature who caused man to be removed from the Garden of Eden. Destined to stalk man for eternity as punishment. A Monk who understands the Snake can not fall victim to one. This form unlocks several powers which can ONLY be used while in the form of the Snake. These powers are: Seasnake, Purge, Cobra Strike, and Infuse. ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ FORM OF THE SPIDER ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ 'There is much power in ones deadly bite.' - Master Dwan Kang Graceful, agile, reviled. The Spider is a creature of many mysteries, who is able to throw itself, trap and kill its its foe. This form unlocks several powers which can ONLY be used while in the form of the Spider. These powers are: Spider Leap, Spider Bite, Spider Burrow, Web and Mend. ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

docs.title: SPIDER BITE
docs.text: ================================================================ SPIDER BITE ================================================================ 'A spider's bite is small, but it's ramifications can be severe.' - Master Lao Chung Should a Monk trap a foe using the form of the Spider and Web, the Monk can inflict a deadly bite upon their enemy. This is a Master of the East Wind power. ================================================================

docs.title: SPIN KICK
docs.text: ================================================================ SPIN KICK ================================================================ 'He who expects a blow from the hand may not see the incoming foot.' - Master Grother A Monk has no need for a blade in combat, as his arms and legs are powerful weapons. A Master Monk can pivot on one foot and launch a devestating blow to his opponents head with their opposite foot. A Monk wielding a weapon may not make this attack. This is a Master of the South Wind power. ================================================================

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ MONK STICK ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ 'The simplest weapon is often the greatest when placed in the hands of a master' - Master Maelstrom The monk stick is not just a weapon. It is a monks best friend. It travels with the monk on their daily journeys, and is a tool for recording these travels. As a monk notches the stick to mark the various areas and lands visited it becomes crafted and shaped becoming a highly versatile and potentially lethal weapon. By typing notch the additional stick commands are displayed. When a monk enters a new area he may add a new notch to his stick through the use of the notch add command. The notch list command will display a list of all areas that a monk has visited. A monk may use the command sling to place the stick across their back. It may be recalled using the command grasp. A stick may NEVER be passed to another and a monk would rather die that lose this treasured object. It is the only true possession of each individual monk. ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

docs.title: STUDY OF CORPSES
docs.text: ================================================================ STUDY OF CORPSES ================================================================ 'He who knows others is learned. He who knows himself is wise.' - Master Lao-Tzu A Monk studies the corpses of their fallen foes to improve and develop their understanding of a creatures anatomy. A Monk receives a small boon from the gods for honouring their foes in this manner. This is a Master of the West Wind power. ================================================================

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ SKILL OF STUN ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ 'An incapacitated enemy is of no consequence.' - Lord Sal Matis Stun is a Monk specific stat. It relates primarily to a Monks ability to reduce a foes combat effectiveness. The greater the stun ability of a Monk, the greater their ability to eliminate an enemy. All Monks gain a rudimentary knowlege of this skill, but it requires study to take full advantage of it. ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ FORM OF THE TIGER ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ 'Its big, its has teeth and stripes, thats enough for me.' - Initiate Idi Yoto The Tiger is one of natures most powerful killing machines. A Monk attempted to harness this internal power to release with devastating force. This form unlocks several powers which can ONLY be used while in the form of the Tiger. These powers are: Tigermind, Intuition, Tiger Chase, Fang and Pounce. ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

docs.title: TIGER MIND
docs.text: ================================================================ TIGER MIND ================================================================ 'The stalking Tiger on his trail is not easily distracted.' - Master Kung Lo A Monk who is one with the Tiger is as strong in mind as they are in body. The mind of a Tiger is like a steel cage, protected from outside attack. A wise Monk uses this technique to combat others invading their minds. This is a Master of Autumn power. ================================================================

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ MONK GUILD TOPICS ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ POWERS: Acupuncture Eval Monkeydriver Rtithe Aid Fang Monkeyslam Scurry Bamboo Fear Seasnake Burrow Flip Nimbus Shatter Cast Fury Orchid Spiderbite Cranekick Gaze Origin Spinkick Cstrike Infuse Palm Study Dance Intuition Phoenixegg Tigerchase Detonate Judge Plum Tigermind Dragonhurl Leap Pounce Web Dragonkick Lily Purge Whip Dragonscale Lore Rebirth Eagle Meditate Resonate Enervate Mend Rstrike FORMS: Crane Monkey Rat Spider Dragon Phoenix Snake Tiger SKILLS: Crit Dodge Meditate Mend Palm Stun COMMANDS: gmonk monkemotes monkhist monktitle monk monkforms monkpowers mscore monkhelp monks RULES: banishment pk wizards MISCELLANEOUS: alcohol challenges forms money possessions reputation ranks ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

docs.title: Spider Web
docs.text: ================================================================ Spider Web ================================================================ 'An enemy who cannot retaliate is the best sort.' - Lord Kung Lo While acting as the Spider, a Monk can fling a thin net of webbing onto an enemy. A foe so bound will find it difficult to fight or run. This is a Disciple power. ================================================================

docs.title: MONKEY WHIP
docs.text: ================================================================ MONKEY WHIP ================================================================ 'The dimunitive monkey conceals great strength.' - Mistress Jin Lotus While in the Monkey Form, you can use your speed and strength to make a powerful throw, grabbing your opponent, and slamming him against a wall. After being slammed against the wall, your foe will need some time to recover from the blow. However if your opponent is better skilled than you are, they can counter your throw, and reverse it into a powerful headbutt. Monkey Whip can only be used in a room with walls; it cannot be used in the open. This is a Master of the South Wind power. ================================================================

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ WIZARDS ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ 'Monks are proudly present by...." - Master Violator The monks guild has been built by many wizards over the last 10 years. Implementation level coding has been completed by Violator and Cygor. Review and Balance checks have been completed by James.
