docs.title: The use of psychic power requires great concentration.
docs.text: The use of psychic power requires great concentration. While a psionicist is trained to be able to concentrate even in the midst of combat, it still requires time. Should the psionicist attempt to perform any action during the power's concentration time (other than normal melee combat), his concentration will be interrupted, and the power will be aborted. Be very careful not to enter a command a few seconds too early, or the power you were concentrating on will be lost!

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Create Image" Using this power, the psionicist can trick others into perceiving something that is not in fact present. This image can be of anything the psionicist can imagine, and can be colored white, yellow, red, or green to imitate items, coins, monsters, or weapons and armor, respectively. The duration of the image is dependent on guild level. SP Cost: 20 Guild Level: 4 Potential Points: 1 Command: create <whatever>

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Psychic Crush" This is the randomized equivalent to psionic blast, for those who are feeling lucky. It costs the same but whereas psionic blast does a flat amount damage, psychic crush does a random amount. So the psionicist could get lucky and do extra damage for the same amount of sp. SP Cost: Variable Guild Level: 6 Potential Points: 5 Command: pcrush <object>

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Crystalize" A psionicist with this power can use the residual psychic energy left behind when the soul departs a corpse in order to create a crystal which stores psychic power (SP). The quality of the crystal created depends on a random chance dependent on guild level. No matter what the quality of the crystal resulting, the power costs 20 sp. To reclaim the power stored in the crystal, you simply 'drain crystal'. SP Cost: 20 Guild Level: 6 Potential Points: 2 Command: crystalize

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Detonate" This allows the psionicist to telekinetically break the pattern holding matter together. It destructs any droppable, stealable object the player is carrying (so it must have been gettable too). SP Cost: 5 Guild Level: 1 Potential Points: 1 Command: detonate <object>

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Displace" This power allows the psionicist to create an image of himself in people's minds while he himself is actually a short distance away! The effect of the power is to create a 'dummy' of the psionicist that does not attack but draws the attacks of any opponents, who believe it to be the original psionicist. This is a very powerful ability. After a length of time dependent on guild level, the opponents will realize their mistake and begin attacking the real psionicist again. SP Cost: 60 Guild Level: 10 Potential Points: 5 Command: displace

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Double Pain" This power allows the psionicist to temporarily alter the pain sense in a target. It does no damage in and of itself, but it makes the target so sensitive to pain that NO amount of armor will protect it from damage at all. It lasts a variable amount of time according to the psionicist's guild level. This is a powerful addition to a psionicists' arsenal and players are urged not to overlook it simply because it doesn't blast anything by itself. SP Cost: 60 Guild Level: 7 Potential Points: 4 Command: dpain <target>

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Dream Reality" Using this power, the mentalist is able to enter his own dream world. Once within the world, he can manipulate it to suit his own tastes. (Type 'realityhelp' within the reality for more information.) He can also invite others into his dream. Be warned that travel between the dream reality and the 'real' reality is very draining spiritually. NOTE: This IS a dream. You may not give objects to others, and objects that are dropped are lost forever in the primeval Dreamscape. SP Cost: variable Guild Level: 8 Potential Points: 3 Command: dreamr

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Dual Mind" This splits the psionicist's mind into two separate, working halves allowing him to collect his thoughts faster. It is a global power modifier that reduces concentration time of all powers automatically. It cannot be forgotten once learned. SP Cost: none Guild Level: 3 Potential Points: 4 Command: none

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Ectoplasmic Form" It allows the psionicist to leave his or her own body and roam the land as an insubstantial phantom. The phantom is entirely invulnerable to attack and cannot damage any monsters or pick any items up. While they are in ectoplasmic form psionicists' own bodies will lie dormant, unable to be given any commands. To end this power, type 'end'. SP Cost: 75 Guild Level: 5 Potential Points: 2 Command: eform

(Blatant self-serving emote :) welcome - welcome someone ysai - look for a spouse to steal (targeted: watch Ysai steal their spouse) Emotes marked by * are normal emotes with a twist.

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Emotion Control" This allows the psionicist to telepathically alter the emotions of creatures. For a short time, it will make a peaceful monster aggressive, or an aggressive monster peaceful. The monster's original attitude then returns. Note that this is a GENERAL attitude change. If the monster is already fighting someone, it won't stop fighting that particular character. This is an unusual power that has many creative uses. SP Cost: 15 Guild Level: 10 Potential Points: 3 Command: emotion <target>

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Enhance" This is a global power modifier. Casting it before another power focuses the psionicist's mental energy, giving a guild level increase for purposes of damage, duration, etc of the next power used. SP Cost: 10 Guild Level: 2 Potential Points: 2 Command: enhance

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Enlighten" This allows the psionicist to have sudden enlightening psychic realizations. It allows the psionicist to perform the cost and advance functions of the guild hall from other locations on the mud. SP Cost: 3 Guild Level: 1 Potential Points: 2 Command: enlighten <command>

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Graft Weapon" Through a combination of meditation on the arts of war and psychometabolic enhancements, a psionicist is able to act as if a weapon were a part of his body. This ability, Graft Weapon, will increase the combat effectiveness of a single weapon for a moderate length of time. The weapon must be unwielded when the power is initiated, and will automatically be wielded. The weapon will be unwielded again when the power ends. If the weapon is unwielded before then, the power will end prematurely. SP Cost: variable Guild Level: 4 Potential Points: 2 Command: graftw <weapon>

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Guild Chat" This allows guild members to talk on the guild channel and is automatically added to the player's power list when joining the guild. Note that it does NOT include the high level guild chat. Obviously, this power cannot be forgotten. SP Cost: none Guild Level: 1 Potential Points: 0 Command: psi <msg>, epsi <emote>, or psi :<in-game emote>

docs.title: The High Psionicists of Darkwind
docs.text: The High Psionicists of Darkwind This is a list of active player high psionicists on Darkwind. If a change needs to be made, please let Klaughihin know. +-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Hypnotize" This allows the psionicist to hypnotize a target into believing that he sees something that is not actually there. The target will see a message to the effect of, 'You think you see <message>' SP Cost: 5 Guild Level: 1 Potential Points: 1 Command: hypnotize <target> <message>

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Imprint" This imprints an object with the psionicist's "psychic signature". If cast in most places on the mud it will last a temporary amount of time dependent on guild level. If cast in the storage room of the Psionicist Guild it has a permanent duration (until the item is next picked up). It will not allow anybody but the psionicist to pick up the item. SP Cost: 3 Guild Level: 2 Potential Points: 1 Command: imprint <object>

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Increase Density" Similar to Reduce Weight, the psionicist alters the structure of a piece of armor to make it denser and therefore more resistant to attack. However, the process also adds weight to the armor, and it is more mentally taxing than Reduce Weight. The bonus is affected, but not determined, by guild level. SP Cost: 100 Guild Level: 11 Potential Points: 3 Command: increase <object>

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Inflict Pain" This allows the psionicist to generate artificial feelings of pain in the target. It does no actual damage, but the target will act as if his str and dex were much lower due to the intense crippling effects of the power. It has a variable duration based on guild level. SP Cost: 40 Guild Level: 9 Potential Points: 3 Command: inflict <target>

docs.title: The practice of psionics is the mastering of mental power.  It
docs.text: The practice of psionics is the mastering of mental power. It involves the disciplines of telepathy, teleportation, and extrasensory perception. Additionally, the psionicist learns to manipulate the minds of his enemies to damage them or change their perceptions and alter the characteristics of objects. Psionicists stand in the center of their own universes and alter the beings and objects around them to fit their own conceptions. With mages, necromancers, druids, and clerics you may be asking yourself 'Why psionicists?'. The answer is that psionicists are unique, with a style and philosophy quite distinct from other 'spellcasting' guilds. Psionicists do not call upon the forces of magic, of nature, of the powers of Darkness, or the powers of Light. Psionicists call upon themselves. They are masters of themselves and of their own minds. Their power is a very individual thing, trained and developed in different directions by each member of the Guild according to his or her desires. The study of the mind is a rigorous path to follow but it offers unparalleled opportunities for personal choice in character development. The purpose of this document was simply to introduce the Guild to the reader. For in-depth information on the guild and how you can become a member, visit the guild itself one east of the post office. That's S,S,S,S,W,W,S from Center of Town.

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Judge" This allows the psionicist to "look deep into another person's eyes and see their soul". It will tell you how far they have advanced within their guild and compare their stats to yours if the target is a player character, and it will estimate how you would fare in combat against the target if it is a monster. Note that it judges purely from a one on one physical confrontation. The psionicist has access to a host of powers the opponent does not and the ability to retreat and heal which most monster do not have. On the other hand, some monsters possess special attacks or abilities which judge will also not factor into things. However, it is a good way to get a general feeling for how tough a monster is, or how far advanced another player is compared to you. SP Cost: 15 Guild Level: 2 Potential Points: 2 Command: pjudge <target>

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Lend Health" This allows the psionicist to lend some of his life energy over to another person. It's not healing, it is rather a transfer of wounds. It restores 10 hp to the target. SP Cost: 15 / 10 HPs Guild Level: 2 Potential Points: 2 Command: lendh <target>

docs.title: Level           Title
docs.text: Level Title 1 "the Follower of the Mind" 2 "the Seeker of the Mind" 3 "the Initiate of the Mind" 4 "the Disciple of the Mind" 5 "the Scholar of the Mind" 6 "the Apprentice of the Mind" 7 "the Philosopher of the Mind" 8 "the Student of the Mind" 9 "the Sage of the Mind" 10 "the Journeyman of the Mind" 11 "the Psychic" 12 "the Psionicist" 13 "the Master of the Mind" 14 "the Grand Master of the Mind" 15 "the Enlightened"

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Limit" This is the opposite of Enhance. It reduces the psionicist's guild level for his next power. It is useful for reducing the cost of glevel dependent powers when you don't need the full effect. SP Cost: none Guild Level: 2 Potential Points: 1 Command: limit [#]

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Grand Master Chat" This allows the person to join the elite of the psionicists, being able to participate on the Hipsi chat line. SP Cost: none Guild Level: 15 Potential Points: 0 Command: hipsi <message>, ehipsi <emote>, or hipsi :<in-game emote>

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Power Mastery" This is a global power modifier allowing psionicists to become masters of X, where X is one of the other powers. The power mastery ability itself must first be bought, then each individual power must be individually mastered. There are 3 levels of mastery. The first causes all uses of the power to be automatically under the influence of enhance and costs 1 purchase point. The second causes all uses of the power to additionally be under the influence of dual mind and costs 1 more purchase points. The last reduces the sp cost of the power by a percentage of its normal cost and costs an additional purchase point. Note that these benefits are in ADDITION to any enhance or dual mind which might might already be in effect! Power Mastery cannot be forgotten once learned, but the individual powers that are mastered can be 'unmastered'. SP Cost: none Guild Level: 8 Potential Points: 3 Command: none - use Guild Advance Board

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Mental Blow" This sends a hammering blow of force directly into the mind of the target. It does a base amount of damage slightly dependent upon regular level and does a further random amount based on guild level. It is an all around attack power cheaper and faster than psionic blast. SP Cost: Variable Guild Level: 3 Potential Points: 2 Command: mblow <target>

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Mindlink" This allows the psionicist to use his telepathic powers to send messages to others. Effectively a psion style tell. A nice guild perk (once it has been bought) in keeping with the psionicist theme. SP Cost: 2 Guild Level: 1 Potential Points: 1 Command: mindlink, ml, mlrep, mlrepto

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Obscure" This allows the psionicist to mentally obscure his image in others' minds. It is not complete invisibility, it simply changes the psionicist's description to "something in the corner of your eye" for a short time. They may know someone's there but they won't know who it is unless your own description gives it away. SP Cost: Variable Guild Level: 9 Potential Points: 3 Command: obscure

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Psychic Lash" A psionicist can use this ability to blast an opponent with raw telepathic power, directly assaulting its mind. Though very fast and easy, this attack is unskilled, relying purely on its raw force, and therefore has less effect than a Psionic Blast or Mental Blow. The exact effect varies slightly with each use, but is not dependent on guild level, regular level, or any outside factor. SP Cost: 15 Guild Level: 1 Potential Points: 1 Command: plash <target>
