_______________________________________________________________________________ "Precognition" This allows a psionicist to fortell the future. "What will I find if I enter the next room?". It will tell the number of inanimate objects, the number of living objects, and how many of those living objects are hostile. SP Cost: 20 Guild Level: 2 Potential Points: 2 Command: precognition <direction>

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Probe" This allows the psionicist to invade a monster's mind for any useful experiences or information it contains. The monster is left permanently mentally scarred. It works once per monster, lowering the monster's experience and raising the psionicist's experience. You will gain less experience when killing a monster that has been probed, but the great advantage is being able to learn something without having to kill the target first. The cost of a probe depends on how tough the opponent is you are trying to probe. SP Cost: Variable Guild Level: 8 Potential Points: 4 Command: probe <target>

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Psionic Prodigy" This is a global power modifier allowing the psionicist to learn new powers more rapidly. It requires planning ahead to use this power effectively. From the point it is learned onwards the psionicist will gain 1 extra purchase point per level. Once learned, this may not be forgotten. SP Cost: none Guild Level: 1 Potential Points: 3 Command: none

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Psionic Profile" A psionicist with psionic profile can alter his "psychic signature" to other psionicists. It simply allows him to change his guild level title displayed in the guild who list. Much more interesting than simply being known as "a Psionicist." SP Cost: 10 Guild Level: 2 Potential Points: 1 Command: profile <new description>

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Project Thought" This is basically an 'area tell'. It projects a thought not to a specific target, but to an entire room full of people. Combined with clairaudience, it allows the psionicist to have conversations from afar with groups of people while he or she is at an entirely different location of Darkwind. SP Cost: 5 Guild Level: 1 Potential Points: 2 Command: project <target> <message>

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Psionic Blast" The workhorse psionicist attack power. It does damage based on guild level with a mental blast. SP Cost: Variable Guild Level: 7 Potential Points: 3 Command: pblast <target>

docs.title: You may get help on the following topics:
docs.text: You may get help on the following topics: psireport - explains the psireport screen advancement - explains how advancement works in the Guild levels - gives the xp and gp chart for levels powers - a quick reference chart to the powers with Guild Level and cost emotes - a list of guild specific emotes concentration - explains the concentration requirement banishment - explains the process for guild punishment You may get help on a particular power using 'phelp <power name>'. just do phelp <topic>. To get a list of psionicists online do 'psions'. For your guild statistics use 'psireport'. To talk or emote on the guild chat line use 'psi' or 'epsi' respectively.

docs.title: Your psireport gives you the necessary information that you need
docs.text: Your psireport gives you the necessary information that you need to make decisions in how and when to advance your character. There is more to the Psionicist Guild than simply earning XP. This will explain what information the psireport gives, and how you can make use of it. First is your psionic profile. This is the description by which other psionicists know you, and is what appears in the 'psions' list. You may alter this through use of the Psionic Profile power. Your guild experience points control when you are eligible to advance your guild level. It is not enough to merely earn the experience required, you must also spend some time at each guild level getting to know your powers. Each time you use a power that costs an amount equal to your current Guild Level or more, you earn 1 or more guild experience points. The more spell points you spend, the more guild experience you earn. Your psionic powers total and psionic potential total tell you how many points you have spent on powers and how many you still have left. You will gain 7 points of psionic potential for each Guild Level you advance, including the first one. Your Psychic Reserve lists how many points you have currently in your reserve to the left of the slash, and how many maximum you can have to the right. See the Psychic Reserve power description for details. Lastly, your psireport maintains 3 lists of powers for you. The first is simply a list of the powers you currently possess. Your mastered powers are those you have used Power Mastery on to increase your abilities. See the Power Mastery power description for details. The last, Eligible Powers, is a list provided for your convenience of the powers you can currently purchase using the 'learn' command at the guild or the Enlightenment power.

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Psychometry" This is the famous "object reading" ability of psychics. It's an identify type power on the mud, displaying any magical info of an object and giving some vague impressions about whether it is a special item or not. It sometimes provides less specific information than a more objective appraisal or mages' identify would, but will often give more overall information than either of them will. You must interpret the messages it gives you well. SP Cost: 30 Guild Level: 3 Potential Points: 2 Command: objectread <object>

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Pyrokinesis" This is the staple attack power for most psionicists in the guild. Unlike most other powers in the guild, it is affected by the regular level of the psionicist using it. It achieves its damage by attempting to psionically set the target afire. A psionicist who has learned this power can also use the reverse effect, Cryokinesis, which does freezing damage. SP Cost: Variable Guild Level: 14 Potential Points: 3 Command: pyro <target> for fire damage cryo <target> for cold damage

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Recall" If a psionicist purchases this ability and uses it while dead they may draw upon the "Psionic Convergence of Minds" to merge them back into a physical body, so that they may continue their adventure from the point at which they died. It costs nothing to use. SP Cost: none Guild Level: 1 Potential Points: 1 Command: recall

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Reduce Weight" This power allows the psionicist to alter the pattern of an object in such a way as to condense and compact it. It works once per item and reduces the item's weight permanently by a random amount influenced, but not determined, by guild level. SP Cost: 75 Guild Level: 7 Potential Points: 2 Command: reduce <object>

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Rejuvenation" This is a healing ability that costs time rather than power points. It is cast with a number of minutes, which will be spent concentrating. At the end of that time, the psionicist will heal an amount of hit points GREATLY influenced by the amount of time spent rejuvenating. Rejuvenating once for 6 minutes will restore an exponentially greater amount than doing it 3 times for 2 minutes each. Of course, any commands given during the concentration period will cancel the power completely and no healing will take place at all. Note that the mental effort necessary to sink into this meditative trance is such that no other power may be used during the rejuvenation time, even if the psionicist cancels the power. The rejuvenation cost in sp is approximately what would be regenerated normally in the same amount of time. SP Cost: Variable Guild Level: 1 Potential Points: 2 Command: rejuvenate <number of minutes>

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Repulsion Field" Through the use of this power, the psionicist can create a telekinetic forcefield behind which he can stand, completely separated from other people and events in the area. The psionicist will be able to look and talk in the room, but cannot pick anything up, attack, or be attacked. Any items or conversation WITHIN the forcefield can be completely separated from those outside. SP Cost: 50 Guild Level: 10 Potential Points: 4 Command: rfield | killfield (To kill a field you have created)

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Psychic Reserve" This gives the Psionicist a 7th stat representing his inner mind. The stat maxes at 12 points. Each point provides a psychic reserve of 25 SP. These points can be withdrawn into regular sp for power casting purposes, but not over the psionicist's normal sp limit. The reserve does not regenerate over time, and must be replenished at a cost of 2 SP per 1 reserve point replaced. Each and every increase of the psychic reserve takes 1 purchase point. Psychic Reserve cannot be 'forgotten' once learned. SP Cost: 2 per point Guild Level: 5 Potential Points: 1 Command: reserve <store/withdraw>

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Psychic Splice" Psychic splice is a global power modifier. This allows the psionicist to splice powers together to perform them as a single action. The splice itself takes 10 spell points per power used inside of it, but in exchange for those sp, the concentration time is completely eliminated! The psionicist prepares the entire sequence in his mind beforehand. Powers within a splice will be less powerful as the Psionicist needs to divide his concentration among the different parts of the splice. The number of powers you can splice at one time is dependant upon your guild level. SP Cost: 10 Guild Level: 7 Potential Points: 4 Command: splice power#power#power

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Telekinetic Storm" This is an impressive attack based on the concepts behind the Ballistic Attack power. The damage it causes is based solely on what you are carrying at the time. It will take everything in your inventory that you aren't wearing or wielding and hurl it at the target in a single, giant telekinetic attack. It can make it either very expensive or very cheap, depending on how much you are carrying at the time. SP Cost: 25 Guild Level: 4 Potential Points: 3 Command: tstorm <target>

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Suggestion" This is an annoyance power for psionicists to use for fun. What it does is place a suggestion in the mind of the target for a couple of minutes depending on guild level. The suggestion is a piece of text set by the psionicist. Whenever the target types something OTHER than the suggested command, the target sees 'For some reason you feel like doing <whatever> instead'. It does not prevent the original command from being performed, though. It's just for fun. SP Cost: 15 Guild Level: 1 Potential Points: 2 Command: suggestion <target> <message/command>

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Telepathic Strike" This is, as the name implies, a telepathic attack. The psionicist must first 'aquire a target' by meeting the monster face to face (ie you must be 'hunting' it.). Like brainwave, the power is an inefficient attack, costing the same as psionic blast but doing less damage. It substitutes pure damage for being able to strike from any distance! SP Cost: Variable Guild Level: 6 Potential Points: 2 Command: tstrike

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Teleport" This power has 3 uses. First, for a flat 75 sp, the psionicist can teleport back to the guild hall. Second, for 10 sp per room, the psionicist can set up a movement path of no more than his glevel worth in rooms, and will appear at the end of the chain without passing through each one. Third, it can be used in conjunction with Mental Beacon to teleport back and forth between a marked area for a short period of time. You may teleport back to your own beacon, or to a shared beacon placed by another Psionicist. Can be used to escape, to move about quickly, to bypass aggressive monsters, to go somewhere without other players knowing where you are going, to aid another Psionicist, etc. SP Cost: 75 / 10 / 150 Guild Level: 13 Potential Points: 5 Command: teleport guild, teleport dir,dir,...,dir, teleport beacon, or teleport <name> beacon (To go to <name>s shared beacon)

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Teleport Object" The psionicist can teleport an object from his location to the location of another player, like the UPS service in the post office. For a slightly higher SP cost, the psionicist can teleport an object to the guild storage room. SP Cost: 20 (40 to guild) Guild Level: 10 Potential Points: 3 Command: telobj <object> to <target>

docs.title: "Guild Chat"
docs.text: "Guild Chat" This allows guild members to talk on the guild channel and is automatically added to the player's power list when joining the guild. Note that it does NOT include the high level guild chat. "Dual Mind" 4 4 This splits the psionicist's mind into two separate, working halves allowing him to collect his thoughts faster. It is a global power modifier that reduces concentration time of all powers automatically. "Detonate" : 1 1 This allows the psionicist to telekinetically break the pattern holding matter together. It destructs any droppable, stealable object the player is carrying (so it must have been gettable too). "Psionic Blast" : 5 3 The workhorse psionicist attack power. It does damabe based on guild level with a mental blast and costs 5 * guild level in SP. "Suggestion" : 2 2 This is an annoyance power for psionicists to use for fun. What it does is place a suggestion in the mind of the target for a couple of minutes depending on guild level. The suggestion is a piece of text set by the psionicist. Whenever the target types something OTHER than the suggested command, the target sees 'For some reason you feel like doing <whatever> instead'. It does not prevent the original command from being performed, though. It's just for fun. "Precognition" : 2 2 This allows a psionicist to fortell the future. "What will I find if I enter the next room?". It will tell them the number of inanimate objects, the number of living objects, and how many of those living objects are hostile to them (ie aggressive npcs). "Clairvoyance" : 2 1 This allows the psionicist to see the location of a target within his mind. It displays the room description (including contents) of the target's location. "Clairaudience" : 2 2 This places a "presence" in a room. The presence is like a monster which can neither attack nor be attacked and it will whatever it "hears" to the psionicist. Note the presence IS visible so it is not a means of invading privacy. "Enhance" : 3 2 This is a global power modifier. Casting it before another power costs 10 sp and focuses the psionicist's mental energy, giving a guild level increase for purposes of damage, duration, etc of the next power used. "Limit" : 3 2 This is the opposite of Enhance. Its cost is free and it reduces the psionicist's guild level for his next power. Useful for reducing the cost of glevel dependent powers when you don't need the full effect. "Probe" : 11 4 This allows the psionicist to invade a monster's mind for any useful experiences or information it contains. The monster is left permanently mentally scarred. It works once per monster, lowering the monster's experience and raising the psionicist's experience. You will gain less experience when killing a monster that has been probed, but the great advantage is being able to learn something without having to kill the target first. The cost of a probe depends on how tough the opponent is you are trying to probe. "Ultrablast" : 18 7 This is the ultimate psionic attack. It hurls a blast of mental energy every couple seconds for a length of time dependent on guild level. The power of each individual blast is also dependent on guild level. The power is taxing on the mind, costing 15 * glevel. "Brainwave" : 8 3 This sends a mental wave through the room hitting everyone in its wake. It has a low efficiency, costing 5 * guild level like a psionic blast but doing less damage to each individual target but it will hit every monster (and player, except the psionicist) in the room. Does less damage to pc's and pets. "Mindlink" : 1 1 This allows the psionicist to use his telepathic powers to send messages to others. Effectively a 2 sp tell. A nice guild perk (once it has been bought) in keeping with the psionicist theme. "Teleport" : 5 4 This power has 2 uses. First, for a flat 75 sp, the psionicist can teleport back to the guild hall. Second, for 10 sp per room, the psionicist can set up a movement path of no more than his glevel worth in rooms, and will appear at the end of the chain without passing through each one. If at any point the path is blocked, the entire power fails. Can be used to escape, to move about quickly, to bypass aggressive monsters, to go somewhere without other players knowing where you are going, etc. "Animate Weapon" : 15 4 This allows a psionicist to cause a weapon to pick itself up and wield itself in battle! One of the most useful combat spells in the guild. It has a duration and hit points of the weapon dependent on the psionicist's guild level. The psionicist must stay in the same room but may perform other powers, attack the monster himself, or whatever. Another great advantage of this power is that it is not subject to weapon restrictions. A weapon not normally usable by the guild MAY be animated. The spell costs 1 sp per second it will be in effect, and if the animated weapon "dies", it will be permanently broken. "Inertial Barrier" : 6 3 A simple protective power. For a length of time dependent on the psionicist's guild level, the target receives a shielding of mental energy which will increase armor. Costs 4 per guild level. "Rejuvenation" : 2 4 This is a healing ability that costs time rather than power points. It is cast with a number of minutes, which will be spent concentrating. At the end of that time, the psionicist will heal an amount of hit points GREATLY influenced by the amount of time spent rejuvenating. Rejuvenating once for 6 minutes will restore an exponentially greater amount than doing it 3 times for 2 minutes each. Of course, any commands given during the conentration period will cancel the power completely and no healing will take place at all. The rejuvenation cost in sp is approximately what would be regenerated normally in the same amount of time. "Adrenaline Control" : 5 2 The psionicist alters the flow of adrenaline in hos own body to provide himself with short boosts of speed or strength. For twice glevel in sp, the psionicist gets a temporary increase in either strength or dexterity based on guild level. "Damage Absorption" : 3 3 The idea of this power is it allows the psionicist to alter his own aura to absorb kinetic energy. The power costs 5 * guild level and adds about 100 hit points which will fade over time, very quickly at low guild levels but slower and slower as guild level rises. "Displace" : 13 4 This power allows the psionicist to create an image of himself in people's minds while he himself is actually a short distance away! The effect of the power is to create a 'dummy' of the psionicist that does not attack but draws the attacks of any opponents, who believe it to be the original psionicist. This is a very powerful ability. After a length of time dependent on guild level, the opponents will realize their mistake and begin attacking the real psionicist again. It costs a flat 50 sp. "Double Pain" : 9 2 This power allows the psionicist to temporarily alter the pain sense in a target. It does no damage in and of itself, but it makes the target so sensitive to pain that NO amount of armor will protect it from damage at all. It costs a flat 60 SP and lasts a variable amount of time according to the psionicist's guild level. This is a powerful addition to a psionicists' arsenal and players are urged not to overlook it simply because it doesn't blast anything by itself. "Lend Health" : 2 2 This allows the psionicist to lend some of his life energy over to another person. It's not healing, it is rather a transfer of wounds. It restores 10 hp to the target while subtracting 10 hp and 15 sp from the psionicist. "Banish" : 17 6 An expensive but powerful effect, the target of the power will be teleported away to otherdimensial space unless it resists the spell. Such strenous mental efforts cannot be maintained long, howeve, and the target will soon return to Darkwind. Make good use of the time provided to search, move on, or escape! "Timeshift" : 15 4 It allows the psionicist to alter his own flow of time to speed it up. It allows the psionicist to make several melee attacks immediately (the number of extra attacks depending on guild level) , but does not give any bonuses to any of these attacks. It costs 4 * glevel. "Awe" : 2 1 This temporarily increases the psionicist's personal magnetism by a large margin. Adds an amount of charima dependent on guild level for a short length of time. It is mostly useful for obtaining better prices when selling treasure, but with some planning it is possible to immediately regenerate the cost of the spell before the effects wear off, thus increasing your spell points for a short while. You'll have to be fast and have a good plan to accomplish this, however. It takes guild level * 2 sp. "Alter Aura" : 3 1 This allows the psionicist to do just what it says. The psionicist is displayed the alignment choices of demonic, evil, nasty, neutral, nice, good, and saintly and can pick which one to become. Of course future actions will immediately begin to alter this. As the psionicist guild does not depend on alignments at all this is largely a roleplaying power. However, it can be used to simultaneously wield magic items requiring wildly different alingments. Such is the power of the mind. It takes a flat 15 sp. "Psychic Reserve" : 7 1 This gives the Psionicist a 7th stat representing his inner mind. The stat maxes at 25 points. Each point provides a psychic reserve of 12 SP. These points can be withdrawn into regular sp for power casting purposes, but not over the psionicist's normal sp limit. The reserve does not regenerate over time, and must be replenished at a cost of 2 SP per 1 reserve point replaced. Each and every increase of the psychic reserve takes 1 purchase point. "Judge" : 3 2 This allows the psionicist to "look deep into another person's eyes and see their soul". It will tell you how far they have advanced within their guild and compare their stats to yours if the target is a player character, and it will estimate how you would fare in combat against the target if it is a monster. Note that it judges purely from a one on one physical confrontation. The psionicist has access to a host of powers the opponent does not and the ability to retreat and heal which most monster do not have. On the other hand, some monsters possess special attacks or abilities which judge will also not factor into things. However, it is a good way to get a general feeling for how tough a monster is, or how far advanced another player is compared to you. It costs 15 sp. "Obscure" : 13 3 This allows the psionicist to mentally obscure his image in others' minds. It is not complete invisibility, it simply changes changes the psionicist's description to "something in the corner of your eye" for a short time. It costs 10 + glevel * 3 SP. They may know someone's there but they won't know who it is unless your own description gives it away. "Teleport Object" : 3 3 The psionicist can teleport an object from his location to the location of another player, like the ups service in the post office. It costs 20 sp. "Ballistic Attack" : 1 1 This allows the psionicist to hurl a small object at superhigh speeds into a target. The object must contain within it a spark of mental energy implanted for the psionicist to contact. The guild shop sells rocks with this special modification made to them for 5 coins apiece. The power is the newbie psionicist attack power, doing a small amount of damage but being extremely cheap in SP and having a very low concentration time. "Mental Blow" : 3 2 This sends a hammering blow of force directly into the mind of the target. It does a base amount of damage slightly dependent upon regular level and does a further random amount based on guild level. It is an all around attack power cheaper and faster than psionic blast. "Pyrokinesis" : 1 2 This is the guild level 1 attack power recommended for those who have switched guilds into the Psionicists rather than joined as a newbie. It has a longer concentration time and much higher cost than Ballistic Attack so it requires a character who can stand up to some punishment and fuel a spell costing 3 * their character level. Unlike any other power in the guild, its effects are based SOLELY upon regular level and not dependent upon guild level at all. It achieves its damage by attempting to psionically set the target afire. "Crystalize" : 2 2 A psionicist with this power can create the crystals the Crystal shop sells himself from the life energy remaining a corpse. This is difficult, however, and doesn't always work. The quality of the crystal created depends on a random chance dependent on guild level. A successful attempt, no matter what the quality of the crystal resulting, costs 40 sp. If the attempt fails outright the corpse is still destroyed and the failed attempt costs 5 sp. "Power Mastery" : 12 3 This is a global power modifier allowing psionicists to become masters of X, where X is one of the other powers. The power mastery ability itself must first be bought, then each individual power must be individually mastered. There are 3 levels of mastery. The first causes all uses of the power to be automatically under the influence of enhance and costs 1 purchase point. The second causes all uses of the power to additionally be under the influence of dual mind and costs 2 more purchase points. The last reduces the sp cost of the power by a percentage of its normal cost and costs an additional 3 purchase points. Note that these benefits are in ADDITION to any enhance or dual mind which might might already be in effect! "Reduce Weight" : 4 2 This power allows the psionicist to alter the pattern of an object as in destruct, but in this case to condense and compact it. It works once per item and reduces the item's weight permanently by a random amount influenced, but not determined, by guild level. It has a flat cost of 75 sp. "Psychic Crush" : 6 5 This is the randomized equivalent to psionic blast, for those who are feeling lucky. It costs the same but whereas psionic blast does a flat amount damage, psychic crush does a random amount. So the psionicist could get lucky and do extra damage for the same amount of sp. "Telekinetic Storm" : 7 3 This is an impressive attack based on the concepts behind the Ballistic Attack power. The damage it causes is based solely on what you are carrying at the time. It will take everything in your inventory that you aren't wearing or wielding and hurl it at the target in a single, giant telekinetic attack. It costs a flat 25 sp, which can make it either very expensive or very cheap, depending on how much you are carrying at the time. "Inflict Pain" : 12 2 This allows the psionicist to generate artificial feelings of pain in the target. It does no actual damage, but the target will act as if his str and dex were much lower due to the intense crippling effects of the power. It has a variable duration based on guild level and costs a flat 40 points. "Repulsion Field" : 13 4 This power is not yet available. To give a preview, for 50 spell points it will create a forcefield behind which the psionicst can stand completely separated from others in the area. The psionicist will be able to look and talk in the room, but cannot pick anything up, attack, or be attacked. Any items or conversation WITHIN the forcefield can be completely separated from those outside. "Project Thought" : 2 2 This is basically an 'area tell'. It projects a thought not to a specific target, but to an entire room full of people. Combined with clairaudience, it allows the psionicist to have conversations from afar with groups of people while he or she is at an entirely different location of Darkwind. It costs 5 SP per use. "Thought Shield" : 8 2 This protects the psionicist from energy attacks. The shield may also be cast on an adventuring compainion. It offers good psi resistance and some, but not a lot, of magic resistance for a length of time based on guild level. The amount of protection also goes up with guild level. Costs 4 * guild level. "Recall" : 5 2 If a psionicist purchases this ability and uses it while dead they will be transported back to the guild and the "Psionic Convergence of Minds" will merge them back into a physical body. It costs nothing to use. <this power is currently not through testing yet> "Enlighten" : 1 2 This allows the psionicist to have sudden enlightening psychic realizations. It allows the psionicist to perform the cost and advance functions of the guild hall from other locations on the mud. "Grand Master Chat" : 18 1 This allows the person to join the elite of the psionicists, being able to participate on the Hipsi chat line and enter the Grand Masters' bulletin board room. As of this writing, no psionicist has achieved Grand Master status. "Psychometry" : 3 2 This is the famous "object reading" ability of psychics. It's an identify type power on the mud, displaying any magical info of an object and giving some vague impressions about whether it is a special item or not. It sometimes provides less specific information than a more objective appraisal or mages' identify would, but will often give more overall information than either of them will. You must interpret the messages it gives you well. It takes 30 SP. "Emotion Control" : 10 3 This allows the psionicist to telepathically alter the emotions of creatures. For a short time, it will make a peaceful monster aggressive, or an aggressive monster peaceful. The monster's original attitude then returns. Note that this is a GENERAL attitude change. If the monster is already fighting someone, it won't stop fighting that particular character. This is an unusual power that has many creative uses. It costs 15 SP. "Telepathic Strike" : 8 3 This is, as the name implies, a telepathic attack. The psionicist must first 'aquire a target' by meeting the monster face to face (ie you must be 'hunting' it.). Like brainwave, the power is an inefficient attack, costing the same as psionic blast but doing less damage. It substitutes pure damage for being able to strike from any distance! "Psionic Prodigy" : 1 3 This is a global power modifier allowing the psionicist to learn new powers more rapidly. It requires planning ahead to use this power effectively. From the point it is learned onwards the psionicist will gain 1 extra purchase point per level. Since "Imprint" : 1 1 This imprints an object with the psionicist's "psychic signature". If cast in most places on the mud it will last a temporary amount of time dependent on guild level. If cast in the storage room of the Psionicist Guild it has a permanent duration (until the item is next picked up). What it is not allow anybody but the psionicist to pick up the item. "Channel" : 3 2 The channelling power allows a psionicist to send his own mental energy to others. Each use of the power will restore 10 spell points (but no hp) to another player, but will cost the psionicist 15 himself. "Psionic Profile" : 3 1 A psionicist with psionic profile can alter his "psychic signature" to other psionicists. It simply allows him to change his guild level title displayed in the guild who list. Much more interesting than simply being known as "a Psionicist." "Psychic Splice" : 10 4 Psychic splice is a global power modifier. This allows the psionicist to splice powers together to perform them as a single action. The splice itself takes 10 spell points charged between each power usage, but in exchange for those sp, the concentration time is completely eliminated! The psionicist prepares the entire sequence in his mind beforehand.

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Thought Shield" This protects the psionicist from energy attacks. The shield may also be cast on an adventuring companion. It offers good psi resistance and some, but not a lot, of magic resistance for a length of time based on guild level. The amount of protection also goes up with guild level. SP Cost: Variable Guild Level: 5 Potential Points: 1 Command: tshield <target>

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Timeshift" This power allows the psionicist to slow down the flow of time around him. Lasting a few combat rounds, it allows the psionicist to make more melee swings then normal, and helps them dodge incoming melee attacks a little better. A psionicist may not have more then one timeshift running for himself at any one time due to the complexities of manipulating the speed of time itself. SP Cost: Variable Guild Level: 12 Potential Points: 4 Command: timeshift

_______________________________________________________________________________ "Ultrablast" This is the ultimate psionic attack. It hurls a blast of mental energy every couple seconds for a length of time dependent on guild level. The power of each individual blast is also dependent on guild level. This power is taxing on the mind. SP Cost: Variable Guild Level: 15 Potential Points: 7 Command: ultrablast <target>

docs.title: Ranger Help for: adapt
docs.text: Ranger Help for: adapt ====================== SYNTAX: adapt <arctic/desert> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 6 BASE SP: 30 SKILL TYPE: defensive SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to adapt their body to extreme climates, reducing the environmental damage caused by harsh arctic cold or scorching desert heat. The Ranger must specify which climate to adapt to. The adaptation lasts for a duration that depends on the Ranger's constitution and skill level. Only one adaptation can be active at a time. This skill is essential for Rangers who venture into the most extreme terrains of Darkwind.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: advancement
docs.text: Ranger Help for: advancement ============================ SUMMARY: Rangers advance through guild levels 1 to 15. Each guild level grants slots that you spend to learn new skills. Higher guild levels give more slots per level (4 at level 1, up to 20 at level 15). BEFORE YOU CAN ADVANCE: You must set all three of these first (one-time choices): setprime <terrain> Your primary terrain setsecond <terrain> Your secondary terrain setenemy <race> Your enemy species HOW TO ADVANCE: Ranger guild levels are earned automatically with Ranger XP from battle. The lodge and your quiver report your progress: rcost See Ranger XP and slot progress radvance level Advance your game level (costs experience) radvance guild See Ranger XP and any blocked advancement radvance <stat> Raise str, dex, con, int, wis, or chr These commands require you to be in the wilderness (not a city, indoors, or at a dock). You can also use 'advance' and 'cost' when visiting the lodge. Your guild level cannot exceed your game level. So to reach guild level 5, you need to be at least game level 5. LEARNING SKILLS: Once you have slots, spend them on skills: skilltree See the full skill tree learn See what skills you can learn right now learn <skill> Learn a skill (costs slots) learn cost <skill> Check the cost before committing Skills have prerequisites - learning one skill unlocks others. Start with 'forage' (your first available skill) and branch out from there. Use 'skilltree' to plan your path. COST FACTORS: - Skill slots are the only cost for learning Ranger skills. - Skills cost more SP to use outside your primary/secondary terrain. - Alignment far from neutral increases SP costs for all skills. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: glevels, slots, skills, skilltree

docs.title: Ranger Help for: aim
docs.text: Ranger Help for: aim ==================== SYNTAX: aim <target> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: variable SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to take careful aim with a bow at a target that is not currently in combat. The longer the Ranger aims, the more damage the shot will deal when released. Aim is interrupted if the Ranger moves, is attacked, or enters combat. The SP cost scales with the time spent aiming. Requires a bow to be wielded and an arrow to be readied.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: alignment
docs.text: Ranger Help for: alignment ========================== SUMMARY: Rangers are traditionally neutral in alignment, walking the line between good and evil, order and chaos. This reflects their role as guardians of the natural balance rather than champions of any particular cause. While Rangers are not strictly required to maintain a neutral alignment, straying too far from neutrality will increase the spell point cost of many skills. Nature does not judge, but it responds best to those who walk in balance. A Ranger's declared alignment should ideally remain close to neutral. Rangers who become too good or too evil may find their connection to Gaia weakened, making their abilities more costly to use. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: stats, philosophy, conduct

docs.title: Ranger Help for: ambush
docs.text: Ranger Help for: ambush ======================= SYNTAX: ambush <target> USAGE: forest,plains,swamp,desert,jungle,hills,road,beach, underground,mountain,arctic,barren SLOT COST: 12 BASE SP: 70 SKILL TYPE: offensive SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to launch a devastating surprise attack from concealment. The Ranger must be concealed before using this skill. The sudden, brutal strike catches the target off guard and deals heavy damage. The effectiveness of the ambush depends on the Ranger's strength, dexterity, and skill level. Ambush is one of the most powerful melee attacks available to a Ranger, but it requires careful preparation and the right conditions to execute.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: animal lure
docs.text: Ranger Help for: animal lure ============================= SYNTAX: lure <race> USAGE: Wilderness SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 40 SKILL TYPE: husbandry SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to lure a temporary wild animal to their location by mimicking its calls and scent. The lured animal will fight alongside the Ranger for a limited time before wandering off. The type of animal that can be lured depends on the terrain. Unlike a bonded follower, a lured animal is not permanent and cannot be trained. This skill is useful when the Ranger needs temporary combat assistance.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: use herbs
docs.text: Ranger Help for: use herbs =========================== SYNTAX: apply <herb> [to <target>] USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 5 BASE SP: variable SKILL TYPE: healing SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to apply gathered herbs to heal wounds or cure ailments. Different herbs have different effects, and a skilled Ranger learns to identify and use them effectively. The Ranger can apply herbs to themselves or to another player. The effectiveness of the treatment depends on the Ranger's wisdom, skill level, and the quality of the herbs used. Herbs can be found through foraging.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: archery
docs.text: Ranger Help for: archery ======================== SUMMARY: One of the identifying characteristics of a Ranger is his or her bow. Once a Ranger gains enough potential as a Ranger, he or she may learn how to make various bows as well as ammo for the bows. They will also learn ways to enhance arrows and bolts to make them more accurate or harder hitting. Extremely proficient Rangers will learn special skills that increase the lethality of their bows. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: weapons

docs.title: Ranger Help for: archery
docs.text: Ranger Help for: archery ======================== SUMMARY: One of the identifying characteristics of a Ranger is his or her bow. Once a Ranger gains enough potential as a Ranger, he or she may learn how to make various bows as well as ammo for the bows. They will also learn ways to enhance arrows and bolts to make them more accurate or harder hitting. Extremely proficient Rangers will learn special skills that increase the lethality of their bows. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: weapons

docs.title: Ranger Help for: arctic
docs.text: Ranger Help for: arctic ======================= SUMMARY: Cold and windy are the characteristics of the arctic environment. Arctic terrains are harsh, hence not many Rangers live there. Some of the skills of a Ranger won't work, due to its extreme nature. Arctic terrains are found mostly in the northern cold of Hyperborea. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: Individual terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: arcticsurvival
docs.text: Ranger Help for: arcticsurvival ================================ SYNTAX: arcticsurvival arctic survival USAGE: Hyperborea and other extreme arctic terrain SLOT COST: 14 BASE SP: 10 SKILL TYPE: cartography SUMMARY: This skill toggles arctic survival instincts on or off. When active, the Ranger reads snow, wind, exposure, and shelter well enough to avoid the punishing Hyperborean cold that normally forces travelers to rely on warmth protection. Use this before crossing Hyperborea's frozen roads, tunnels, icefields, and wilderness. Toggle it again to relax those instincts. SEE ALSO: desert survival, rest, guide, terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: armour
docs.text: Ranger Help for: armour ======================= SUMMARY: Rangers are free to wear almost all armour. The only armours they have trouble getting by in is plate or platemail armours. Mainly because it is so clanky and noisey, kind of takes away any surprise a stealthy Ranger might have. Chainmail armours are still somewhat noisey, but not to the point of being restrictive. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: weapons

docs.title: Ranger Help for: armour
docs.text: Ranger Help for: armour ======================= SUMMARY: Rangers are free to wear almost all armour. The only armours they have trouble getting by in is plate or platemail armours. Mainly because it is so clanky and noisey, kind of takes away any surprise a stealthy Ranger might have. Chainmail armours are still somewhat noisey, but not to the point of being restrictive. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: weapons

docs.title: Ranger Help for: assess
docs.text: Ranger Help for: assess ======================= SYNTAX: assess <target> USAGE: Any terrain. SLOT COST: 2 BASE SP: 10 SUMMARY: Evaluate a target creature, sizing up its strength, weapons, and defenses. Information revealed depends on your guild level: higher ranked Rangers glean more detail. This is a prerequisite for the calm and strike skill branches. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: inspect, calm, strike

docs.title: Ranger Help for: assess
docs.text: Ranger Help for: assess ======================= SYNTAX: assess <opponent> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 1 BASE SP: 2*GLEVEL+5 SKILL TYPE: knowledge SUMMARY: This allows a Ranger to assess his or her opponent up against themselves. It will match up your ratings against your opponent's and give you some idea of how hard it would be to kill. It also shows if your opponent is of your enemy race or not. 'Assess' does not take into account your primary and secondary terrains, in which in most cases you have an advanatage over your opponents.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: attract
docs.text: Ranger Help for: attract ======================== SYNTAX: attract follower USAGE: Primary terrain or claimed Ranger domain SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 50 SKILL TYPE: husbandry SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to attract and bond with a wild animal as a permanent companion. The Ranger must be in their primary terrain or within their claimed Ranger domain for this skill to work. The type of animal attracted depends on the Ranger's primary terrain. Once bonded, the follower will fight alongside the Ranger, can be trained with commands, and will follow the Ranger between rooms. Each Ranger has a limited number of followers in their lifetime - if too many die, no more will come. Choose your battles wisely to protect your companion.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: attract
docs.text: Ranger Help for: attract ======================== SYNTAX: attract follower/attract <race> follower USAGE: primary terrain only SLOT COST: 9 BASE SP: variable SKILL TYPE: follower SUMMARY: Once a Ranger gains this ability, he or she may attract a friend follower from any room that has his or her primary terrain in it. Followers come in all shapes and sizes, from ants to elephants. Some are smarter than others, some are stronger than others. What comes out of the wilderness to aid you is dependent on what your primary terrain is. IE: You won't get a seal if your primary terrain is desert. Once you attract a follower, you will get the same one until it dies. As you increase your level, its level will go up along side of you. Each follower has a max level that it can achieve, which will affect things such as fighting or carrying weight. Each follower is also rated on how smart and trainable it is. All followers can learn at least one task, some can learn two, and the smartest ones can learn three. Some tasks are too tough for some followers to learn as well. A list of tasks are: Easy Tasks: slay, burden and guard Medium Tasks: fetch, carry and obscure Difficult Tasks: explore, hunt and forage Tasks are very handy, and helpful to a Ranger. For more detail on each task, type 'rh <task name>' and 'rh teach'. IMPORTANT NOTE: Each Ranger has a set amount of followers that will come to his or her aid over time that is determined at join time. Everytime a Ranger allows a follower to die, you get one closer to that number. Once a Ranger has let his or personal number of followers die, no followers will ever come to the Ranger's aid again! And, if you teach a follower a task, and then let it die, you will have to reteach it to the next follower if it is capable of learning it. You are guaranteed at least 2 followers, but after that be wary and take care of your follower. YOU HAVE BEEN WARNED.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: attune
docs.text: Ranger Help for: attune ======================= SYNTAX: attune <target> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 43 SKILL TYPE: religious SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to attune to a target's elemental weakness through a brief communion with Gaia. Once attuned, the Ranger's attacks will exploit that weakness for increased damage. Attunement lasts for a limited duration and can only be active on one target at a time. This is a religious skill, requiring devotion to Gaia to use effectively.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: balance weapon
docs.text: Ranger Help for: balance weapon ================================ SYNTAX: balance <weapon> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 4 BASE SP: 15 SKILL TYPE: creation SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to carefully adjust the balance of a weapon, improving its accuracy in combat. The weapon must be non-magical for the Ranger to work with it. The degree of improvement depends on the Ranger's skill level and dexterity. A well-balanced weapon can make the difference between a hit and a miss in the heat of battle.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: barren
docs.text: Ranger Help for: barren ======================= SUMMARY: The barren terrain is just that barren. Its not void of life, but you would think it is if you ever saw it. In fact, Ranger's that live in the barren environment never know what kind of follower they will get, it could be anything. Due to its extreme nature, the Ranger population in this terrain is the smallest, other than water terrains. Skills use is limited here, and there aren't many areas in the realms that are barren, athough there are a few. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: Individual terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: beach
docs.text: Ranger Help for: beach ====================== SUMMARY: Beaches are any area where water meets land. It could be the side of a lake, river of sea. They are usually have similar characteristics no matter the water source, such as water erosion, marine animals and plants. The Ranger population on beaches is fairly small, but beaches can be found on all of the continents. Ranger skills are somewhat limited on beaches. The only exception is the port, ports join land to water but are not considered beaches. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: Individual terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: bio
docs.text: Ranger Help for: bio ==================== SYNTAX: bio bio <text> USAGE: Anywhere. SUMMARY: View or set your personal Ranger biography. Your bio is a short description of your character's background. Without an argument, shows your current bio. With text, sets a new bio (max 500 chars). Also accessible as 'myinfo'. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: motto, rangers

docs.title: Ranger Help for: bringword
docs.text: Ranger Help for: bringword =========================== SYNTAX: bringword on <player> USAGE: Wilderness SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 60 SKILL TYPE: husbandry SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to send a small animal scout to find another player and report back with their location. The animal will seek out the target player and return with information about where they are. The Ranger must be in wilderness terrain to call upon a scout animal. The time it takes for the scout to return depends on how far away the target player is. This skill is useful for locating friends or tracking targets.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: bringword
docs.text: Ranger Help for: bringword ========================== SYNTAX: bringword on <player> USAGE: forest,plains,swamp,desert,jungle,hills,sea,lake,river,road, beach,underground,mountain,arctic,barren,outside,port SLOT COST: 13 BASE SP: 60 sp SKILL TYPE: knowledge SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to call upon his friends of the wild to go out and search for a target player and return with a report of his or her whereabouts. You will never know exactly where the target is relative to you other than if he or she is close to you, on the continent, or not.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: call
docs.text: Ranger Help for: call ===================== See: rcall The 'call' command is an alias for the 'rcall' skill. Type 'rhelp rcall' for full details on summoning your animal follower.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: calm animal
docs.text: Ranger Help for: calm animal ============================= SYNTAX: calm <target> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 9 BASE SP: 45 SKILL TYPE: defensive SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to use a nature-like demeanor to overcome an animal's aggression and calm it. A calmed animal stops attacking, and anything attacking the animal also stops. There is a chance the animal may become frightened and resume attacking. A Ranger cannot calm an animal that belongs to their enemy species. The success rate depends on the Ranger's charisma and skill level.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: calm
docs.text: Ranger Help for: calm ===================== SYNTAX: calm <target> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 9 BASE SP: 45 sp SKILL TYPE: defensive SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to use his nature-like behavior to overcome hesitation by animals and calm it. A calmed animal stops attacking, and anything attacking the animal stops attacking. There is a chance that the animal will get scared and start attacking again. A Ranger cannot calm his or her enemy race.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: camoflage
docs.text: Ranger Help for: camoflage ========================== SYNTAX: camo camoflage USAGE: Wilderness SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 55 SKILL TYPE: stealth SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to use advanced natural camouflage to become nearly invisible in wilderness terrain. Camoflage provides a higher level of concealment than the basic conceal skill, making the Ranger much harder to detect. The Ranger must not be in combat to activate this skill. Moving or attacking will break the camouflage. This skill is ideal for setting up ambushes or bypassing dangerous areas unseen.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: camoflage (camo)
docs.text: Ranger Help for: camoflage (camo) ================================= SYNTAX: camoflage/camoflage <target> USAGE: forest,plains,swamp,desert,jungle,hills,road,beach, mountain,arctic,barren,outside,underground SLOT COST: 11 BASE SP: 35 sp SKILL TYPE: defensive SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to conceal him or herself in the surrounding terrain. A Ranger can also conceal other players as well. Any concealed player will remain concealed until they perform any action besides: (look,users,sc,hp,inv,i,inventory,who,rangers,ran or eran). Any commands besides the ones listed here will cause the player to become unconcealed. A concealed player is invisible to all players except for Rangers that have a higher wisdom and wizards+.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: camp
docs.text: Ranger Help for: camp ===================== SUMMARY: Set up a persistent camp at your current location. Your camp becomes your login point - when you log back in, you'll appear at your camp instead of the guild lodge. Other Rangers can see where your camp is and can visit using 'trailblaze to camp <name>'. Your tent will show your name so others know whose camp it is. USAGE: camp Set up camp (requires unpacked tent) camp break Break camp and return login to the lodge camp stores Review wildcraft supplies and camp stores camp stock Turn field supplies into camp supplies camp cook <food> Cook a temporary meal for the road camp brew <drink> Brew a temporary drink for the road camp tend Recover hit points and spell points at camp camp ward Raise a temporary defensive camp ward TRAVEL: rest camp Return to your own camp from anywhere trailblaze to camp <name> Visit another ranger's camp camps List all registered ranger camps REQUIREMENTS: - Must be in the wilderness (not city, indoors, or dock) - An unpacked tent must be in the room - You can only have one camp at a time - Stocking, cooking, tending, and warding require being at your own camp HOW TO SET UP CAMP: 1. Learn the 'make rope' and 'make tent' skills 2. Go to a grassy area: make rope 3. Go to a wooded area: make tent 4. Drop your packed tent: drop tent 5. Set it up: unpack tent 6. Establish camp: camp Your tent will update to show "A makeshift tent (owned by <Name>)" so other Rangers know whose camp this is. RANGER NOMAD LIFE: Rangers are wilderness nomads. Your camp is your home base in the wild. Other Rangers can visit your camp, and you can visit theirs. Use 'camps' to see all active camps, and 'rscore' to see your own. SURVIVAL USE: Use forage, mine, quarry, and skin to gather wildcraft supplies. Camp stock turns kindling, clean water, and binding fiber into camp supplies. If your forage pouch fills with supplies you do not need, use 'forage stores' to review it and 'forage discard <component> [amount]' to free room. Cooking, brewing, tending, and stocking camp also consume wildcraft supplies. Fish traps add fish catch to your camp stores. Fish catch is used by fish stew and hunter feast. Cooked foods: camp cook trail cakes camp cook smoked meat camp cook fish stew camp cook hunter feast Brewed drinks: camp brew spring tea camp brew bark tonic camp brew smokeleaf infusion camp brew ranger draught Cooked and brewed supplies scale with Ranger wilderness skill and level, but they are field provisions: they do not save over logout or reboot. Camp tend consumes fresh camp supplies, clean water, and medicinal scraps for recovery while you are at your own camp. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: camps, rest, trailblaze, make, rscore

docs.title: Ranger Help for: camp
docs.text: Ranger Help for: camp ===================== SYNTAX: camp USAGE: forest,plains,swamp,desert,jungle,hills,road,beach, underground,mountain,arctic,barren,outside SLOT COST: 1 BASE SP: 1/4 max sp SKILL TYPE: aid SUMMARY: Rangers do not have a guild hall. All of the wilderness is their guild hall. As a result, Rangers do not have a place that they can take their stuff and store while they are away. But being the masters of the wild that they are, Rangers have learned how to rough it in the outdoors. When a Ranger 'camps', they create a small campsite and makeshift tent. In it they store their stuff so when they come back, its all redy for them to explore. Camping also saves a Rangers position. Campsites won't last over reboots.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: camps
docs.text: Ranger Help for: camps ====================== SYNTAX: camps USAGE: Anywhere. SUMMARY: List all registered Ranger camps. Shows the name of each Ranger who has a camp and the location where it's set up. Use 'trailblaze to camp <name>' to visit another Ranger's camp. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: camp, trailblaze, rest

docs.title: Ranger Help for: carve
docs.text: Ranger Help for: carve ====================== See: carvebow The 'carve' command is used for carving bows. Type 'rhelp carvebow' for full details on bow crafting, including wood requirements and bow types available.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: carve bow
docs.text: Ranger Help for: carve bow ========================== SYNTAX: carve <shortbow/crossbow/longbow> USAGE: forest,jungle,swamp SLOT COST: 10 BASE SP: 60 sp SKILL TYPE: bow SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to carve one of three types of bows from wooded areas. The three bows are shortbow, longbow and crossbow. Each has its advantages and disadvantages as well as more advanced special attacks for each. The shortbow, loads faster, but hits with less power. The longbow hits pretty hard, but takes longer to load. Both the shortbow and longbow use arrows. The crossbow hits the hardest, and takes the longest to load. Crossbows use bolts to fire. As a Ranger's level goes up, so does his or her ability to carve a bow. The quality of a bow affects how well a Ranger shoots it, as well as how tough it is in hand to hand combat. When used in hand to hand combat, a bow becomes something more akin to a staff, so it is weapon spec'ed as a medium blunt weapon. Ammo for the bows can be carved from wooded areas as well, provided the Ranger knows the skill carve arrow. Once arrows and bolts have been carved, they can be enhanced with several other Ranger skills. Once a bow has been carved. You need to specify where you want to load ammo from by typing 'load from <container>' where container can be the name of a container you have, such as your quiver, or from 'me', which loads arrows from the arrows you are holding in your hands. The best arrows or bolts you have are automatically used first and you can change from what container you wish to load from at any time. Too fire your bow at someone, type 'fire <target>' and you will either score a hit or miss. Arrows and bolts can be reused if you get them back by slaying your opponent or picking up arrows or bolts that you shot and missed with.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: carve torch
docs.text: Ranger Help for: carve torch ============================ SYNTAX: carve torch USAGE: forest,jungle,swamp,plains SLOT COST: 2 BASE SP: 10 sp SKILL TYPE: creation SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to carve of a torch from any wooded area. The Ranger must have a slash type weapon in order to carve the torch, and how long the torch lasts depends on how wise a Ranger is. Whether or not the Ranger knows whats kinds of woods are better than others, things like what shape makes a good torch.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: carve bow
docs.text: Ranger Help for: carve bow =========================== SYNTAX: make bow make shortbow make longbow make crossbow carve bow carve shortbow carve longbow carve crossbow USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 7 BASE SP: 70 SKILL TYPE: archery SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to craft one of three temporary ranged weapons from wood: shortbow, longbow, or crossbow. The quality of the bow depends on the Ranger's wilderness training and mental/physical crafting ability. Shortbows are suited to fast archery and furyfire. Longbows are suited to longfire. Crossbows are slower, hit harder, use bolts, and are required for heartshot.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: ceremony
docs.text: Ranger Help for: ceremony ========================= SYNTAX: ceremony USAGE: Wilderness only SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: variable SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to perform a sacred ceremony to Gaia in the wilderness. The ceremony strengthens the Ranger's connection to the natural world and grants blessings that vary based on the terrain and the Ranger's devotion. The SP cost depends on the type of ceremony performed. This is a religious skill that can only be performed outside of combat in wilderness terrain.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: check
docs.text: Ranger Help for: check ====================== SYNTAX: check <terrain> USAGE: Anywhere. SUMMARY: Shows all Ranger skills that can be used in the specified terrain, along with their slot costs. Useful for planning which skills to learn based on where you like to adventure. Example: check forest check mountain check underground ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: terrains, survey, skills

docs.title: Ranger Help for: check
docs.text: Ranger Help for: check ====================== SYNTAX: check <weapon>/check <weapon1> against <weapon2> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 2 BASE SP: 25 sp SKILL TYPE: knowledge SUMMARY: This skills lets a Ranger check how good a weapon is. It will show various ratings on certain aspects of the weapon. You can also check a weapon against another weapon, in which case it will show information for both weapons and then give you an idea of which one might be better.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: circle
docs.text: Ranger Help for: circle ======================= SYNTAX: circle <target> USAGE: Wilderness SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 30 SKILL TYPE: attack SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to circle around an opponent, gaining a positional advantage in combat. A successful circle grants +15 to dodge and +20 to hit for a limited duration. The Ranger must be in combat with the target. This skill works best in wilderness terrain where there is room to maneuver. While circling is active, the Ranger also works for position behind the target. When the circling rhythm slips into the target's blind side, Ranger melee damage gains a major bonus. The effect lasts longer for more dexterous Rangers, but the positional advantage comes and goes as the target turns to face the attack. At present, getting behind the target grants a very large melee damage bonus while that position holds.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: city
docs.text: Ranger Help for: city ===================== SUMMARY: The city is any area that has buildings or other humanoid-made structures. These will be areas where many of the higher forms of life interact with each other. Being devoid of almost all of its original nature elements, the city terrain is a harsh place for Rangers. Most Rangers prefer to stay out of cities and enjoy the wilderness. Most of a Ranger's nature skills will not work here. Cities are all over the realms. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: Individual terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: claim
docs.text: Ranger Help for: claim ====================== SYNTAX: claim USAGE: Wilderness SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 250 SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to claim a wilderness area as their warden territory. Claiming territory is a ONE-TIME action that permanently designates the area as the Ranger's domain. Within claimed territory, the Ranger receives enhanced bonuses to combat, crafting, and survival skills. Choose your territory carefully, as this decision cannot be undone. The high SP cost reflects the significance of this commitment.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: claim
docs.text: Ranger Help for: claim ====================== SYNTAX: claim USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 15 BASE SP: 250 sp(one time use) SKILL TYPE: aid SUMMARY: This skill is a one time use only skill. It allows a Ranger to set his or her range. A Ranger's range is where he or she feels at home, a place they always come back to. If a Ranger has a place that they explore in often, or like..they might should set it as their range. Any Ranger exploring in their range, will get bonuses in all aplicable skills and in fighting. Such as, a Ranger fighting it out in his or her range might do extra damage with Gaeia's help, and knowing the terrain..gains an advantage in a fight over his or her opponent. Ranges are aproximately the size of a realm(wizard's area).

docs.title: Ranger Help for: compare equipment
docs.text: Ranger Help for: compare equipment =================================== SYNTAX: compare <item1> to <item2> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 2 BASE SP: 5 SKILL TYPE: assessment SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to compare two pieces of equipment, either weapons or armor, and determine which is of higher quality. The accuracy of the comparison depends on the Ranger's guild level. Higher ranked Rangers can discern finer differences between items. Both items must be in the Ranger's inventory to be compared.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: concealment
docs.text: Ranger Help for: concealment ============================= SYNTAX: conceal USAGE: forest,plains,swamp,desert,jungle,hills,road,beach, underground,mountain,arctic,barren SLOT COST: 8 BASE SP: 25 SKILL TYPE: stealth SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to hide using natural camouflage, blending into the surrounding terrain. The Ranger must not be in combat to use this skill. While concealed, the Ranger is invisible to most creatures and players. Moving or initiating combat will break the concealment. Concealment is a prerequisite for the ambush skill. The effectiveness depends on the Ranger's dexterity, skill level, and the type of terrain. Some terrains offer better natural cover than others.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: conduct
docs.text: Ranger Help for: conduct ======================== SUMMARY: Rangers live by a code rooted in respect for the natural world. A Ranger protects the wild places and the creatures within them, hunting only when necessary and never destroying what is not needed. Rangers are expected to maintain a neutral alignment. Straying too far toward good or evil increases the cost of performing skills, as Gaia favors balance in all things. Aid your fellow Rangers when you can, and respect the bond between a Ranger and their animal follower. Do not abuse the gifts Gaia has granted. Use the land wisely, take only what you need, and leave the wilderness as you found it. A true Ranger is a guardian first, a hunter second. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: philosophy, alignment

docs.title: Ranger Help for: cooldowns
docs.text: Ranger Help for: cooldowns ========================== SUMMARY: Ranger abilities use several different recovery timers. This keeps one kind of work from blocking every other part of the guild. TIMER TYPES: Combat Attacks, combat defense, bow shots, and combat magic. Crafting Making gear, arrows, traps, mixtures, and item prep. Fieldwork Foraging, scouting, terrain study, hunting, and stealth. Travel Running, trailblazing, guiding, locating, and messages. Companion Attracting, calming, training, calling, and commanding. Camp Camp stock, cooking, brewing, wards, and camp building. Recovery Rest, meditation, ceremonies, Gaia's touch, and camp tend. Recovery skills are stronger pauses. While recovering from one of those, you need to wait before using another major Ranger ability. EXAMPLES: A strike delays another combat maneuver, but not make arrow. Forage delays another fieldwork action, but not quickshot. Camp cook delays other camp work, but not attract. Rest and camp tend delay most Ranger abilities until recovery passes. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: skills, camp, rest, make, forage, attract

docs.title: Ranger Help for: coordinate
docs.text: Ranger Help for: coordinate ============================ SYNTAX: coordinate <target> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 8 BASE SP: 40 SKILL TYPE: offensive SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to organize a coordinated group attack against a target. By calling out tactical instructions, the Ranger improves the combat effectiveness of everyone in the party for a brief time. The bonus to the group's attacks depends on the Ranger's charisma and skill level. This skill works best when the Ranger is fighting alongside allies.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: cost
docs.text: Ranger Help for: cost ===================== SYNTAX: cost (or: tally) USAGE: Any wilderness terrain. SUMMARY: Shows character level and stat advancement costs, plus combat-earned Ranger XP progress and the slots granted by the next Ranger guild level. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: improve, advancement, glevels

docs.title: Ranger Help for: defend
docs.text: Ranger Help for: defend ======================= SYNTAX: defend <target> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 5 BASE SP: 20 sp SKILL TYPE: defensive SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to step in and defend a fellow explorer from attack. There is a small chance that the creature that is fighting your friend won't fall for your move and continue fighting them. Also, you can't defend your enemy species.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: desert
docs.text: Ranger Help for: desert ======================= SUMMARY: The desert terrain is a harsh terrain, hot and dry. Sand is the most common feature in a desert area, it gets into everything. Life still holds its own, but is far less abundant than some of the more hospitable terrains such as forest. The Ranger population is fairly small in the desert, for a lot of a Ranger's skills will not work there. Deserts are most prominently known for being in Souvrael, but there others around the realms. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: Individual terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: desertsurvival
docs.text: Ranger Help for: desertsurvival ================================ SYNTAX: desertsurvival desert survival USAGE: Souvrael desert and other extreme desert terrain SLOT COST: 14 BASE SP: 10 SKILL TYPE: cartography SUMMARY: This skill toggles desert survival instincts on or off. When active, the Ranger reads the heat, wind, shade, and pace of the desert well enough to avoid the punishing Souvrael desert heat that normally drains water or damages travelers caught without water. Use this before crossing the Segovia Desert, the Rub' al Khali, or other Souvrael desert rooms that punish unprepared travelers. Toggle it again to relax those instincts. SEE ALSO: arctic survival, rest, guide, terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: disarm
docs.text: Ranger Help for: disarm ======================= SYNTAX: disarm <target> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 50 SKILL TYPE: attack SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to attempt to strip the weapon from an opponent's hands during combat. A successful disarm forces the target to drop their wielded weapon to the ground. The Ranger must have at least one free hand to perform this maneuver. The chance of success depends on the Ranger's strength, dexterity, and the target's weapon skill. Larger or heavier weapons are harder to disarm.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: diversion
docs.text: Ranger Help for: diversion ========================== SYNTAX: diversion <target> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 35 SKILL TYPE: attack SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to create a combat distraction, confusing and disorienting the target. A successful diversion debuffs the target, reducing their combat effectiveness for a short duration. This can include penalties to hit chance, dodge, and awareness. The distraction draws on the Ranger's cunning and knowledge of the surrounding terrain to exploit the environment.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: dodge
docs.text: Ranger Help for: dodge ====================== SYNTAX: dodge USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 20 + martial level SKILL TYPE: attack SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to enter an active dodging stance, granting a passive evasion buff for a limited duration. While active, the Ranger has an increased chance to dodge incoming attacks. The SP cost increases with the Ranger's martial skill level, but so does the effectiveness of the evasion. The Ranger must be in combat to use this skill.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: echo
docs.text: Ranger Help for: echo ===================== SYNTAX: echo USAGE: Underground only SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 20 SKILL TYPE: cartography SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to use a sonar-like technique underground, sending out a sound and listening to the echoes to detect creatures in adjacent rooms. The results report what creatures are nearby and in which direction they can be found. This skill only works in underground terrain. The accuracy depends on the Ranger's perception and skill level. Echo is invaluable for navigating dangerous underground areas.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: edge
docs.text: Ranger Help for: edge ===================== SYNTAX: edge <slash or pierce type weapon> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 6 BASE SP: 35 sp SKILL TYPE: aid SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to take a slash or pierce type weapon and sharpen it to razor sharpness, significantly enhancing its weapon class for a while. It requires a carried rock or stone rather than just nearby terrain. If you are in hills, mountains, or underground terrain, use 'quarry' to gather a rock first.
