docs.title: Ranger Help for: encircle
docs.text: Ranger Help for: encircle ========================= SYNTAX: encircle <target> USAGE: forest,plains,swamp,desert,jungle,hills,road,beach, underground,mountain,arctic,barren,outside SLOT COST: 4 BASE SP: 30 sp SKILL TYPE: attack SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to use his or her superior knowledge of the outdoors to gain an advantage against an opponent by circling around it. While circling, if you use an attack type skill when BEHIND an opponent, you do additional damage, since the opponent can't defend itself from behind. But, some other skills such as firing your ranger's bow won't work, since your moving around and never have the time to stop and aim your bow.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: enemy
docs.text: Ranger Help for: enemy ====================== SUMMARY: Each Ranger has a special species that he or she just loaths. Use the 'setenemy' command to set your enemy species. A Ranger's primary terrain determines what races are allowed. Once set, the Ranger will get fighting bonuses and bonuses in various skills against it. And some hinderances, such as you probably won't be able to sooth an orc, if an orc is your enemy race. Your enemy species will never be the race of your follower. Use 'setenemy' with no argument to see the choices available to your primary terrain. Use 'rhelp <species>' or 'rhelp enemy <species>' to read what that species usually covers before choosing. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: setenemy, setprime and followers

docs.title: Ranger Help for: enemy
docs.text: Ranger Help for: enemy ====================== SUMMARY: Each Ranger has a special species that he or she just loaths. Use the 'setenemy' command to set your enemy species. A Ranger's primary terrain determines what races are allowed. Once set, the Ranger will get fighting bonuses and stronger Ranger attack-skill damage against it. In combat this currently means a major boost to critical chance (currently +30 crit) and a sizable damage increase when striking that species (currently about +33% damage). There are also some hinderances, such as you probably won't be able to sooth an orc, if an orc is your enemy race. Your enemy species will never be the race of your follower. Use 'setenemy' with no argument to see the choices available to your primary terrain. Use 'rhelp <species>' or 'rhelp enemy <species>' to read what that species usually covers before choosing. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: setenemy, setprime and followers

docs.title: Ranger Help for: enemy amphibian
docs.text: Ranger Help for: enemy amphibian ================================ SUMMARY: Choosing amphibian means your Ranger has studied and learned to hate frogfolk, toads, salamanders, and similar wet-skinned creatures that live between water and land. This is usually a strong thematic choice for swamp, beach, and other damp territories. Expect it to matter most where marshes, pools, mud, or old waterways are common. COMMAND: setenemy amphibian ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: enemy, setenemy and terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: enemy any
docs.text: Ranger Help for: enemy any ========================== SUMMARY: Barren terrain is unusual. Its enemy list may show 'any', which means the land is hostile enough that a Ranger can choose almost any non-civilized species as a personal enemy. If you are a barren Ranger, use 'setenemy' to see the valid choices, then choose a real species such as reptile, insect, dog, dragon, or another race that fits your hunting story. Choosing a specific species is usually more useful than choosing the literal word 'any'. COMMAND: setenemy <species> ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: enemy, setenemy and barren

docs.title: Ranger Help for: enemy bear
docs.text: Ranger Help for: enemy bear =========================== SUMMARY: Choosing bear means your Ranger is trained to bring down bears and bear-like predators: heavy, clawed, territorial beasts that rely on bulk, strength, and endurance. This is a practical wilderness choice for forests, hills, mountains, arctic lands, and caves where large predators roam. COMMAND: setenemy bear ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: enemy, setenemy and terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: enemy bird
docs.text: Ranger Help for: enemy bird =========================== SUMMARY: Choosing bird means your Ranger specializes against avian creatures: hawks, ravens, eagles, vultures, giant birds, and other winged hunters. This choice fits Rangers who watch the sky as much as the ground. It can be useful across many terrains because birds migrate, nest, scavenge, and hunt almost everywhere. COMMAND: setenemy bird ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: enemy, setenemy and terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: enemy cat
docs.text: Ranger Help for: enemy cat ========================== SUMMARY: Choosing cat means your Ranger hunts feline predators: wildcats, lions, panthers, jaguars, and similar stalking beasts. This is a strong choice for forests, jungles, hills, and mountains. It represents a Ranger who knows how ambush predators move, hide, and spring. COMMAND: setenemy cat ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: enemy, setenemy and terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: enemy cow
docs.text: Ranger Help for: enemy cow ========================== SUMMARY: Choosing cow means your Ranger specializes against cattle, aurochs, oxen, and similar herd animals. This is a narrower enemy choice, but it can matter in plains, underground areas, farms, and places where large horned herd creatures are common. COMMAND: setenemy cow ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: enemy, setenemy and terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: enemy crustacean
docs.text: Ranger Help for: enemy crustacean ================================= SUMMARY: Choosing crustacean means your Ranger knows how to fight hard-shelled shore and water creatures: crabs, lobsters, crawfish, and stranger things with claws and chitin. This is mostly a coastal or swamp choice. It is best for Rangers who spend time near beaches, marshes, pools, and tidal places. COMMAND: setenemy crustacean ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: enemy, setenemy and terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: enemy deer
docs.text: Ranger Help for: enemy deer =========================== SUMMARY: Choosing deer means your Ranger is skilled at hunting deer, elk, stags, and other antlered woodland or plains creatures. This is a traditional tracker choice. It fits Rangers who want their enemy species to reflect patient pursuit, spoor reading, and clean fieldcraft. COMMAND: setenemy deer ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: enemy, setenemy and terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: enemy dog
docs.text: Ranger Help for: enemy dog ========================== SUMMARY: Choosing dog means your Ranger specializes against wolves, hounds, jackals, feral dogs, and similar pack hunters. This is a broad predator choice that can matter in forests, plains, swamps, deserts, mountains, arctic lands, and underground areas. COMMAND: setenemy dog ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: enemy, setenemy and terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: enemy dragon
docs.text: Ranger Help for: enemy dragon ============================= SUMMARY: Choosing dragon means your Ranger has sworn against dragons and dragonkin: scaled monsters, wyrms, drakes, and other ancient reptilian terrors. This is a dramatic, high-risk identity choice. Dragons are not everywhere, but when they appear they are often dangerous and memorable. COMMAND: setenemy dragon ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: enemy, setenemy and terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: enemy elephant
docs.text: Ranger Help for: enemy elephant =============================== SUMMARY: Choosing elephant means your Ranger studies massive tusked beasts: elephants, mammoths, mastodons, and similar huge herd creatures. This is a specialized choice for plains, jungle, beach, and desert-themed hunters who expect to fight enormous animals rather than smaller predators. COMMAND: setenemy elephant ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: enemy, setenemy and terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: enemy goat
docs.text: Ranger Help for: enemy goat =========================== SUMMARY: Choosing goat means your Ranger knows how to hunt goats, rams, ibex, and similar sure-footed horned animals. This is most thematic for mountains, hills, forests, plains, and jungles. It fits Rangers who know cliffs, ridges, and rocky grazing paths. COMMAND: setenemy goat ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: enemy, setenemy and terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: enemy golem
docs.text: Ranger Help for: enemy golem ============================ SUMMARY: Choosing golem means your Ranger is trained to fight constructed bodies: stone guardians, clay servants, animated statues, and other artificial creatures. This is a rare and specialized choice. It is less about animal lore and more about knowing where joints, cores, seams, and bindings fail. COMMAND: setenemy golem ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: enemy, setenemy and terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: enemy horse
docs.text: Ranger Help for: enemy horse ============================ SUMMARY: Choosing horse means your Ranger specializes against horses, wild mounts, mustangs, chargers, and similar equine creatures. This is a plains, forest, hill, mountain, desert, and arctic choice. Keep in mind that your follower will never be the same race as your enemy. COMMAND: setenemy horse ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: enemy, setenemy and followers

docs.title: Ranger Help for: enemy insect
docs.text: Ranger Help for: enemy insect ============================= SUMMARY: Choosing insect means your Ranger specializes against ants, beetles, wasps, mosquitoes, mantises, and other many-legged chitinous creatures. This is a broad choice across forests, swamps, deserts, jungles, beaches, mountains, and underground spaces. COMMAND: setenemy insect ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: enemy, setenemy and terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: enemy invertebrate
docs.text: Ranger Help for: enemy invertebrate =================================== SUMMARY: Choosing invertebrate means your Ranger hunts soft-bodied and many-limbed creatures without backbones: worms, slugs, leeches, mollusks, and stranger things from wet earth or deep places. This can overlap with insect or crustacean in feel, but it usually points at crawling, boneless, burrowing, or aquatic threats. COMMAND: setenemy invertebrate ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: enemy, setenemy and terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: enemy lycanthrope
docs.text: Ranger Help for: enemy lycanthrope ================================== SUMMARY: Choosing lycanthrope means your Ranger has made enemies of shapeshifters: werewolves, werebeasts, cursed hunters, and other creatures caught between person and predator. This is a flavorful choice for forests, swamps, hills, and mountains. It is often narrower than choosing dog or mammal, but more specific. COMMAND: setenemy lycanthrope ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: enemy, setenemy and terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: enemy mammal
docs.text: Ranger Help for: enemy mammal ============================= SUMMARY: Choosing mammal means your Ranger has a broad hatred for warm-blooded beasts that nurse their young and live by tooth, claw, hoof, or hide. This is a general-purpose animal choice. It may cover many ordinary beasts that are not better represented by a more specific race such as bear, cat, dog, deer, horse, or rodent. COMMAND: setenemy mammal ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: enemy, setenemy and terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: enemy mammal2
docs.text: Ranger Help for: enemy mammal2 ============================== SUMMARY: Some older creatures in Darkwind use the race label 'mammal2'. Choosing mammal2 means your Ranger specializes against that second legacy mammal category. This is mostly a mechanical distinction from older area code. If you are choosing for theme, mammal is clearer. If you know an area uses mammal2, this can be the more exact choice. COMMAND: setenemy mammal2 ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: enemy, setenemy and mammal

docs.title: Ranger Help for: enemy pig
docs.text: Ranger Help for: enemy pig ========================== SUMMARY: Choosing pig means your Ranger specializes against boars, swine, hogs, and tusked rooting beasts. This is a solid choice for forests, jungles, hills, mountains, and arctic lands where aggressive boars or pig-like creatures appear. COMMAND: setenemy pig ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: enemy, setenemy and terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: enemy pinniped
docs.text: Ranger Help for: enemy pinniped =============================== SUMMARY: Choosing pinniped means your Ranger specializes against seals, sea lions, walruses, and similar flippered shoreline or arctic creatures. This is a specialized beach and arctic choice. It matters most around coasts, ice, cold seas, and seal-haunted shores. COMMAND: setenemy pinniped ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: enemy, setenemy and terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: enemy plant
docs.text: Ranger Help for: enemy plant ============================ SUMMARY: Choosing plant means your Ranger has learned to fight living plants: animated vines, carnivorous flowers, treants, fungus growths, and other rooted or creeping vegetation. This is a good choice for forests, jungles, swamps, plains, and strange beaches where the land itself may bite back. COMMAND: setenemy plant ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: enemy, setenemy and terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: enemy reptile
docs.text: Ranger Help for: enemy reptile ============================== SUMMARY: Choosing reptile means your Ranger specializes against snakes, lizards, crocodiles, turtles, and other cold-blooded scaled creatures. This is useful across swamps, deserts, jungles, beaches, plains, mountains, and underground areas. COMMAND: setenemy reptile ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: enemy, setenemy and terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: enemy rodent
docs.text: Ranger Help for: enemy rodent ============================= SUMMARY: Choosing rodent means your Ranger specializes against rats, mice, beavers, porcupines, giant rodents, and other gnawing creatures. This is a practical choice in forests, plains, swamps, deserts, caves, beaches, and cold lands where small pests become real threats. COMMAND: setenemy rodent ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: enemy, setenemy and terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: enemy spider
docs.text: Ranger Help for: enemy spider ============================= SUMMARY: Choosing spider means your Ranger hunts spiders, web-spinners, venomous arachnids, and similar ambush predators. This is a strong choice for forests, swamps, deserts, jungles, hills, mountains, beaches, and underground areas. COMMAND: setenemy spider ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: enemy, setenemy and terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: equipment
docs.text: Ranger Help for: equipment ========================== SUMMARY: Rangers favor practical equipment suited to life in the wilderness. Leather and studded leather armors are preferred, as heavier plate armors restrict the stealth and agility a Ranger depends on. Chainmail is acceptable but somewhat noisy. The defining weapon of a Ranger is the bow. Rangers can carve their own bows and arrows from harvested wood, creating reliable weapons from the land itself. Medium swords, daggers, and staves round out the Ranger's arsenal. Rangers are also able to craft torches, rope, tents, and fish traps from natural materials gathered in the wild. Rangers can balance weapons to improve accuracy, and treat leather armor to improve its protection. A well-equipped Ranger carries a quiver for arrows, a carved bow, and whatever tools the terrain demands. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: weapons, armour, archery

docs.title: Ranger Help for: essence of the land
docs.text: Ranger Help for: essence of the land ====================================== SYNTAX: essence USAGE: forest,plains,swamp,desert,jungle,hills,road,beach, mountain,arctic,barren,outside SLOT COST: 7 BASE SP: variable SKILL TYPE: religious SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to draw power from the surrounding terrain, granting temporary stat buffs that vary depending on the type of land. A forest might grant agility, while mountains might grant endurance. The strength and duration of the buffs depend on the Ranger's wisdom, guild level, and familiarity with the terrain. This skill works best in the Ranger's primary terrain and cannot be used in cities or indoor areas.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: falcon
docs.text: Ranger Help for: falcon ======================= SYNTAX: falcon <direction> USAGE: Wilderness terrains. SLOT COST: 4 BASE SP: variable SUMMARY: Sends a falcon to scout in a given direction, reporting back what lies ahead. The falcon describes the room, any creatures present, and terrain type. More skilled Rangers receive more detailed reports. Also known as 'falcon eyes'. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: reconnoiter, study, survey

docs.title: Ranger Help for: fetch
docs.text: Ranger Help for: fetch ====================== SYNTAX: fetch <what> from <whom> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: NA BASE EXP: NA BASE SP: variable SUMMARY: This task allows a follower to fetch an item off of the ground in the same room of any player that is in the same domain. Communicate with the player you are having your fetch from to have the item on the ground and use the correct syntax. If the player is where the follower can reach them, the item will be fetched. This is a medium task so only fairly smart followers can learn it.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: falcon eyes
docs.text: Ranger Help for: falcon eyes ============================= SYNTAX: falcon <direction> USAGE: forest,plains,swamp,desert,jungle,hills,road,beach, mountain,arctic,barren,outside SLOT COST: 4 BASE SP: 20 SKILL TYPE: scouting SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to send a falcon to scout in a given direction. The falcon flies ahead and reports back what lies in the adjacent room, including any creatures or notable features. This is useful for scouting dangerous areas before entering them. The detail of the falcon's report depends on the Ranger's skill level.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: make fish trap
docs.text: Ranger Help for: make fish trap ================================ SYNTAX: make fish trap USAGE: Any terrain to craft; water terrain to set SLOT COST: 4 BASE SP: 48 SKILL TYPE: creation / survival SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to weave a collapsible fish trap from wildcraft supplies. The Ranger needs 2 binding fiber and 1 kindling. Once made, carry the trap to a river, lake, sea, beach, swamp, or underwater area and use: set fish trap check fish trap retrieve fish trap Checking a ready trap adds a fish catch to your camp stores. Fish catches can be used by 'camp cook fish stew' and 'camp cook hunter feast' at your camp.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: flame arrow
docs.text: Ranger Help for: flame arrow ============================= SYNTAX: flame arrow flame bolt USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 15 SKILL TYPE: archery SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to set an arrow or bolt on fire, adding fire damage to the next shot. The Ranger needs ammo and a lit torch in their inventory. Flaming ammo must be used quickly before it burns out.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: seasonal flux
docs.text: Ranger Help for: seasonal flux ================================ SYNTAX: flux <target> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 9 BASE SP: variable SKILL TYPE: religious SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to channel the energy of the current season into an attack against a target. The damage type and power vary depending on the time of year. Spring brings poison, summer brings fire, autumn brings decay, and winter brings frost. A skilled Ranger learns to read the seasons and use their power to maximum effect. The damage scales with the Ranger's wisdom and guild level.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: followers
docs.text: Ranger Help for: followers ========================== SUMMARY: Once a Ranger is trusted enough by Nature, he or she may be able to call a follower to their side. The race of follower a Ranger will get, will depend on the Ranger's primary terrain. It could be anything from a worm to an elephant. Some followers are smarter than others, and can be trained to perform special tasks that can benefit the Ranger. Keep in mind though, every time a Ranger allows his or her follower to die, the stinch of death will stick to the Ranger and future followers may refuse to come to his or her aid forever. Your follower's race will never be the same as your enemy species. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: enemy

docs.title: Ranger Help for: followers
docs.text: Ranger Help for: followers ========================== SUMMARY: Once a Ranger is trusted enough by Nature, he or she may be able to call a follower to their side. The race of follower a Ranger will get, will depend on the Ranger's primary terrain. It could be anything from a worm to an elephant. Some followers are smarter than others, and can be trained to perform special tasks that can benefit the Ranger. Keep in mind though, every time a Ranger allows his or her follower to die, the stinch of death will stick to the Ranger and future followers may refuse to come to his or her aid forever. Your follower's race will never be the same as your enemy species. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: enemy

docs.title: Ranger Help for: forage
docs.text: Ranger Help for: forage ======================= SYNTAX: forage USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: variable SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to search the surrounding wilderness for wildcraft supplies instead of loose inventory junk. What the Ranger finds depends heavily on terrain. Forests and jungles are good for binding fiber, resin, kindling, medicinal scraps, and tannin bark. Wet terrain is better for clean water, and plains can provide smokeleaf and useful fiber. Use 'forage stores' to review your wildcraft pouch. If the pouch fills with materials you do not need, use 'forage discard <component> [amount]' to make room. For example, 'forage discard kindling 2' throws away two kindling, and 'forage discard all confirm' empties the pouch. These supplies feed Ranger survival skills such as mix, make tools, make satchel, make fish trap, camp stock, camp cook, and camp brew.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: forage
docs.text: Ranger Help for: forage ======================= SYNTAX: forage USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: NA BASE EXP: NA BASE SP: variable SUMMARY: This task allows a follower to go find the nearest wilderness area and forage for food and bring it back to you to eat. How nourishing the food is that the follower brings back depends on how smart the follower is. This is a hard task to teach, so only the smartest followers will be able to learn it.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: forest
docs.text: Ranger Help for: forest ======================= SUMMARY: The forest is probably the most well known Ranger setting. Its wooded, with a temperate climate and an abundance of life. Almost all Ranger skills will work in the forest terrain, so no doubt, a lot of Rangers will be forest Rangers. Forests abound in Darkwind and in Kerei. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: Individual terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: fortify
docs.text: Ranger Help for: fortify ======================== SYNTAX: fortify <direction> USAGE: forest,plains,swamp,desert,jungle,hills,road,beach, underground,mountain,arctic,barren SLOT COST: 5 BASE SP: 30 SKILL TYPE: defensive SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to gather materials from the surrounding terrain and build a blockade or barricade in one direction, providing defensive advantages. The blockade can be circumvented by trashing it, allowing passage. How strong the blockade is and how much of a beating it can take depends on how proficient the Ranger is at building them. Other Rangers can pass through blockades freely, since they understand the nature of such constructions.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: fortify
docs.text: Ranger Help for: fortify ======================== SYNTAX: fortify <direction> USAGE: forest,plains,swamp,desert,jungle,hills,road,beach, underground,mountain,arctic,barren SLOT COST: 5 BASE SP: 30 sp SKILL TYPE: defensive SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to gather materials from the surrounding terrain and build a blockade or structure in one direction. The blockade can be circumvented by 'trashing' it, allowing passage. How strong or how much of a beating a blockade can take will depend on how proficient a Ranger is at building them. Once a blockade is built, other Rangers will be able to pass through it, since they understand the nature of blockades.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: furyfire
docs.text: Ranger Help for: furyfire ========================= SYNTAX: furyfire <target> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 80 SKILL TYPE: archery SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to unleash a rapid volley of arrows from a shortbow, firing 3 to 4 arrows in quick succession at the target. The Ranger must have a shortbow wielded and at least 4 arrows in inventory. Each arrow is rolled individually for hit and damage. Furyfire is one of the most devastating ranged attacks available, but its high SP cost and ammunition requirements make it best saved for tough opponents.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: furyfire
docs.text: Ranger Help for: furyfire ========================= SYNTAX: furyfire <target> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 14 BASE SP: variable SKILL TYPE: bow SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to make full use os the easy loading ability of the shortbow. Several factors go into how well a furyfire goes, such as dexterity. When a ranger furyfires, he or she lets go a volley of arrows all in the span of mere seconds. Whatever the Ranger has set as the shortbow's loader will be used in furyfire. The best arrows in the loader will automatically be used in the volley. There must be at least 4 arrows in the loader in order for a Ranger to furyfire.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: gash
docs.text: Ranger Help for: gash ===================== SYNTAX: gash <target> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 75 SKILL TYPE: attack SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to deliver a powerful slashing attack that tears through the target's defenses. The Ranger must be wielding a slash-type weapon (sword, axe, etc.) to perform this skill. Gash deals heavy slash damage and has a chance to cause bleeding. The damage scales with the Ranger's strength and weapon skill. This is a mid-tier melee attack that bridges the gap between strike and naturestrike.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: gash
docs.text: Ranger Help for: gash ===================== SYNTAX: gash <target> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 6 BASE SP: 75 sp SKILL TYPE: attack SUMMARY: Hack allows a Ranger to gash his or her opponent. Its provides a Ranger with an attack that does good damage. The Ranger must be wielding a slash type weapon in order to gash.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: general
docs.text: Ranger Help for: general ======================== SUMMARY: Rangers are the guardians of the wild places of Darkwind. They serve Gaia, the spirit of the earth, and draw their strength from the natural world. Equally at home stalking through deep forests or scaling frozen mountain passes, Rangers are skilled survivalists, trackers, and fighters. HOW RANGERS PLAY: Rangers are a self-sufficient class built around three pillars: SURVIVAL - Craft your own gear from the land. Harvest wood, make rope, forge tools, skin animals for hide, mix herbs into salves and poisons, carve bows and arrows. You can camp anywhere in the wilderness. COMBAT - A mix of melee and ranged fighting. Rangers use bows for ranged attacks (quickshot, heartshot, furyfire, longfire) and blades for close combat (strike, gash, impale, naturestrike). Circle your opponents for positional advantage, or ambush from concealment. NATURE MAGIC - Channel Gaia's power through meditation, wrath, winter's bite, and seasonal flux. Protect yourself and heal with essence of the land and nature's protection. At high levels, become Gaia's living incarnation. TERRAIN SYSTEM: Every Ranger chooses a primary and secondary terrain. These affect everything: combat damage, spell costs, cooldown times, and which animals you can bond with. Your primary terrain gives the biggest bonuses (+20%), your secondary less (+10%). Choose them to match where you like to adventure. COOLDOWNS: Ranger abilities recover in separate categories. Combat maneuvers, crafting, fieldwork, travel, camp work, and companion commands each have their own rhythm. Heavy recovery skills such as rest and camp tend still require a broader pause before other Ranger abilities. ANIMAL COMPANIONS: Rangers can attract and bond with animal followers from the wild. Your companion fights alongside you, can be trained with tricks, and is unique to your terrain. But be careful - each Ranger has a limited number of followers in their lifetime. If too many die, no more will come. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: advancement, skills, cooldowns, terrains, followers, philosophy

docs.title: Ranger Help for: glevels
docs.text: Ranger Help for: glevels ======================== SUMMARY: Rangers advance their guild level automatically by earning Ranger XP in battle. Each guild level grants additional skill slots for learning new abilities. Use 'rcost', 'radvance guild', or 'gscore ranger' to see progress. Guild level cannot exceed your game level. So to reach guild level 5, you must be at least game level 5. Maximum guild level is 15. SLOTS PER GUILD LEVEL: Level 1: 4 slots Level 9: 11 slots Level 2: 5 slots Level 10: 13 slots Level 3: 5 slots Level 11: 13 slots Level 4: 7 slots Level 12: 15 slots Level 5: 7 slots Level 13: 15 slots Level 6: 9 slots Level 14: 17 slots Level 7: 9 slots Level 15: 20 slots Level 8: 11 slots You start with 2 base slots when joining, and guild level 1 grants 4 more immediately, for a maximum total of 163 slots across all 15 guild levels. RANK: Your Ranger rank is derived from skill slots invested, not guild level: Novice (0-9 slots) Captain (70-99 slots) Regular (10-24 slots) Commander (100-129 slots) Veteran (25-44 slots) Warden (130+ slots) Elite (45-69 slots) SKILL SCORES: As you learn skills, three scores increase automatically: Wilderness Based on Survival + Cartography + Hunting skills Martial Based on Attack + Archery skills Spiritual Based on Husbandry skills These scores affect the power of your abilities. Type 'rscore' to see your current scores and rank. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: advancement, skills, slots, rscore

docs.title: Ranger Help for: glevels
docs.text: Ranger Help for: glevels ======================== SUMMARY: Rangers earn Ranger XP through battle and advance automatically through guild levels 1 to 15. Guild levels cannot exceed the limits imposed by game level and other guild training. Ranger XP remains banked while advancement is blocked. Each guild level grants slots, which are the only currency used to learn Ranger skills. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: stats

docs.title: Ranger Help for: guard
docs.text: Ranger Help for: guard ====================== SYNTAX: guard/unguard USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: NA BASE EXP: NA BASE SP: variable SUMMARY: This task teaches a follower to be your 'watchdog'. Once you command your follower to be on guard, it will attack anyone that enters the room! Use this task with care. To make your follower be off guard, just type unguard. This is an easy task, so any follower can learn it.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: guide
docs.text: Ranger Help for: guide ====================== SYNTAX: guide <player> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 20 SKILL TYPE: cartography SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to guide another player through the terrain, granting them a dodge bonus while the Ranger leads. The guided player benefits from the Ranger's knowledge of the land, receiving improved evasion as the Ranger directs them through safe paths and advantageous positions. The guide effect lasts as long as both players remain in the same room. This is a useful support skill for group play.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: guide
docs.text: Ranger Help for: guide ====================== SYNTAX: guide <name here> USAGE: Any wilderness terrain. SUMMARY: The only way for a Ranger to join the guild is to be guided by another Ranger in the ways of nature. Once a player is offered the knowledge, he/she must accept twice, then that player becomes a Ranger. =============================================================================

docs.title: Ranger Help for: guildhall
docs.text: Ranger Help for: guildhall ========================== SUMMARY: The Ranger's Lodge is an open-air lodge built beneath ancient oaks in the deep forest southwest of Darkwind city. It serves as the gathering place for all Rangers. HOW TO GET THERE: From Darkwind city, head west along Village Road to reach the forest. Continue deeper into the forest heading west. When you reach the deep forest, go northeast to find the forest meadow (a clearing with a large symbolic tree). From the meadow, go northeast again to enter the Ranger's Lodge. City -> west -> forest -> west -> deep forest -> northeast -> forest meadow -> northeast -> Ranger's Lodge Note: The path from the deep forest to the meadow is restricted to Rangers and guild applicants. Non-Rangers will feel uneasy and turn back. WHAT YOU CAN DO AT THE LODGE: join Join the Rangers guild (if not already a member) improve Advance stats/level or review Ranger XP cost Check character costs and Ranger XP learn Learn new skills fix quiver Repair or rebuild your quiver CONNECTED AREAS: North: The Training Clearing (practice area) East: The Trophy Hall (displays and storage) Southwest: Forest Meadow (exit to the deep forest) The Lodge is an outdoor room with forest terrain, so all wilderness skills work here. It is a safe zone - no fighting allowed. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: advancement, general

docs.title: Ranger Help for: harvest wood
docs.text: Ranger Help for: harvest wood =============================== SYNTAX: harvest USAGE: forest,jungle SLOT COST: 2 BASE SP: 10 SKILL TYPE: creation SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to gather wood from the surrounding trees for use in crafting. The wood can be used to carve bows, arrows, torches, fish traps, and other useful items. The amount and quality of wood gathered depends on the Ranger's skill level and the terrain. Forests and jungles provide the best sources of usable wood.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: heartshot
docs.text: Ranger Help for: heartshot ========================== SYNTAX: heartshot <target> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: variable SKILL TYPE: archery SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to fire a precisely aimed crossbow bolt at the target's heart. The Ranger must be wielding a crossbow and carrying at least one bolt. Heartshot is a deliberate finishing shot, not a rapid-fire attack. It uses the best bolt available and deals heavy single-target damage based on dexterity, Ranger progression, crossbow quality, and bolt quality. A poorly lined up shot still clips the target for partial damage, while a clean shot is much stronger. Heartshot is especially dangerous against targets that are already wounded.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: heartshot
docs.text: Ranger Help for: heartshot ========================== SYNTAX: heartshot <target> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 14 BASE SP: variable SKILL TYPE: bow SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger a special attack with crossbows. The Ranger takes an extra carefully aimed shot for the target's heart. The Ranger must be wielding a crossbow and carrying at least one bolt. Heartshot uses the best bolt available and is intended as a finishing shot. It deals heavy single-target damage based on dexterity, Ranger progression, crossbow quality, and bolt quality. A poor shot still clips the target for partial damage, while a clean hit is much stronger. Wounded targets are especially vulnerable.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: hills
docs.text: Ranger Help for: hills ====================== SUMMARY: Hills are fairly big mounds of dirt, but smaller than mountains. A number of other terrains can be present on hills. The Ranger population is medium in size because of this. Hills can be found on most of the continents. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: Individual terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: history
docs.text: Ranger Help for: history ======================== SUMMARY: The Ranger is a woodsman, fighter, tracker, rogue, and limited magic user all rolled into one. His abilities in the wilderness are unmatched. Able to survive in the harshest of conditions, Nature is his friend..sharing a special akindship to it with Druids. He has the strength of a fighter and the cunning of a thief. More often than not, the Ranger prefers to fight alone, though not always true. The Ranger's origins can be traced to the times when settlements were less developed, when a warrior had to rely on his smarts and the land. This relationship brought about a love of nature and an afinity for protecting it. Using all at his disposal and living off of the land makes the Ranger a very tough, stout character. He might use the land to his advantage in fights, or to locate lost explorers. Since the roots of a Ranger lie mostly in his growing up in a natural setting, only certain guilds may meld with the views of a Ranger and only after a long time. Rangers prefer solitude, and only later in their lives(higher lev) might they want explore other guilds. There are a many different Rangers, yet all are linked to nature, some are more affluent in certain areas than others, but all recognize the uses of their surroundings. Rangers in their birth terrain(primary) have certain advantages over there opponents or may have other skills/spells available to them. Most Rangers also 'know' a secondary terrain that may help them in their adventures. Lastly, Rangers being the master of nature and all within it, on rare occasions may call on nature itself to help them. With the help of Gaeia, Ranger can sometimes perform minor magics to aid them in combat or exploring. These take a lot out of Rangers, since they not performed on a regular basis. =============================================================================

The Ranger takes an extra carefully aimed shot for the target's heart. The Ranger must be wielding a crossbow and carrying at least one bolt. docs.title: Ranger Help for: hunt
docs.text: Ranger Help for: hunt ===================== SYNTAX: hunt <creature> USAGE: Wilderness SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 60 SKILL TYPE: hunting SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to track and attack a creature in an adjacent room. The Ranger uses their tracking abilities to locate the target, then automatically moves to the target's room and initiates combat. The creature must be in a room directly adjacent to the Ranger. This skill combines the Ranger's tracking expertise with combat readiness, allowing them to close distance quickly and strike before the prey can react.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: impale
docs.text: Ranger Help for: impale ======================= SYNTAX: impale <target> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 90 SKILL TYPE: attack SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to deliver a devastating piercing attack, driving their weapon deep into the target. The Ranger must be wielding a pierce-type weapon (spear, dagger, rapier, etc.) to perform this skill. Impale deals very high pierce damage and is one of the strongest single-hit melee attacks available to Rangers. The damage scales with the Ranger's strength and weapon proficiency.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: impale
docs.text: Ranger Help for: impale ======================= SYNTAX: impale <target> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 11 BASE SP: 90 sp SKILL TYPE: attack SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to punish an opponent by impaling his or her weapon through their opponent's armour into their body, causing good damage. The Ranger must use a pierce type weapon in order to perform this attack.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: improve
docs.text: Ranger Help for: improve ======================== SYNTAX: improve <str/dex/con/wis/int/chr/level/guild> USAGE: Any wilderness terrain. SUMMARY: Advance your stats or game level, or review automatic Ranger guild progress. You must be in a wilderness area (not city, inside, or dock terrain). improve str/dex/con/int/wis/chr Raise a stat (costs experience) improve level Raise game level (costs experience) improve guild Show combat-earned Ranger XP progress Your guild level cannot exceed your game level. Use 'cost' to see current prices and Ranger XP. You must set your primary terrain, secondary terrain, and enemy species before Ranger XP can raise your guild level above 1. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: cost, advancement, glevels

docs.title: Ranger Help for: improve
docs.text: Ranger Help for: improve ======================== SYNTAX: improve <str/dex/con/wis/int/chr/level> USAGE: Any wilderness terrain. SUMMARY: Allows a Ranger to advance stats and levels. You can advance the following: str/dex/con/wis/int/chr/level. Costs can be determined by using the 'tally' command. Guild level increase with player level, so you cannot raise it. However, wise Rangers will rise in guild level faster than others. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: stats, tally, journal, repair and glevels

docs.title: Ranger Help for: improvise
docs.text: Ranger Help for: improvise ========================== SYNTAX: improvise USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 110 SKILL TYPE: attack SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to use the surrounding environment as a weapon, improvising a terrain-based attack against their current combat opponent. The type and damage of the attack varies depending on the terrain: hurling rocks in mountains, using vines in jungle, kicking sand in desert, and so on. The Ranger must be in active combat to use this skill. Improvise is powerful but costly, best used when other options are exhausted.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: improvise
docs.text: Ranger Help for: improvise ========================== SYNTAX: improvise USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 12 BASE SP: 110 sp SKILL TYPE: attack SUMMARY: With this skill, a Ranger has an advantage over his or her opponent. He or she may improvise an attack by noting his or her surrounding terrain and use it to their advantage. The Ranger must already be attacking in order to improvise.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: gaia incarnate
docs.text: Ranger Help for: gaia incarnate ================================= SYNTAX: incarnate USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 15 BASE SP: variable SKILL TYPE: religious SUMMARY: This skill allows a high-level Ranger to transform into an avatar of Gaia herself. While in this form, the Ranger's combat abilities are greatly enhanced for a duration. Strength, speed, and resilience all increase dramatically. This is the ultimate expression of the bond between a Ranger and the earth. Only the most experienced Rangers can channel this much of Gaia's power without being overwhelmed. Requires a high guild level to learn and use.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: inside
docs.text: Ranger Help for: inside ======================= SUMMARY: The terrain inside is pretty obvious. Its any area that is inside a humanoid-made structure. Most inside terrains are in or around city terrains, since most cities have buildings, etc...Ranger skills are limited in this unnatural environment. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: Individual terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: inspect
docs.text: Ranger Help for: inspect ======================== SYNTAX: inspect <target> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 15 SKILL TYPE: hunting SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to carefully analyze an opponent, revealing information about their stats, strengths, and weaknesses. A successful inspection may reveal the target's approximate hit points, damage type resistances, elemental vulnerabilities, and combat style. The amount of detail revealed depends on the Ranger's skill level and intelligence. This is an invaluable scouting tool for preparing to fight tough enemies.

docs.title: Ranger
docs.text: Ranger Rangers are practical wilderness specialists. They study terrain, tracks, weather, tools, camps, animal helpers, and the preparation that happens before the first arrow lands. A Ranger chooses favored terrain and quarry, then develops a personal skill tree. Their toolkit includes tracking, foraging, camps, concealment, ambushes, archery, fieldcraft, and support for allies traveling through land the Ranger understands. Current roster status: OPEN Useful starting commands: ranhelp Open the Ranger help system rscore Review Ranger progress skilltree Review learned and available skills survey Identify the current terrain rangers List visible Rangers Joining requirements and directions can change. Check help guilds and ask a current Ranger before committing.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: journal
docs.text: Ranger Help for: journal ======================== SYNTAX: journal USAGE: Anywhere SUMMARY: This command displays your current list of available ranger tasks and quests. The journal tracks your progress through the Ranger guild's various challenges and objectives. Each entry shows the task name, its current status, and any relevant details. Tasks are updated automatically as you complete objectives. Check your journal regularly to see what challenges await you.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: journal
docs.text: Ranger Help for: journal ======================== SYNTAX: journal/journal <quest name> USAGE: Any wilderness terrain. SUMMARY: This command lets a Ranger flip through his or her journal of quests. Just typing 'journal' brings up a quest list, while typing 'journal' and a quest name brings up some info about the quest. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: stats, tally, journal, repair and glevels

docs.title: Ranger Help for: jungle
docs.text: Ranger Help for: jungle ======================= SUMMARY: The jungle terrain is almost a cross between forest and swamp. Its very wooded, but also quite humid and moist. These two factors cause it to be very foliated, with animals all about. The climate is usually hot and humid with rain falling a lot of the time. The Ranger population is strong in the jungle, since most of a Ranger's skills will work here. Kerei is most noted for its jungles. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: Individual terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: lake
docs.text: Ranger Help for: lake ===================== SUMMARY: The lake is similar to the sea, but smaller in size and usually made up of fresh water. All sorts of fish live in lakes, and while it is good source of food, no Rangers line in a lake. Lots of times, Rangers will live near them though. Ranger skills use in limited in lakes. Lakes can be found on most all of the continents. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: Individual terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: learn
docs.text: Ranger Help for: learn ====================== SYNTAX: learn learn <skill> learn cost <skill> USAGE: Any wilderness terrain. SUMMARY: The learn command is how Rangers acquire new skills. learn Shows all skills you know about, marking which are learned and which are available to learn. learn <skill> Learn a skill. Costs slots only. learn cost <skill> Shows the exact cost, prerequisites, terrains, and what the skill unlocks. Skills have prerequisites - you must learn earlier skills to unlock later ones. When you learn a skill, any new skills it unlocks will automatically appear in your available list. Your first available skill is 'forage'. Start there. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: skilltree, slots, skills, glevels

docs.title: Ranger Help for: learn
docs.text: Ranger Help for: learn ====================== SYNTAX: learn <skill name here>/learn cost for <skill name here> USAGE: Any wilderness terrain. SUMMARY: Allows a Ranger to learn a skill from the slots list when the Ranger has enough slots available. If you type 'learn cost <skill>', you will see the slot cost, prerequisites, terrains, and unlocked skills. ============================================================================ SEE ALSO: slots, myinfo and myskills

docs.title: Ranger Help for: liquify
docs.text: Ranger Help for: liquify ======================== SYNTAX: liquify <item> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 5 BASE SP: 15 sp SKILL TYPE: arrow SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to stoke up a searing hot fire and melt items in it. The Ranger is looking for items with gold or silver in them, other materials won't melt or just burn up. The soft gold and silvers easily melt and also make good metals to tip arrows and bolts with. Gold tipped arrows and bolts are extremely accurate, increasing chances for hitting critical areas of the body. Silver tipped arrows and bolts are accurate, but not as accurate as gold tipped arrows and bolts, but they are less costly. Once you melt down an item, a nugget of gold or silver will be left. The size of the nugget will be dependent on how big the original item was. How big the nugget is also determines how many arrows or bolts can be tipped with it. You can only liquify items if there is a stove or furnace nearby. A campfire wouldn't get hot enough. Once you get the nugget, you can "goldtip <arrow/bolt>" or "silvertip <arrow/bolt>" depending on which type of nugget you have. You can liquify any object with gold or silver in it, but weapons and objects will generally leave smaller nuggets than will armours...meaning less tippings per nugget. Also, if the liquified object has multiple materials in it, the resulting nugget will be smaller. NOTE: I have to manually add furnace rooms, so if one you think you should be supported isn't, lemme know. The more the better..:)

docs.title: Ranger Help for: locate
docs.text: Ranger Help for: locate ======================= SYNTAX: locate USAGE: Wilderness SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 15 SKILL TYPE: husbandry SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to sense the location of their bonded animal follower. The Ranger receives information about which direction and approximately how far away their companion is. This skill only works in wilderness terrain. If the follower has died, the skill will report that no companion can be found. Locate is useful when the Ranger and their follower have become separated.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: longfire
docs.text: Ranger Help for: longfire ========================= SYNTAX: longfire <direction> at <target> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 60 SKILL TYPE: archery SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to fire a longbow shot into an adjacent room, striking a target from a distance without entering the room. The Ranger must specify the direction and the target. A longbow must be wielded with an arrow readied. This is a powerful tactical skill that lets the Ranger engage enemies before they can close to melee range. Damage is based on archery skill and dexterity.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: longfire
docs.text: Ranger Help for: longfire ========================= SYNTAX: longfire <direction> at <target> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 14 BASE SP: variable SKILL TYPE: bow SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to take advantage of the extra power provided by the longbow. It allows a Ranger to shoot at targets adjacent rooms. Being a long shot, its harder to hit, but the arrows comes as a surprise to the target. Whatever the Ranger has set as the longbow's loader will be used in longshot. The best arrow in the loader will automatically be used in the shot.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: longshot
docs.text: Ranger Help for: longshot ========================= SYNTAX: longshot <target> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: variable SKILL TYPE: archery SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to fire a long-range bow attack at a target. Longshot trades speed for power, delivering a carefully aimed shot that deals more damage than a quickshot. The SP cost varies based on the Ranger's archery skill level and the bow used. The Ranger must have a bow wielded and an arrow readied. Longshot is the standard ranged attack for Rangers who prefer precision over rapid fire.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: longshot
docs.text: Ranger Help for: longshot ========================= SYNTAX: longshot <target> or lshot <target> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 8 BASE SP: variable SKILL TYPE: bow SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to fire a long-range bow shot at a target in an adjacent room. The Ranger draws the bow with great force and sends an arrow flying over a considerable distance. This is especially useful for initiating combat from safety or harassing fleeing enemies. The damage and accuracy of the shot depend on the Ranger's strength, dexterity, and proficiency with the skill.

docs.title: RANGER'S GUILD HELP
docs.text: RANGER'S GUILD HELP ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- GETTING STARTED: setprime <terrain> Set your primary terrain (one-time, do first!) setsecond <terrain> Set your secondary terrain (one-time) setenemy <race> Set your enemy species (one-time) SKILLS & ADVANCEMENT: skilltree / tree View the full skill tree and your progress. learn See skills available to learn. learn <skill> Learn a new skill (costs slots). learn cost <skill> See the cost and details of a skill. skills / myskills Show your learned skills. slots Show your available skill slots. improve <what> Advance stats/level or review Ranger XP. cost / tally Show character costs and Ranger XP. check <terrain> See what skills work in a terrain. INFORMATION: ranhelp / rh Show this screen. 'rh <topic>' for details. rscore / rsc Your Ranger status report. rangers Show Rangers currently online. bio / myinfo View or set your Ranger bio. motto / declare Set your motto (shown on 'rangers' list). survey / id Identify the terrain you are in. inspect <target> Analyze an opponent's strengths. COMMUNICATION: ran <message> Chat on the Ranger guild line. eran <message> Emote on the Ranger guild line. signal <who> <msg> Send a nature-carried message to a player. GUILD MANAGEMENT: recruit <name> Recruit another player into the guild. rebuild quiver Get a new quiver if yours is lost. repair quiver Refresh your quiver if having problems. rangerbug <message> Report a Ranger bug. journal List available tasks and quests. docs.title: Ranger Help for: make
docs.text: Ranger Help for: make ===================== SUMMARY: The unified crafting command. Rangers can craft all their gear from natural materials found in the wild. USAGE: make Show all available items make rope Twist grasses into rope make torch Carve a wooden torch make fish trap Weave a trap for catching camp fish make tent Build a tent from rope and wood make tools Prepare a reusable field kit make satchel Expand your wildcraft forage pouch make arrow Carve arrows from wood make bolt Carve crossbow bolts from wood make bow Carve a shortbow from wood make crossbow Carve a crossbow from wood make longbow Carve a longbow from wood make trophy Mount a trophy from a corpse make snare <dir> Set a snare trap in a direction REQUIREMENTS: All crafting requires a slash weapon (knife/sword) equipped. Most items need specific terrain or materials: rope Grass terrain (forest, plains, swamp) torch Wood terrain (forest, jungle, swamp, mountain) fish trap 2 binding fiber + 1 kindling tent Wood terrain + rope in inventory tools 2 fieldstone + 1 flint + 1 binding fiber satchel 3 hide scraps + 2 sinew + 2 binding fiber arrow/bolt Wood terrain (quantity based on skill) bow types Wood terrain + 2 wood (10 sec delay) trophy Corpse in the room snare Rope in inventory + valid exit direction CRAFTING CHAINS: make rope -> make tent -> camp (set up a wilderness camp) mine/quarry + forage -> make tools -> mine more reliably skin corpse + forage -> make satchel forage + make fish trap -> set fish trap -> camp cook make arrow + make bow -> archery combat make bolt + make crossbow -> heartshot If your wildcraft pouch fills with the wrong supplies, use 'forage stores' to review it and 'forage discard <component> [amount]' to free room. Camp stock, camp cook, and camp brew also consume wildcraft supplies. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: skills, camp, forage, skin, mine

docs.title: Ranger Help for: carve arrow
docs.text: Ranger Help for: carve arrow ============================ SYNTAX: carve arrow/carve bolt USAGE: forest,jungle,swamp SLOT COST: 5 BASE SP: 10 sp SKILL TYPE: arrow SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to carve an arrow or bolt from wooded areas. Arrows are used in shortbows and longbows, while bolts are used in crossbows. Once carved, arrows and bolts can be enhanced by fire, poison and other methods, if they Ranger knows how to. The Ranger must have a slash type weapon in order to cut and carve the wood.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: carve arrow
docs.text: Ranger Help for: carve arrow ============================ SYNTAX: carve arrow/carve bolt USAGE: forest,jungle,swamp SLOT COST: 5 BASE SP: 10 sp SKILL TYPE: arrow SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to carve an arrow or bolt from wooded areas. Arrows are used in shortbows and longbows, while bolts are used in crossbows. Once carved, arrows and bolts can be enhanced by fire, poison and other methods, if they Ranger knows how to. The Ranger must have a slash type weapon in order to cut and carve the wood.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: make satchel
docs.text: Ranger Help for: make satchel ============================== SYNTAX: make satchel USAGE: Wilderness SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 30 SKILL TYPE: survival SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to expand their wildcraft forage pouch. The Ranger needs 3 hide scraps, 2 sinew, and 2 binding fiber. Hide scraps and sinew come from skinning corpses, while binding fiber comes from forage. If your pouch is full before you have the right materials, use 'forage stores' to see what is taking space and 'forage discard <component> [amount]' to throw away spare supplies. Each successful upgrade increases wildcraft capacity, up to the maximum a Ranger can maintain in the field.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: make tools
docs.text: Ranger Help for: make tools ============================ SYNTAX: make tools USAGE: Wilderness SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 25 SKILL TYPE: survival SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to prepare a reusable field kit from wildcraft supplies. The Ranger needs 2 fieldstone, 1 flint, and 1 binding fiber. Fieldstone and flint come from mine or quarry, and binding fiber comes from forage. The field kit is stored in the Ranger's wildcraft pouch instead of being carried as a fragile inventory item. It supports field survival and mining work.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: make trophy
docs.text: Ranger Help for: make trophy ============================= SYNTAX: mount corpse make trophy USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 20 SKILL TYPE: survival SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to mount a trophy from a slain creature's corpse. The trophy serves as a decoration and proof of the Ranger's hunting prowess. The Ranger must have a corpse present in the room to create the trophy. Different creatures produce different trophies. The quality of the trophy depends on the Ranger's skill level. Trophies can be displayed or carried as mementos of notable kills.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: martial
docs.text: Ranger Help for: martial ======================== SUMMARY: The Martial branch encompasses the Ranger's combat abilities. These are the techniques of a warrior who fights with cunning, speed, and knowledge of the terrain rather than brute force alone. Key martial skills include: Quickshot - Rapid archery attack, firing multiple shots Longshot - Long-range bow attack reaching adjacent rooms Heartshot - Carefully aimed crossbow shot to the heart Coordinate - Organizes a group attack for improved effectiveness Ambush - Devastating surprise attack from concealment Concealment - Hides using natural camouflage Move Silently - Travel without being noticed Set Snare - Sets a hidden trap for the unwary Fortify - Builds a defensive barricade Compare - Compares weapons or armor quality Balance Weapon - Improves a weapon's accuracy Treat Armor - Treats leather armor for better protection Rangers are at their deadliest when fighting in their primary terrain against their chosen enemy species. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: wilderness, religious, archery, weapons

docs.title: Ranger Help for: meditation
docs.text: Ranger Help for: meditation ============================ SYNTAX: meditate USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 3 BASE SP: NA SKILL TYPE: religious SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to enter a meditative state, communing with nature to restore spell points. The Ranger must not be in combat to meditate. The amount of spell points restored depends on the Ranger's wisdom, guild level, and the terrain they are in. Meditating in the Ranger's primary terrain is more effective. This is the primary way Rangers recover their spell points in the field.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: mine
docs.text: Ranger Help for: mine ===================== SYNTAX: mine mine stone USAGE: Underground, hills, or mountains SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 25 SKILL TYPE: cartography SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to gather useful stone from rough terrain. The Ranger must have a field kit prepared with 'make tools'. Mining stores fieldstone and flint in the Ranger's wildcraft pouch instead of creating loose rocks in inventory. Fieldstone and flint are used by survival crafts such as make tools and mix weapon paste. Mining depletes a room for a while, so Rangers need to move through the wild instead of stripping one place forever.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: mix
docs.text: Ranger Help for: mix ==================== SYNTAX: mix salve mix poison mix poultice mix antivenom mix stimulant mix smoke mix weapon paste USAGE: Wilderness SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 20 SKILL TYPE: survival SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to turn wildcraft supplies and saved profession materials into practical survival consumables. Poultices heal wounds. Antivenom helps clear poison. Stimulants restore stamina. Smoke bundles create a brief defensive screen. Weapon paste sharpens a wielded slash or pierce weapon. Poison still creates a vial that works with the 'poison arrow' skill. Poultices, antivenom, stimulants, smoke bundles, and weapon paste scale with Ranger wilderness skill and level. They are temporary field preparations and do not save over logout or reboot. Most recipes use components from forage, mine, quarry, or skin. Some recipes also consume saved profession herbs or reagents, so Rangers can live off what they gather instead of returning to town.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: motto
docs.text: Ranger Help for: motto ====================== SYNTAX: motto <your motto> USAGE: Anywhere. SUMMARY: Set your personal motto, which appears on the 'rangers' list next to your name. Keep it short (max 60 characters). Also accessible as 'declare'. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: bio, rangers

docs.title: Ranger Help for: motto
docs.text: Ranger Help for: motto ====================== SYNTAX: motto <your motto here> USAGE: Any wilderness terrain. SUMMARY: Allows a Ranger to declare a motto, which will show up on the rangers screen. Nothing obscene please. Just type 'motto' by itself to erase your current motto. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: tog and rbug

docs.title: Ranger Help for: mount
docs.text: Ranger Help for: mount ====================== SYNTAX: mount corpse USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 3 BASE SP: 20 sp SKILL TYPE: creation SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to show up all of his or her Ranger friends by mounting a trophy of any corpse he or she has slain.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: mountain
docs.text: Ranger Help for: mountain ========================= SUMMARY: The mountain terrain is characterized by huge mounds of dirt and rock that form high mountains all over the realms. The Ranger population is small but larger than in such terrains as the desert. Most Ranger skills will work on mountains. Mountains are most notably in Darkwind and Hyperborea. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: Individual terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: move
docs.text: Ranger Help for: move ===================== SYNTAX: move silently/move normally USAGE: forest,plains,swamp,desert,jungle,hills,road,inside, beach,underground,mountain,arctic,barren,outside SLOT COST: 6 BASE SP: 20 sp/5 sp per move SKILL TYPE: defensive SUMMARY: In certain terrains, once a Ranger has learned this skill, he or she can move through the area silently. Other players can see you, but they can't hear you enter or leave via normal exits.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: myinfo
docs.text: Ranger Help for: myinfo ======================= SYNTAX: myinfo USAGE: Any terrain. SUMMARY: Myinfo shows a Ranger a number of important pieces of information about him or herself. It shows game information, such as level, guild level, experience and gold...but it also shows a Ranger information about his or her standing as a Ranger, such as primary and secondary terrains, the Ranger's current follower, and enemy species, as well as a list of skills learned to that point. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: myskills, slots and learn

docs.title: Ranger Help for: myskills
docs.text: Ranger Help for: myskills ========================= SYNTAX: myskills USAGE: Any wilderness terrain. SUMMARY: Shows a list of the Ranger's current skills and applicable terrains, as well as how any slots available the Ranger has. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: learn, myinfo and slots

docs.title: Ranger Help for: nature lore
docs.text: Ranger Help for: nature lore ============================= SYNTAX: lore [target] USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 10 SKILL TYPE: survival SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to identify creatures, plants, and terrain features using their knowledge of the natural world. When used on a creature, it reveals information about the creature's type, habitat, and notable traits. When used without a target, it provides information about the current terrain and its properties. The detail of information revealed depends on the Ranger's experience and skill level.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: naturestrike
docs.text: Ranger Help for: naturestrike ============================== SYNTAX: naturestrike <target> USAGE: Wilderness only SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 150 SKILL TYPE: attack SUMMARY: This skill is the ultimate melee attack available to Rangers, channeling the raw power of nature through the Ranger's weapon. Naturestrike deals the highest melee damage of any Ranger skill, combining physical force with elemental energy from the surrounding terrain. The Ranger must be in wilderness terrain to draw upon Gaia's power. The damage type and visual effect vary by terrain. This skill has a significant cooldown and SP cost, making it best reserved for the most dangerous foes.

docs.title: WELCOME TO THE RANGER'S GUILD!
docs.text: WELCOME TO THE RANGER'S GUILD! ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- Congratulations! You are now a Ranger, a guardian of the wild places of Darkwind. The Wind speaks to you now, connecting you to all Rangers across the land. This guide will help you get started. FIRST STEPS (do these immediately): ------------------------------------ 1. SET YOUR TERRAINS AND ENEMY. You cannot advance until these are set. These are permanent choices that define your Ranger, so choose wisely. Type each command with no argument to see your options: setprime Choose your primary terrain (biggest bonuses) setsecond Choose your secondary terrain (smaller bonuses) setenemy Choose your enemy species (combat bonuses vs them) Example: setprime forest, setsecond mountain, setenemy bear 2. LEARN YOUR FIRST SKILL. You start knowing 'forage' but haven't learned it yet. Type 'learn forage' to learn it. This unlocks more skills you can learn. Type 'skilltree' to see all skills and how they connect. 3. GET TO THE WILDERNESS. Ranger skills only work outside of cities. Head out of town to start using your abilities. HOW RANGERS WORK: ----------------- - You earn Ranger XP in battle and gain guild levels automatically. Type 'cost', 'radvance guild', or 'gscore ranger' to see your progress. - Spend slots to LEARN skills (type 'learn' to see what's available, 'learn <skill>' to learn one). - Skills have TERRAIN requirements - some only work in certain places. Type 'check <terrain>' to see what works where. - Your PRIMARY terrain gives +20% damage, -20% SP cost, -20% cooldown. Your SECONDARY terrain gives +10% to those same things. - Fighting your ENEMY SPECIES gives +30% critical hit chance. ESSENTIAL COMMANDS: ------------------- ranhelp / rh Full help system. 'rh <topic>' for details. skilltree / tree View the entire skill tree and your progress. learn See available skills and learn new ones. skills / myskills See your learned skills. slots See your available slots. cost / tally See character costs and Ranger XP progress. improve <stat> Advance stats, or show Ranger XP with 'improve guild'. rscore / rsc Your full Ranger status report. rangers See who else is online. ran <message> Chat with other Rangers. GETTING AROUND: --------------- The Ranger's Lodge is in the deep forest southwest of Darkwind. From town, go to the forest (west from Village Road area) and keep heading deeper. When you reach the deep forest, go northeast to find the forest meadow, then northeast again to the Lodge. Type 'rh' for the full command list, or 'rh <topic>' for help on any topic. Good luck, Ranger!

docs.title: Ranger Help for: outside
docs.text: Ranger Help for: outside ======================== SUMMARY: Outside is just a general terrain, that is above ground and not indoors. There really isn't any defining characteristics other than its in the wilderness. Most Ranger skills will work outside. Outside terrains can be found in all of the realms. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: Individual terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: philosophy
docs.text: Ranger Help for: philosophy =========================== SUMMARY: At the heart of every Ranger is a deep connection to Gaia, the living spirit of the earth. Rangers believe the land is not merely soil and stone but a living force that sustains all creatures. They serve as guardians of the balance between civilization and wilderness, standing at the boundary where the settled world meets the untamed wild. The Wind carries the prayers of Rangers to Gaia and connects them to one another across vast distances. Through communion with nature, a Ranger draws strength, wisdom, and on rare occasions, divine power. Rangers understand the cycle of life and death, of seasons turning and the land renewing itself. They do not fight against nature but work within it, adapting to the terrain, reading the signs of the wild, and channeling the energy of the earth through their bodies. To be a Ranger is to accept that you are part of something far greater than yourself. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: general, history, conduct

docs.title: Ranger Help for: plains
docs.text: Ranger Help for: plains ======================= SUMMARY: The plains are just as they sound, large flat grassland expanses. Some plains are mere large fields though. They are charaterized by temperate climates and some life. The population of Rangers is quite a bit smaller in the plains than in other wooded areas. Plains can be found on Darkwind and some arctic plains can be found in Hyperborea. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: Individual terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: poison arrow
docs.text: Ranger Help for: poison arrow ============================== SYNTAX: poison arrow poison bolt taint arrow taint bolt USAGE: Specific terrains SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 10 SKILL TYPE: archery SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to coat an arrow or bolt with poison, adding toxic damage to the next shot. The Ranger needs ammo and a vial of poison in their inventory. The 'taint' command is an alias for poison arrow/bolt.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: port
docs.text: Ranger Help for: port ===================== SUMMARY: Ports are areas where ships dock and are stored when not in use. Ports or docks are humanoid-made, usually of wood. They are almost always wet with pieces of dead fish laying around. They are no place for some of nature, like a Ranger is. Skills are somewhat limited on ports, and no Rangers live on or near them. Ports can be found on all of the continents. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: Individual terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: powerlist
docs.text: Ranger Help for: powerlist =========================== SUMMARY: Below is the complete learnable Ranger skill list, grouped by branch. Slot costs match the current Ranger skill tree. SURVIVAL: Forage 1 slot Make Rope 1 slot Make Torch 2 slots Make Fish Trap 4 slots Make Tent 2 slots Camp free Make Tools 2 slots Make Satchel 4 slots Nature Lore 7 slots Mix 4 slots Defend 5 slots Fortify 8 slots Treat 9 slots CARTOGRAPHY: Survey 1 slot Trailmark 3 slots Prospect 3 slots Mine free Study Area 7 slots Trail Signs free Echo 6 slots Trailblaze 10 slots Rest 10 slots Guide 13 slots Desert Survival 14 slots Arctic Survival 14 slots Claim 15 slots HUNTING: Run 1 slot Skin 2 slots Make Trophy 3 slots Reconnoiter 6 slots Make Snare 10 slots Stealth 8 slots Stalk 9 slots Camoflage 11 slots Hunt 14 slots HUSBANDRY: Assess 2 slots Calm 6 slots Attract 8 slots Teach 6 slots Locate 9 slots Animal Lure 12 slots ATTACK: Strike 3 slots Inspect 5 slots Gash 6 slots Sharpen 5 slots Compare free Circle 6 slots Impale 9 slots Disarm 7 slots Improvise 12 slots Naturestrike 15 slots ARCHERY: Make Arrow 2 slots Flame Arrow free Poison Arrow free Tip Arrow free Make Bow 7 slots Heartshot 13 slots Furyfire 13 slots Longfire 13 slots TIP: Use 'ranhelp <skill name>' for details. The canonical names above now work directly, including multi-word names such as 'study area', 'animal lure', 'make satchel', and 'desert survival'. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: skills, skilltree, learn, slots, glevels

docs.title: Ranger Help for: prospect
docs.text: Ranger Help for: prospect ========================= SYNTAX: prospect USAGE: Mountain/hills only SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 15 SKILL TYPE: cartography SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to search the surrounding area for mineral deposits such as gold, silver, and other ores. Prospecting can only be done in mountain or hills terrain. A successful prospect reveals whether the area contains mineable deposits and what type of minerals are present. This information is used in conjunction with the mine skill to extract ore nuggets for crafting arrow tips and other items.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: quickshot
docs.text: Ranger Help for: quickshot ========================== SYNTAX: quickshot <target> or qshot <target> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 6 BASE SP: variable SKILL TYPE: bow SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to fire a rapid volley of arrows at a target. The Ranger sacrifices accuracy for speed, firing multiple shots in quick succession. Each individual hit does less damage than a carefully aimed shot, but the combined effect of multiple arrows can be devastating. The number of arrows fired depends on the Ranger's dexterity and proficiency with the skill.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: quarry
docs.text: Ranger Help for: quarry ======================= SYNTAX: quarry quarry rock USAGE: Hills, mountain, underground SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 10 sp SKILL TYPE: utility SUMMARY: This command lets a Ranger gather a few useful rocks from rocky terrain for crafting and sharpening. It stores fieldstone and flint in the Ranger's wildcraft pouch instead of creating loose rocks in inventory. It is meant to support skills like 'sharpen', 'make tools', and 'mix weapon paste' without pretending that every room's exposed stone can be used directly as inventory. You must already know how to sharpen a weapon before you can use quarry.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: quickshot
docs.text: Ranger Help for: quickshot ========================== SYNTAX: quickshot <target> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: variable SKILL TYPE: archery SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to snap off a rapid bow shot at a target. Quickshot trades damage for speed, allowing faster attacks than longshot. The SP cost varies based on the Ranger's archery level. The Ranger must have a bow wielded and an arrow readied. Quickshot is ideal for weaker opponents or situations where sustained damage output is more important than single-shot power. It has a shorter cooldown than other bow skills.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: radvance
