docs.text: Ranger Help for: radvance ========================= SYNTAX: radvance <level|guild|str|dex|con|int|wis|chr> USAGE: Any wilderness area. SUMMARY: Advance your stats or game level, or review automatic Ranger guild progress, from anywhere in the wilderness. You do not need to return to the lodge. radvance level Advance your game level (costs experience) radvance guild Show combat-earned Ranger XP progress radvance str Raise your strength radvance dex Raise your dexterity radvance con Raise your constitution radvance int Raise your intelligence radvance wis Raise your wisdom radvance chr Raise your charisma REQUIREMENTS: - Must be in the wilderness (not city, indoors, or dock) - Terrains and enemy species must be set before guild level 2 - Guild level cannot exceed your game level - Use 'rcost' to check character costs and Ranger XP ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: rcost, advancement, glevels

docs.title: Ranger Help for: ran
docs.text: Ranger Help for: ran ==================== SYNTAX: ran <message> eran <message> USAGE: Anywhere SUMMARY: This command sends a message on the Ranger guild chat channel. All online Rangers will see the message. Use 'ran' for standard messages and 'eran' for emote-style messages. Guild chat is an out-of-character communication channel for Rangers to coordinate, ask questions, and socialize. Use 'ranhist' or 'rhist' to view recent chat history.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: rangerbug
docs.text: Ranger Help for: rangerbug =========================== SYNTAX: rangerbug <message> rbug <message> USAGE: Anywhere SUMMARY: This command reports a bug in the Ranger guild system to the guild maintainers. Describe the issue as clearly as possible, including what you were doing when the bug occurred. Reports are logged for review by the guild coders. The 'rbug' command is a shorter alias for 'rangerbug'. Please use this for guild-specific bugs only; for general game bugs, use the standard 'bug' command.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: rangers
docs.text: Ranger Help for: rangers ======================== SYNTAX: rangers USAGE: Anywhere SUMMARY: This command displays a list of all Rangers currently online. The list shows each Ranger's name and their guild level. This is useful for finding other Rangers to group with or to see who is available for assistance. Only members of the Ranger guild appear in this list.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: ranhelp
docs.text: Ranger Help for: ranhelp ========================= SYNTAX: ranhelp [topic] rh [topic] USAGE: Anywhere SUMMARY: This command accesses the Ranger guild help system. Type 'ranhelp' or 'rh' followed by a topic to view help on that subject. Without a topic, it displays a list of available help categories. This is the same as the 'rhelp' command. EXAMPLES: ranhelp skills - View help on Ranger skills rh archery - View help on archery rh general - View general guild overview

docs.title: Ranger Help for: ranhist
docs.text: Ranger Help for: ranhist ======================== SYNTAX: ranhist rhist USAGE: Anywhere SUMMARY: This command displays the recent history of the Ranger guild chat channel. It shows the last several messages sent on the 'ran' channel, including timestamps and who sent each message. This is useful for catching up on conversations you may have missed while away. The 'rhist' command is a shorter alias for 'ranhist'.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: carve arrow
docs.text: Ranger Help for: carve arrow ============================= SYNTAX: make arrow make bolt carve arrow carve bolt USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 2 BASE SP: variable SKILL TYPE: archery SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to carve arrows or crossbow bolts from wood. Arrows are used with shortbows and longbows. Bolts are used with crossbows and are required for heartshot. Ammo can be improved with flame arrow, poison arrow, and tip arrow. The same commands can be used on bolts when preparing crossbow ammunition.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: pecking birds
docs.text: Ranger Help for: pecking birds ================================ SYNTAX: rbird <target> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 6 BASE SP: 25 SKILL TYPE: religious SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to call upon a flock of birds to peck and harass a target. The birds swoop down and attack, dealing minor damage and distracting the enemy. While the damage is not great, the distraction can disrupt an opponent's concentration and give the Ranger an advantage. The number and ferocity of the birds depend on the Ranger's guild level and connection to Gaia.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: rbug
docs.text: Ranger Help for: rbug ===================== SYNTAX: rbug <bug message here> USAGE: Any wilderness terrain. SUMMARY: Allows a Ranger to report bugs within the Ranger's Guild. Please report all bugs, even if your not sure its a bug. Thank you. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: toggle and declare

docs.title: Ranger Help for: build shelter
docs.text: Ranger Help for: build shelter ================================ SYNTAX: build USAGE: forest,plains,swamp,desert,jungle,hills,road,beach, mountain,arctic,barren SLOT COST: 4 BASE SP: 25 SKILL TYPE: creation SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to construct a camp shelter for resting in the wilderness. The Ranger must have the necessary materials, including rope and wood or other tent components. A shelter provides a safe place to rest and recover. The quality of the shelter depends on the Ranger's skill level and the materials available. Shelters are temporary and will eventually deteriorate.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: call follower
docs.text: Ranger Help for: call follower ================================ SYNTAX: call USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 5 BASE SP: 20 SKILL TYPE: husbandry SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to summon their bonded animal follower to their side, regardless of where the follower currently is. The follower will make its way to the Ranger as quickly as it can. The Ranger must have previously bonded with a follower for this skill to work. If the follower has died and the Ranger has not yet called a new one, this skill will attempt to attract a new companion based on the Ranger's primary terrain.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: rcommand
docs.text: Ranger Help for: rcommand ========================= SYNTAX: rcommand <follower> <action> USAGE: Any terrain SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to issue a command to their bonded animal follower. The follower will attempt to carry out the action to the best of its ability. Common commands include attacking a target, staying in place, following the Ranger, or performing trained tricks. The follower must be in the same room as the Ranger to receive commands. Not all animals can perform all actions - the available commands depend on the follower's species and training.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: rcompare
docs.text: Ranger Help for: rcompare ========================= SYNTAX: rcompare <item1> to <item2> USAGE: Any terrain. SLOT COST: 0 BASE SP: 25 SUMMARY: Compare two weapons or pieces of armor side by side, showing their relative qualities. Higher ranked Rangers get more accurate and detailed comparisons. Both items must be in your inventory. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: inspect, sharpen, treat

docs.title: Ranger Help for: rcost
docs.text: Ranger Help for: rcost ====================== SYNTAX: rcost USAGE: Any wilderness area. SUMMARY: Check character advancement costs and combat-earned Ranger XP progress from anywhere in the wilderness. Also shows the slots granted by the next Ranger guild level. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: radvance, advancement, glevels

docs.title: Ranger Help for: rdefend
docs.text: Ranger Help for: rdefend ======================== SYNTAX: rdefend USAGE: Any terrain SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to adopt a defensive combat stance. While in defensive stance, the Ranger prioritizes evasion and blocking over attacking, gaining improved damage reduction and dodge chance at the cost of reduced offensive output. This stance is useful when facing overwhelming odds or when the Ranger needs to survive long enough for help to arrive. Use 'rdefend' again to return to normal stance.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: reattune
docs.text: Ranger Help for: reattune ========================= SYNTAX: reattune reattune primary <terrain> reattune secondary <terrain> reattune enemy <species> USAGE: Ranger lodge or Warden Thorn's meadow. SUMMARY: Warden Thorn can perform a reattunement ritual for Rangers who need to change their primary terrain, secondary terrain, or enemy species after their first choice. The ritual cannot be performed while fighting or while you have an active follower with you. It does not cost experience. After a successful reattunement, your bond must settle for seven days before the ritual can be performed again. If you change your primary terrain and your current enemy species is not valid for the new terrain, your enemy species will be cleared. Use 'setenemy' to choose a new one. Use 'reattune' with no arguments to see your current affinities, ritual attunement state and cooldown. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: setprime, setsecond, setenemy, rscore and survey

docs.title: Ranger Help for: rebuild
docs.text: Ranger Help for: rebuild ======================== SYNTAX: rebuild quiver USAGE: Anywhere. SUMMARY: Creates a brand new quiver if you have lost yours. Your quiver is the physical manifestation of your bond with the Rangers guild and is required for most guild commands to work. If your quiver exists but is malfunctioning, use 'repair quiver' instead. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: repair

docs.title: Ranger Help for: rebuild
docs.text: Ranger Help for: rebuild ======================== SYNTAX: rebuild quiver USAGE: Any wilderness terrain. SUMMARY: If a Ranger is having problems with his/her commands, they can try using this command to refresh their quiver. This is logged. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: repair

docs.title: Ranger Help for: reconnoiter
docs.text: Ranger Help for: reconnoiter ============================= SYNTAX: recon <direction> reconnoiter <direction> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 40 SKILL TYPE: cartography SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to scout an adjacent room without entering it, revealing information about what lies in that direction. The scout report includes creatures present, other players, notable items, and the terrain type. The amount of detail depends on the Ranger's skill level and perception. Reconnoiter is useful for planning routes and avoiding dangerous encounters. The alias 'recon' can be used for speed.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: reconnoiter(recon)
docs.text: Ranger Help for: reconnoiter(recon) =================================== SYNTAX: reconnoiter <direction>/reconnoiter far <direction> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 7 BASE SP: 40 sp SKILL TYPE: knowledge SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to take in information, such as sound, smells and keen eyesight to get an idea of what creatures are in the direction that the Ranger reconnoiters. Extra perceptive Rangers can sense far(two rooms aways).

docs.title: Ranger Help for: recruit
docs.text: Ranger Help for: recruit ======================== SYNTAX: recruit <player name> (or: solicit) USAGE: Anywhere. SUMMARY: Offers to recruit another player into the Rangers guild. The target player must be in the same room as you. You must be at least guild level 5 to recruit. The target player will receive an invitation they can accept or ignore. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: rangers

docs.title: Ranger Help for: religious
docs.text: Ranger Help for: religious ========================== SUMMARY: The Religious branch represents the divine gifts granted to Rangers by Gaia herself. These powers are rare and demanding, drawing heavily on the Ranger's spell points, but they can turn the tide of battle or save a life in desperate moments. Key religious skills include: Meditation - Restore spell points through communion with nature Ceremony - Perform a ritual to honor Gaia Wrath of Gaia - Powerful nature damage spell Winter's Bite - Cold damage attack channeling winter's fury Essence of the Land - Draw power from surrounding terrain for stat buffs Seasonal Flux - Channel the current season's energy into an attack Nature's Protection - Create a protective aura reducing incoming damage Gaia's Eyes - Remote viewing of distant rooms Gaia's Touch - Healing touch channeling Gaia's restorative power Tap Stone - Draw spell points from the earth through stone Pecking Birds - Call birds to harass and distract a target Gaia Incarnate - Transform into an avatar of Gaia These powers are strongest when performed in the Ranger's primary terrain and weakest when alignment strays from neutral. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: martial, wilderness, philosophy

docs.title: Ranger Help for: repair
docs.text: Ranger Help for: repair ======================= SYNTAX: repair quiver USAGE: Anywhere. SUMMARY: Refreshes your existing quiver, fixing any issues with it. This destroys your current quiver and creates a fresh one, restoring your command paths and guild functionality. If you have completely lost your quiver, use 'rebuild quiver' instead. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: rebuild

docs.title: Ranger Help for: repair
docs.text: Ranger Help for: repair ======================= SYNTAX: repair quiver USAGE: Any wilderness terrain. SUMMARY: If a Ranger is having problems with his/her commands, they can try using this command to refresh their quiver. This is logged. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: Restore

docs.title: Ranger Help for: rest
docs.text: Ranger Help for: rest ===================== SYNTAX: rest rest camp (or: rest home) USAGE: Wilderness SLOT COST: 10 BASE SP: 35 (rest) / 50 (rest camp) SKILL TYPE: Cartography SUMMARY: Rest has two modes: REST (heal): Find a sheltered spot and rest briefly, recovering HP and SP. Must be in the wilderness and not in combat. Healing scales with your constitution and wisdom. You will sit down while resting. REST CAMP / REST HOME (travel): Return to your own camp from anywhere. Costs 50 SP. You must have a camp established (see 'camp' for setup instructions). This is the fastest way to get back to your base. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: camp, camps, trailblaze, advancement

docs.title: Ranger Help for: rest
docs.text: Ranger Help for: rest ===================== SYNTAX: rest USAGE: forest,plains,swamp,desert,jungle,hills,inside,beach, underground,mountain,arctic,barren,outside SLOT COST: 7 BASE SP: 35 sp SKILL TYPE: aid SUMMARY: When a Ranger rests, he or she finds a cozy spot in the wilderness and lies down for a good nap. While resting, the Ranger heals at an increased rate, but he or she can't do or see anything. Length of resting periods is variable and theres is no way to break it.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: gaia's eyes
docs.text: Ranger Help for: gaia's eyes ============================= SYNTAX: reyes USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 10 BASE SP: variable SKILL TYPE: religious SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to use Gaia's sight to view distant rooms without physically traveling to them. The Ranger enters a trance-like state and sees through the eyes of nature itself. The range of the remote viewing scales with the Ranger's guild level and wisdom. This is useful for scouting ahead or locating specific areas without putting the Ranger in danger.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: rh
docs.text: Ranger Help for: rh ==================== SYNTAX: rh [topic] rhelp [topic] ranhelp [topic] USAGE: Anywhere SUMMARY: This command accesses the Ranger guild help system. Type 'rh' followed by a topic to view help on that subject. Without a topic, it displays a list of available help categories. The 'rh' command is a shorthand alias for 'rhelp' and 'ranhelp'. EXAMPLES: rh skills - View help on Ranger skills rh archery - View help on archery rh general - View general guild overview

docs.title: Ranger Help for: rhelp
docs.text: Ranger Help for: rhelp ====================== SYNTAX: rhelp [topic] rh [topic] ranhelp [topic] USAGE: Anywhere SUMMARY: This command accesses the Ranger guild help system. Type 'rhelp' or 'rh' followed by a topic to view help on that subject. Without a topic, it displays a list of available help categories. EXAMPLES: rhelp skills - View help on Ranger skills rhelp archery - View help on archery rhelp general - View general guild overview HELP CATEGORIES: general - Guild overview skills - Skill system overview advancement - How to advance in the guild terrains - Terrain system followers - Animal companion system weapons - Ranger weapons archery - Ranged combat equipment - Gear and armour

docs.title: RANGER'S GUILD HELP
docs.text: RANGER'S GUILD HELP ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- COMMAND: DESCRIPTION: -------- ------------ ranhelp Shows this screen. Do 'ranhelp <command/topic>' for further info on most things. You may use 'rh' in place of 'ranhelp'. rangers Shows what Rangers are currently on. rangerbug <message> Reports a bug about Rangers. ran <message> Chats on the Ranger Guild line. eran <message> Emotes on the Ranger Guild line. skills Shows your current skills. bio Shows your personal Ranger bio. slots/slots # Shows how many slots you have and available skills for you. recruit <name> Recruits another player into the guild. They have to accept. rebuild quiver If you have lost your quiver, you can get a new one with this command. repair quiver Refreshes your quiver if you are having problems. motto <motto> Declares your motto which is seen on the rangers screen. improve <what> Advances stats and your level. cost Shows current costs for advancing. journal Lists available quests. learn <skill> Lets you learns a new skill. check <terrain> Checks what skills are available to be learned or used in that terrain. ADDITIONAL TOPICS: glevels terrains stats archery weapons armour emotes followers enemy alignment history skills TERRAINS: forest plains swamp desert jungle city hills sea lake river road dock inside beach underground mountain arctic barren underwater

docs.title: Ranger Help for: ride
docs.text: Ranger Help for: ride ===================== SYNTAX: ride <garou> USAGE: Any terrain SUMMARY: This skill will allow a Ranger to ride a garou mount for faster travel. This feature is not yet available. When implemented, Rangers will be able to mount willing garou companions and travel at increased speed across the wilderness. Check back for updates as this skill is still under development.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: ride
docs.text: Ranger Help for: ride ===================== SYNTAX: ride <garou target> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 4 BASE SP: 65 sp SKILL TYPE: aid SUMMARY: This skills allows a Ranger and a willing garou(in wolf form) to become allies. The Ranger rides and fights on the Garou's back. More to come on this one.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: river
docs.text: Ranger Help for: river ====================== SUMMARY: The river may not be smaller than a lake since its volume of water is spread out over a long run. Its is usually charaterized by rushing fresh water down a gully or other lower land feature. Just as with lakes, Rangers don't live in rivers, but around them. They are great source of food and can be found on most of the continents. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: Individual terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: road
docs.text: Ranger Help for: road ===================== SUMMARY: Roads are built between cities or cities and other natural features to allow ease of movement and location. While Rangers do not need roads to move around, they use them when it is convenient. Most skills work on roads, and roads can be found in almost all of the realms. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: Individual terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: nature's protection
docs.text: Ranger Help for: nature's protection ====================================== SYNTAX: rprotect USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 7 BASE SP: variable SKILL TYPE: religious SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to call upon Gaia for a protective aura that surrounds the Ranger and reduces incoming damage for a duration. The strength and duration of the protection depend on the Ranger's wisdom and guild level. This aura is a gift from Gaia and works in any terrain, though it is strongest in the Ranger's primary terrain. The protection fades over time and must be renewed.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: make rope
docs.text: Ranger Help for: make rope =========================== SYNTAX: rope USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 3 BASE SP: 15 SKILL TYPE: creation SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to craft rope from natural materials such as vines and grasses. Rope is an essential component in several other crafting skills, including making tents, bows, and fish traps. The Ranger must have suitable materials in their inventory. The quality and length of the rope depends on the materials used and the Ranger's crafting proficiency.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: rscore
docs.text: Ranger Help for: rscore ======================= SYNTAX: rscore (or: rsc) USAGE: Anywhere. SUMMARY: Display your full Ranger score report. Shows rank, skill scores, terrains, stats, and camp information. FIELDS: Rank Your rank based on skill slots invested Ranger XP Progress toward your next Ranger guild level Wilderness Score from Survival + Cartography + Hunting skills Martial Score from Attack + Archery skills Spiritual Score from Husbandry skills Skills Number learned out of the current skill table Slots Remaining and invested skill slots Terrain Your primary and secondary terrain Enemy Your enemy species (+30% crit bonus) Adapt Arctic or Desert survival specialization Follower Your current bonded animal companion Camp Your camp location (login point) ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: glevels, skills, advancement, rangers

docs.title: Ranger Help for: skin animal
docs.text: Ranger Help for: skin animal ============================= SYNTAX: skin <corpse> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 3 BASE SP: variable SKILL TYPE: creation SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to skin the corpse of a slain creature, obtaining meat and hide in the process. The hide can be fashioned into a leather pouch, and leftover meat can be eaten for sustenance. The size of the pouch depends on how large the corpse was. The Ranger must be wielding a slash type weapon to perform the skinning. How much usable material the Ranger gets depends on skill and dexterity.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: tap stone
docs.text: Ranger Help for: tap stone =========================== SYNTAX: rtap USAGE: mountain,underground SLOT COST: 6 BASE SP: NA SKILL TYPE: religious SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to tap into the deep energy of the earth through stone, restoring spell points. The Ranger places a hand on the stone and draws power from the earth itself. This skill works best in underground areas and mountains where the connection to raw stone is strongest. The amount of spell points restored depends on the Ranger's wisdom and guild level.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: make torch
docs.text: Ranger Help for: make torch ============================ SYNTAX: torch USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 2 BASE SP: 10 SKILL TYPE: creation SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to create a torch from harvested wood. The torch provides light in dark areas, which is essential when exploring caves, underground passages, or traveling at night. The Ranger must have wood in their inventory to create the torch. How long the torch lasts depends on the quality of the wood and the Ranger's crafting skill.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: gaia's touch
docs.text: Ranger Help for: gaia's touch =============================== SYNTAX: rtouch <target> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 8 BASE SP: variable SKILL TYPE: religious SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to channel Gaia's restorative power through touch, healing the wounds of a target. The amount of hit points healed depends on the Ranger's wisdom, guild level, and connection to Gaia. The Ranger may use this skill on themselves or on an ally. Healing is more effective in the Ranger's primary terrain, where the connection to the land is strongest.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: run
docs.text: Ranger Help for: run ==================== SYNTAX: run <dir> [dir] [dir] ... USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 5 per room SKILL TYPE: cartography SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to sprint through multiple rooms in quick succession by specifying a series of directions. The Ranger moves rapidly through each room without stopping, costing 5 SP per room traversed. This is useful for covering long distances quickly or fleeing from danger. The Ranger cannot stop mid-run and may be interrupted by obstacles, locked doors, or aggressive creatures.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: sea
docs.text: Ranger Help for: sea ==================== SUMMARY: The sea terrain is pretty obvious. A large body of water between continents or islands. The water is usually salty and only aquatic type animals or fish are found there. There is no Ranger population in the sea and skill use is limited there too. Seas are found between all of the major continents. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: Individual terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: setenemy
docs.text: Ranger Help for: setenemy ========================= SYNTAX: setenemy/setenemy <race here> USAGE: Any wilderness terrain. SUMMARY: Setenemy allows a Ranger to set his or her enemy species. What races a Ranger can set is based on his or her primary terrain, so it must be set first. You can type just setenemy with no argument to see a list of allowable races. Keep in mind that your follower cannot be of the same race as your enemy species. So if you like horses, don't choose horse as your enemy species. Use 'rhelp <species>' or 'rhelp enemy <species>' before choosing. For example: 'rhelp bear', 'rhelp enemy dragon', or 'rhelp lycanthrope'. Changing your enemy species later requires Warden Thorn's reattunement ritual. Use 'rhelp reattune' for details. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: enemy, followers, setprime and reattune

docs.title: Ranger Help for: setenemy
docs.text: Ranger Help for: setenemy ========================= SYNTAX: setenemy/setenemy <race here> USAGE: Any wilderness terrain. SUMMARY: Setenemy allows a Ranger to set his or her enemy species. What races a Ranger can set is based on his or her primary terrain, so it must be set first. You can type just setenemy with no argument to see a list of allowable races. Keep in mind that your follower cannot be of the same race as your enemy species. So if you like horses, don't choose horse as your enemy species. Use 'rhelp <species>' or 'rhelp enemy <species>' before choosing. For example: 'rhelp bear', 'rhelp enemy dragon', or 'rhelp lycanthrope'. Against the chosen enemy species, Rangers gain meaningful combat bonuses. At present this means a large increase to critical chance during combat (currently +30 crit), plus a sizable damage bonus on Ranger attacks and attack skills against that species (currently about +33% damage). Enemy choice also affects certain follower and animal interactions, so it is both a combat and role identity decision. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: enemy, followers, setprime and reattune

docs.title: Ranger Help for: setprime
docs.text: Ranger Help for: setprime ========================= SYNTAX: setprime/setprime <your primary terrain name here> USAGE: Any wilderness terrain. SUMMARY: Allows the Ranger to set his or her first primary terrain. Available terrains are: forest plains swamp desert jungle hills beach arctic barren underground mountain A Ranger's primary terrain is the terrain in which he/she grew up in. A Ranger's primary terrain will affect such things as fighting, allowing him/her to fight better due the fact that he/she knows the terrain better. It will also affect what kinds of followers a Ranger might attract, or what kinds of animals he/she might try to sooth. It will affect almost everything a Ranger does, choose it carefully. Choose your primary terrain carefully. Changing it later requires Warden Thorn's reattunement ritual. Use 'rhelp reattune' for details. NOTE: Primary and secondary terrains can be the same. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: setsecond, setenemy, reattune, terrains, survey and followers

docs.title: Ranger Help for: setprime
docs.text: Ranger Help for: setprime ========================= SYNTAX: setprime/setprime <your primary terrain name here> USAGE: Any wilderness terrain. SUMMARY: Allows the Ranger to set his or her primary terrain. YOU MAY ONLY USE THIS COMMAND ONCE. Available terrains are: forest plains swamp desert jungle hills beach arctic barren underground mountain A Ranger's primary terrain is the terrain in which he/she grew up in. A Ranger's primary terrain will affect such things as fighting, allowing him/her to fight better due the fact that he/she knows the terrain better. It will also affect what kinds of followers a Ranger might attract, or what kinds of animals he/she might try to sooth. It will affect almost everything a Ranger does, choose it carefully. In direct combat, a Ranger's primary terrain currently grants better defensive footing and stronger strikes. While fighting in primary terrain, the Ranger currently gains +20 dodge and roughly +20% damage. Many Ranger skills also feel more efficient or more dangerous in that terrain. Choose your primary terrain carefully, for it is a one time command. Use 'rhelp <terrain>' to read about each terrain before choosing. NOTE: Primary and secondary terrains can be the same. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: setsecond, setenemy, terrains, survey and followers

docs.title: Ranger Help for: setsecond
docs.text: Ranger Help for: setsecond ========================== SYNTAX: setsecond/setsecond <your secondary terrain name here> USAGE: Any wilderness terrain/one time use. SUMMARY: Allows the Ranger to set his or her first secondary terrain. Available terrains are: forest plains swamp desert jungle hills beach arctic barren underground mountain A Ranger's secondary terrain is the terrain in which the he/she spent some time in growing up. But the Ranger doesn't know it as well as they're primary terrain. A Ranger's secondary terrain will affecT the same kinds of things as their primary terrain, just not as much. Choose your secondary terrain carefully. Changing it later requires Warden Thorn's reattunement ritual. Use 'rhelp reattune' for details. NOTE: Primary and secondary terrains can be the same. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: setprime, setenemy, reattune, terrains, survey and followers

docs.title: Ranger Help for: setsecond
docs.text: Ranger Help for: setsecond ========================== SYNTAX: setsecond/setsecond <your secondary terrain name here> USAGE: Any wilderness terrain/one time use. SUMMARY: Allows the Ranger to set his or her secondary terrain. THIS COMMAND MAY ONLY BE USED ONCE. Available terrains are: forest plains swamp desert jungle hills beach arctic barren underground mountain A Ranger's secondary terrain is the terrain in which the he/she spent some time in growing up. But the Ranger doesn't know it as well as they're primary terrain. A Ranger's secondary terrain will affecT the same kinds of things as their primary terrain, just not as much. In combat, secondary terrain still matters. A Ranger fighting there currently receives +10 dodge and roughly +10% damage. It is not as strong as primary terrain, but it is still a meaningful edge over unfavored ground. Choose your secondary terrain carefully, for it is a one time command. Use 'rhelp <terrain>' to read about each terrain before choosing. NOTE: Primary and secondary terrains can be the same. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: setprime, setenemy, terrains, survey and followers

docs.title: Ranger Help for: sharpen
docs.text: Ranger Help for: sharpen ======================== SYNTAX: sharpen <weapon> edge <weapon> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 35 SKILL TYPE: survival SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to sharpen a bladed weapon using a rock, improving its damage temporarily. The Ranger must have a rock in their inventory. Only slash and pierce weapons can be sharpened. The effectiveness depends on the Ranger's training, and the keen edge persists for a meaningful stretch of time before it dulls again. The 'edge' command is an alias for 'sharpen'. If you are in hills, mountains, or underground terrain, you can use 'quarry' to gather a suitable rock first.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: signal
docs.text: Ranger Help for: signal ======================= SYNTAX: signal <player> <message> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 1 SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to send a short message to another player through natural means - bird calls, wind patterns, and other nature signals. The target player receives the message regardless of distance. Only Rangers can send signals, but any player can receive them. The extremely low SP cost reflects the simplicity of using natural phenomena to carry messages. This is an in-character alternative to tells.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: signal
docs.text: Ranger Help for: signal ======================= SYNTAX: signal <target> <message> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 2 BASE SP: 1 sp SKILL TYPE: aid SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to use the elements of nature to communicate with friend or foe. The target must be smart enough to understand the message, because it will come via a variety of ways. Its use is limited to targets on the same continent.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: skills
docs.text: Ranger Help for: skills ======================= SUMMARY: Rangers learn skills by spending slots. Each skill has a fixed slot cost; learning does not consume ordinary experience or Ranger XP. HOW SKILLS WORK: - Skills are organized in a TREE. Learning one skill unlocks others. - Type 'skilltree' to see the full tree with your progress. - Type 'learn' to see what you can learn right now. - Type 'learn cost <skill>' to see exact costs and requirements. - Type 'learn <skill>' to learn it. SKILL BRANCHES: Survival Crafting, gathering, camping, herb mixing Cartography Navigation, scouting, terrain knowledge, mining Hunting Tracking, stealth, skinning, snares Husbandry Animal companions, calming, training Attack Melee combat techniques Archery Bow crafting, arrow enhancement, ranged specials TERRAIN BONUSES: Many skills work differently based on terrain. Skills used in your primary terrain cost less SP, have shorter cooldowns, and deal more damage. Your secondary terrain provides smaller bonuses. Some skills only work in specific terrains - use 'check <terrain>' to see what works where. COOLDOWN CATEGORIES: Ranger skills recover by category rather than all sharing one timer. For example, a combat maneuver will delay another combat maneuver, but it will not stop you from doing fieldwork or crafting. Recovery skills such as rest and camp tend are broader pauses. CRAFTING: Rangers are self-sufficient. Use 'make' to craft items: make rope Twist grasses into rope (grass terrain) make torch Carve a wooden torch (wood terrain) make fish trap Weave a trap for catching camp fish make tent Build a tent from rope + wood make tools Craft tools from rope + rock + wood make satchel Expand your wildcraft forage pouch make arrow Carve arrows from wood make bolt Carve crossbow bolts from wood make bow Carve a shortbow from wood make crossbow Carve a crossbow from wood make longbow Carve a longbow from wood make trophy Mount a trophy from a corpse make snare <dir> Set a snare trap in a direction Basic crafting flow: forage -> make rope -> make tent -> camp forage -> make torch (for light) forage + mine -> make tools -> mine skin corpse + forage -> make satchel make arrow/bolt + make bow/crossbow -> archery combat STARTING OUT: Your first available skill is 'forage'. Learn it, then learn the skills it unlocks (make rope, make torch, survey). From there the tree branches into all six categories. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: skilltree, learn, slots, glevels, advancement, make, cooldowns

docs.title: Ranger Help for: skills
docs.text: Ranger Help for: skills ======================= SUMMARY: Rangers learn skills by spending slots. Each skill has a fixed slot cost; learning does not consume ordinary experience or Ranger XP. HOW SKILLS WORK: - Skills are organized in a TREE. Learning one skill unlocks others. - Type 'skilltree' to see the full tree with your progress. - Type 'learn' to see what you can learn right now. - Type 'learn cost <skill>' to see exact costs and requirements. - Type 'learn <skill>' to learn it. SKILL BRANCHES: Survival Crafting, gathering, camping, herb mixing Cartography Navigation, scouting, terrain knowledge, mining Hunting Tracking, stealth, skinning, snares Husbandry Animal companions, calming, training Attack Melee combat techniques Archery Bow crafting, arrow enhancement, ranged specials TERRAIN BONUSES: Many skills work differently based on terrain. Skills used in your primary terrain cost less SP, have shorter cooldowns, and deal more damage. Your secondary terrain provides smaller bonuses. Some skills only work in specific terrains - use 'check <terrain>' to see what works where. CRAFTING CHAIN: Rangers are self-sufficient. The basic crafting flow is: harvest -> get wood (in forest terrain) harvest -> get rocks (in mountain/hills/underground) forage herbs -> mix into salve or poison skin corpse -> get meat, hide, and a pouch wood + rope + rock -> make tools tools -> mine for gold/silver nuggets wood -> carve arrows, carve bow, make torch, make rope STARTING OUT: Your first available skill is 'forage'. Learn it, then learn the skills it unlocks (make rope, make torch, survey). From there the tree branches into all six categories. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: skilltree, learn, slots, glevels, advancement

docs.title: Ranger Help for: skilltree
docs.text: Ranger Help for: skilltree ========================== SYNTAX: skilltree (or: tree) USAGE: Anywhere. SUMMARY: Shows the complete Ranger skill tree organized by branch: Survival, Cartography, Hunting, Husbandry, Attack, and Archery. Each skill is marked with its status: [*] = learned (ready to use) [ ] = available to learn (prerequisites met) [-] = locked (prerequisites not yet met) The tree also shows slot costs and prerequisite skills for each entry. Use this to plan which skills to learn next. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: learn, slots, skills, advancement

docs.title: Ranger Help for: skin
docs.text: Ranger Help for: skin ===================== SYNTAX: skin USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 20 SKILL TYPE: hunting SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to skin a corpse, harvesting useful materials from a slain creature. The Ranger must have a slash-type weapon wielded and a corpse present in the room. Skinning field-dresses the corpse into Ranger survival stores instead of loose inventory clutter. It can add raw meat to camp stores and hide scraps or sinew to wildcraft supplies. These materials support camp cooking, camp tending, make satchel, and other survival work.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: skin
docs.text: Ranger Help for: skin ===================== SYNTAX: skin corpse USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 3 BASE SP: Variable(5-50) SKILL TYPE: creation SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to skin the corpse of a slain foe, and create a leather pouch from it. Usually there is some amount of meat left over from the process that a resourceful Ranger might be able to use. The amount of stuff that can fit in the pouch is dependent on how big of a corpse the skin came from. The Ranger must be using a slash type weapon in order to skin the corpse.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: slots
docs.text: Ranger Help for: slots ====================== SYNTAX: slots USAGE: Anywhere. SUMMARY: Shows how many skill slots you have available and which skills you can currently learn with their slot costs. Slots are earned by advancing your guild level. Each guild level grants between 4 and 20 slots (higher levels give more). You spend slots to learn skills. Learning never consumes ordinary experience or banked Ranger XP. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: glevels, learn, skilltree

docs.title: Ranger Help for: slots
docs.text: Ranger Help for: slots ====================== SYNTAX: slots/slots # USAGE: Any wilderness terrain. SUMMARY: Shows a Ranger how many slots he/she has available. It also shows which skills are available to be learned by the Ranger. Slots are used to buy skills with. Additional slots are gained as a Ranger's guild level goes up. You may also type slots with a number between 1-15 as an argument to see a list of skills in that slot level. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: glevels, myskills, learn and myinfo

docs.title: Ranger Help for: move silently
docs.text: Ranger Help for: move silently ================================ SYNTAX: smove <direction> USAGE: forest,plains,swamp,desert,jungle,hills,road,beach, underground,mountain,arctic,barren SLOT COST: 7 BASE SP: 20 SKILL TYPE: stealth SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to move to an adjacent room without being noticed by other creatures or players. The chance of being detected depends on the Ranger's dexterity, skill level, and the terrain. Some terrains are easier to move silently through than others. Forests and swamps offer natural cover, while open plains and roads are more difficult. Moving silently is essential for setting up ambushes or avoiding dangerous encounters.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: set snare
docs.text: Ranger Help for: set snare =========================== SYNTAX: snare USAGE: forest,plains,swamp,desert,jungle,hills,road,beach, underground,mountain,arctic,barren SLOT COST: 9 BASE SP: 35 SKILL TYPE: defensive SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to set up a hidden snare trap in the surrounding terrain. Players or NPCs that are in the room when the snare is set cannot be caught in it, since they are aware of its presence. The first creature that wanders into the room will be caught. Rangers, being adept at reading the wild, can spot and avoid snare traps set by other Rangers. How long a victim remains snared depends on how proficient the Ranger is at making them.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: snare
docs.text: Ranger Help for: snare ====================== SYNTAX: snare USAGE: forest,plains,swamp,desert,jungle,hills,road,beach, underground,mountain,arctic,barren SLOT COST: 9 BASE SP: 35 sp SKILL TYPE: defensive SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to set up a snare trap in certain areas that have the right materials to make one. Players or NPCs that are in the room with the Ranger at the time it is made, cannot be caught in it, since they know about it. But, the first player or NPC that wonders into the room will be caught in the snare. The only exception to this, is when a Ranger enters the room, being extra adept at noting things in the wild, Rangers can avoid snare traps. How long a player is snared depends on how proficient the Ranger is at making it.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: stalk
docs.text: Ranger Help for: stalk ====================== SYNTAX: stalk <target> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 20 SKILL TYPE: stealth SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to shadow a target, following them with partial concealment. While stalking, the Ranger gains a bonus to hit on their next attack against the stalked target. The Ranger remains partially hidden from other creatures but is not fully invisible. Stalking is broken if the Ranger attacks a different target or is detected. This skill combines elements of stealth and combat preparation, making it useful for setting up an opening strike.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: stalk
docs.text: Ranger Help for: stalk ====================== SYNTAX: stalk <target> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 11 BASE SP: 20 initially, 10 sp per move SKILL TYPE: tracking SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to trail close behind or follow a query through any area the query can go. Several things can cause a Ranger to lose his or her query, such as the query is wiser than the Ranger, or just by chance, or if the Ranger runs out of stamina points. Rangers can only trail less wise Rangers than themselves.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: stats
docs.text: Ranger Help for: stats ====================== SUMMARY: If Rangers are one thing, they are balanced. Rangers do not train in just one area of the mind or body. They have to be tough in all aspects to be successful. Almost all of the stats will be used in one way or the other, one skill or the other. All Rangers will benefit from training the physical stats, such as strength, dexterity, and constitution, for obvious reasons. However, the most important stat is wisdom. Lacking formal training, a Ranger depends on his or her wisdom to keep them alive and breathing. Having said that though, if you think a skill might use a stat in some way, it probably does, so it won't hurt to raise any stat. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: glevels

docs.title: Ranger Help for: stats
docs.text: Ranger Help for: stats ====================== SUMMARY: If Rangers are one thing, they are balanced. Rangers do not train in just one area of the mind or body. They have to be tough in all aspects to be successful. Almost all of the stats will be used in one way or the other, one skill or the other. All Rangers will benefit from training the physical stats, such as strength, dexterity, and constitution, for obvious reasons. However, the most important stat is wisdom. Lacking formal training, a Ranger depends on his or her wisdom to keep them alive and breathing. Having said that though, if you think a skill might use a stat in some way, it probably does, so it won't hurt to raise any stat. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: glevels

docs.title: Ranger Help for: strike
docs.text: Ranger Help for: strike ======================= SYNTAX: strike <target> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 25 SKILL TYPE: attack SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to deliver an enhanced melee hit against a target. Strike is the basic combat attack skill for Rangers, dealing more damage than a standard attack. It works with any wielded weapon and in any terrain. Strike is often the first attack skill a Ranger learns and serves as the foundation for more advanced techniques like gash, impale, and naturestrike.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: strike
docs.text: Ranger Help for: strike ======================= SYNTAX: strike <target> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 3 BASE SP: 40 sp SKILL TYPE: attack SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to use any blunt weapon and inflict decent amounts of damage to an opponent. Bonus damage against a Ranger's enemy species.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: strip
docs.text: Ranger Help for: strip ====================== SYNTAX: strip <target> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 10 BASE SP: 50 sp SKILL TYPE: defensive SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to attempt to strip an opponent's weapon from them. Both of the Ranger's hands must be free in order to strip the weapon away. If the target is wielding two weapons, only one will be stripped and which one you strip is random, depending on which one the Ranger gets his or her hands on first.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: study
docs.text: Ranger Help for: study ====================== SYNTAX: study USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 15 SKILL TYPE: cartography SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to perform a detailed analysis of their current area, revealing information about the terrain, exits, hidden features, and environmental conditions. Study provides more detail than a standard look, including terrain type, weather effects, and any notable natural features. The depth of information revealed depends on the Ranger's skill level and familiarity with the terrain.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: study
docs.text: Ranger Help for: study ====================== SYNTAX: study area USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 8 BASE SP: 15 sp SKILL TYPE: knowledge SUMMARY: When a Ranger studies an area, he or she takes special note of the surroundings. Such intense study allows a Ranger to pick out things of note, or interesting actions in the area.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: survey
docs.text: Ranger Help for: survey ======================= SYNTAX: survey (or: id) USAGE: Any terrain. SLOT COST: 1 BASE SP: 2 SUMMARY: Surveys the terrain you are standing in, identifying all terrain types present and displaying them with color codes. Also reports whether you are in your primary terrain, secondary terrain, or claimed warden range, and shows the domain name. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: terrains, setprime, setsecond, check

docs.title: Ranger Help for: survey(id)
docs.text: Ranger Help for: survey(id) =========================== SYNTAX: survey/id USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 1 BASE SP: 2 SKILL TYPE: knowledge SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to survey the type of terrain he or she is in. You will note some characteristics of the area and make a decision as to what terrain you are in. When a terrain is shown, it will be in its color. Also, if your are in your range, primary or secondary terrains, they will be show as well.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: swamp
docs.text: Ranger Help for: swamp ====================== SUMMARY: The swamp is a dark looking place, wet and dank. There are many trees and stumps, with standing water everywhere. Life is abundant here, as well as the Ranger population. Most Ranger skills will work in the swamp terrain. Swamps can be found on Darkwind, and Kerei. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: Individual terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: swiftstrike
docs.text: Ranger Help for: swiftstrike ============================= SYNTAX: swiftstrike <target> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 13 BASE SP: 90 SKILL TYPE: attack REQUIRES: improvise SUMMARY: Swiftstrike drives a Ranger into a focused melee cadence against a single target. The Ranger must be wielding a slashing weapon. While the rhythm holds, each slash builds momentum. Every third step in the cadence breaks open into a violent burst of extra cuts, with stronger payoff when the Ranger is fighting a favored enemy, moving through favored terrain, or attacking from a circling flank. This is a pressure skill, not a single heavy strike. It rewards staying on one target, reading its movement, and layering other Ranger melee tools on top of the tempo. Rangers who can circle behind a foe or bring swiftstrike to bear on a hated enemy will feel the burst become much deadlier.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: taint
docs.text: Ranger Help for: taint ====================== SYNTAX: taint arrow/bolt USAGE: forest,plains,jungle,swamp,desert SLOT COST: 5 BASE SP: 10 sp SKILL TYPE: arrow SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to use some of the native poisons in certain terrains to poison the tips of arrows and bolts. Poisoned arrows and bolts do increased damage over plain ones. Arrows are used in shortbows and longbows while bolts are used in crossbows.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: teach
docs.text: Ranger Help for: teach ====================== SYNTAX: teach follower to <task> USAGE: Any terrain BASE SP: 10 sp SUMMARY: This command allows a Ranger to teach his or her follower to do a task. Whether or not a Ranger can teach the follower s certain task is based on how smart the follower is and how many tasks the follower already knows. Teachable tasks are: Easy Tasks: fight, carry and guard Medium Tasks: hide, fetch and deliver Difficult Tasks: spy, scout and forage ============================================================================ SEE ALSO: seek, fight, carry, guard, hide, fetch, deliver, spy, scout and forage

docs.title: Ranger Help for: terrains
docs.text: Ranger Help for: terrains ========================= SUMMARY: Different terrains are found all over the realms of Darkwind. Rangers will move through many of them, and Rangers are not penalized just for fighting or exploring outside their primary and secondary terrains. Primary and secondary terrain still matter. They improve a Ranger's footing in combat and can influence the cost, cooldown, damage, or feel of many Ranger skills. Some skills also require a specific kind of land. Use 'rhelp <terrain>' to read about a specific terrain. EXAMPLES: rhelp forest rhelp desert rhelp mountain rhelp dock TERRAINS: forest plains swamp desert jungle hills beach arctic barren underground mountain city sea lake river road dock inside underwater outside ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: setprime, setsecond, survey and check

docs.title: Ranger Help for: terrains
docs.text: Ranger Help for: terrains ========================= SUMMARY: Different terrains are found all over the realms of Darkwind. Rangers will move through many of them, and Rangers are not penalized just for fighting or exploring outside their primary and secondary terrains. Primary and secondary terrain still matter. They improve a Ranger's footing in combat and can influence the cost, cooldown, damage, or feel of many Ranger skills. Some skills also require a specific kind of land. Use 'rhelp <terrain>' to read about a specific terrain. EXAMPLES: rhelp forest rhelp desert rhelp mountain rhelp dock TERRAINS: forest plains swamp desert jungle hills beach arctic barren underground mountain city sea lake river road dock inside underwater outside ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: setprime, setsecond, survey and check

docs.title: Ranger Help for: tip arrow
docs.text: Ranger Help for: tip arrow =========================== SYNTAX: goldtip arrow goldtip bolt silvertip arrow silvertip bolt tip arrow gold tip bolt silver USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 15 SKILL TYPE: archery SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to tip an arrow or bolt with a gold or silver nugget, creating precious metal-tipped ammunition. The Ranger needs ammo and a nugget, usually obtained from mining. Gold-tipped ammo is especially accurate, while silver-tipped ammo is useful against creatures vulnerable to silver.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: torch
docs.text: Ranger Help for: torch ====================== SYNTAX: torch arrow/bolt USAGE: forest,plains,jungle,swamp,beach SLOT COST: 5 BASE SP: 15 sp SKILL TYPE: arrow SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to take an arrow or bolt and set it a blaze. Flaming arrows do a good deal more damage than plain or other enhanced arrows or bolts. Arrows are used in shortbows and longbows, while bolts are used in crossbows. Flaming arrows only last for so long, and then they burn up.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: track
docs.text: Ranger Help for: track ====================== SYNTAX: track <opponent> USAGE: forest,plains,swamp,desert,jungle,hills,road,beach, mountain,arctic,barren,outside,underground SLOT COST: 13 BASE SP: 50 sp SKILL TYPE: tracking SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to track down opponents like dogs. A Ranger can set out to track an opponent in any terrain, but once the Ranger finds the tracks, they may only be intermitent..IE: tracks won't be left in water terrains. And just remember, because you find a set of tracks, it doesn't mean its your query. You must look over the tracks and determine if its your foe from what you know of him or her. Also, when following a set of tracks, depending how good you are and how clever your query is, the information you get from tracks might change from set to set. Don't mess around when tracking an opponent because the environments in the Domains of Darkwind are ever changing, so tracks only last for so long and the trail won't go on forever, so you must be quick on your feet in order to catch a query.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: trail signs
docs.text: Ranger Help for: trail signs ============================= SYNTAX: signs trailsigns USAGE: Wilderness SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 5 SKILL TYPE: cartography SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to read trail markers that have been left in the current room by other Rangers. Trail markers contain short messages left by fellow Rangers as directions, warnings, or notes. Only Rangers can see and read these markers. If no markers are present in the room, the skill will report that no signs have been found.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: trailblaze
docs.text: Ranger Help for: trailblaze ============================ SYNTAX: trailblaze to <player> trailblaze to camp <ranger> backtrack USAGE: Wilderness SLOT COST: 10 BASE SP: 65 SKILL TYPE: Cartography SUMMARY: Trailblaze allows a Ranger to travel quickly through the wilderness. TRAILBLAZE TO <PLAYER>: Teleport to another player in the same domain. Uses your deep knowledge of the terrain to find a shortcut. The target must be a visible mortal, and neither of you can be fighting, warded against travel, or inside an Eternal Dungeon run. TRAILBLAZE TO CAMP <RANGER>: Visit another Ranger's camp, regardless of domain. Use 'camps' to see all registered camps. This is how Rangers visit each other's wilderness bases. You cannot trailblaze from or into places warded against travel. BACKTRACK: Return to where you trailblazed from. Your origin is remembered until you backtrack or trailblaze again. You cannot backtrack while fighting, from a warded location, or into a warded location. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: camp, camps, rest, guide

docs.title: Ranger Help for: trailblaze(blaze)
docs.text: Ranger Help for: trailblaze(blaze) ================================== SYNTAX: trailblaze to <target>/backtrack USAGE: forest,plains,swamp,desert,jungle,hills,road,beach, mountain,arctic,barren,outside SLOT COST: 8 BASE SP: 65 sp SKILL TYPE: aid SUMMARY: Trailblaze allows a Ranger to come to the rescue of a lost explorer. The explorer must have called for the Rangers help by using the 'helpme' emote. Once a call has been made, the Ranger only has about 5 minutes, after which he or she forgets from which direction the call came from. A Ranger can't trailblaze from just anywhere, they must be fairy close, approximately within the same realm(wizard's area) and both the Ranger and the target explorer must be above ground...Rangers can't trailblaze through dirt and rock. Once there, the Ranger may elect to 'backtrack' to his or her original location at no extra cost. If the explorer you trailblazed to is there, they will follow you while you backtrack.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: trailmark
docs.text: Ranger Help for: trailmark =========================== SYNTAX: trailmark <message> USAGE: Wilderness SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 15 SKILL TYPE: cartography SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to leave a trail marker in the current room with a short message attached. Only other Rangers can see trail markers. These markers are useful for leaving directions, warnings, or notes for fellow Rangers who pass through the area. Trail markers persist for a limited time before fading. Use 'signs' or 'trailsigns' to read any markers left in the current room.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: trailmark
docs.text: Ranger Help for: trailmark ========================== SYNTAX: trailmark <message> USAGE: forest,plains,swamp,desert,jungle,hills,road,beach, underground,mountain,arctic,barren,outside SLOT COST: 3 BASE SP: 15 sp SKILL TYPE: creation SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to trailmark a message into the surrounding terrain. Trailmarks can only be seen by other Rangers, however, they only last for so long. A Ranger can use them to help find his or her way back or to warn of impending danger around the next turn to other Rangers.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: train animal
docs.text: Ranger Help for: train animal =============================== SYNTAX: train <follower> <trick> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 7 BASE SP: variable SKILL TYPE: husbandry SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to teach their bonded animal follower a new trick. The available tricks are: power, speed, senses, dart, unleash, fetch, deliver, and seek. Not all followers can learn all tricks, as some require a certain level of intelligence. The smarter the follower, the more tricks it can learn. Training takes time and patience, and the chance of success depends on the Ranger's charisma and the follower's intelligence.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: treat armor
docs.text: Ranger Help for: treat armor ============================= SYNTAX: treat <armor> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 5 BASE SP: variable SKILL TYPE: creation SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to treat a piece of leather armor using natural agents, improving its protective qualities. The armor must be leather or studded leather for the treatment to work. The effectiveness of the treatment depends on the Ranger's skill level and knowledge of the terrain. Treating armor is one of the ways Rangers maintain their gear without relying on civilization.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: treat
docs.text: Ranger Help for: treat ====================== SYNTAX: treat/treat <target> USAGE: forest,plains,jungle,swamp,desert SLOT COST: 10 BASE SP: variable SKILL TYPE: defensive SUMMARY: With this skill, in certain terrains, a Ranger can use native ingredients to make heals and treat the wounds of a friend or him or herself. Too treat oneself, just type 'treat' with no argument. As a Ranger's knowledge of the environment increases, so does the effectiveness of his or her heals.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: underground
docs.text: Ranger Help for: underground ============================ SUMMARY: The underground terrain is characterized by enclosed natural walls and is almost always dark and dank. Underground or cave Rangers feel at home in this inhospitable environment, gaining a feel for how a cave runs just from listening. Ranger skills are somewhat limited in caves, so the Ranger population is smaller here. The Underworld is the most obvious example of the underground environment, although caves are all over the realms. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: Individual terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: underwater
docs.text: Ranger Help for: underwater =========================== SUMMARY: The underwater terrains is any area that is below the surface of water. It could be a sea, lake or river. Its characteristics are marine life, no oxygen and very wet. As a result of the lack of oxygen, no Rangers live in this environment. Skills use is very limited here. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: Individual terrains

docs.title: Ranger Help for: weapons
docs.text: Ranger Help for: weapons ======================== SUMMARY: Rangers are proficient in medium sized swords and daggers. As well as some larger blunt polearms, such as staves. Rangers can double wield most of these weapons, except for the larger ones. The defining weapon for a Ranger is his or her bow. Ranger carved bows aren't set as missile type weapons, so a Ranger doesn't have to be specialized in missile weapons to use them, they are medium blunt weapons, since that is how a Ranger uses it in hand to hand combat. There main advantage is the volleys of arrows you can shoot at your opponents. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: archery and armour

docs.title: Ranger Help for: weapons

Rangers can double wield most of these weapons, except for the larger ones. The defining weapon for a Ranger is his or her bow. Ranger carved bows aren't set as missile type weapons, so a Ranger doesn't have to be specialized in missile weapons to use them, they are medium blunt weapons, since that is how a Ranger uses it in hand to hand combat. There main advantage is the volleys of arrows you can shoot at your opponents. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: archery and armour

docs.title: Ranger Help for: whirl
docs.text: Ranger Help for: whirl ====================== SYNTAX: whirl <target> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: NA BASE SP: 30 SKILL TYPE: attack SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to execute a spinning melee attack against a target, dealing a combination of slash and blunt damage. The whirling motion uses both the blade and the momentum of the swing to inflict dual damage types. Whirl is effective against opponents with resistance to a single damage type. The Ranger must be in combat and wielding a melee weapon to use this skill.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: wilderness
docs.text: Ranger Help for: wilderness ============================ SUMMARY: The Wilderness branch covers the Ranger's survival and crafting skills. These abilities allow a Ranger to live off the land, create tools and weapons from natural materials, and navigate the wilds with ease. Key wilderness skills include: Forage - Search for edible plants and herbs Harvest Wood - Gather wood from trees for crafting Skin Animal - Skin a corpse for meat and hide Carve Bow - Craft a bow from wood and rope Carve Arrow - Carve arrows from harvested wood Make Torch - Create a torch for light Make Rope - Craft rope from natural materials Make Fish Trap - Weave a trap for catching camp fish Build Shelter - Construct a camp shelter for resting Use Herbs - Apply gathered herbs to heal or cure Calm Animal - Soothe an aggressive animal Call Follower - Summon your bonded animal companion Train Animal - Teach your follower new tricks Adapt - Adapt your body to extreme climates A Ranger who masters wilderness skills can survive indefinitely in even the harshest environments without depending on civilization. ============================================================================= SEE ALSO: martial, religious, followers

docs.title: Ranger Help for: winter's bite
docs.text: Ranger Help for: winter's bite ================================ SYNTAX: winterbite <target> or wbite <target> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 8 BASE SP: variable SKILL TYPE: religious SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to channel the fury of winter into a cold damage attack against a target. The biting cold saps the strength of the enemy. Winter's Bite is more effective in arctic and cold terrains and during the winter season, when the power of frost is at its peak. The damage dealt depends on the Ranger's wisdom, guild level, and the current terrain and season.

docs.title: Ranger Help for: wrath of gaia
docs.text: Ranger Help for: wrath of gaia ================================ SYNTAX: wrath <target> USAGE: Any terrain SLOT COST: 10 BASE SP: variable SKILL TYPE: religious SUMMARY: This skill allows a Ranger to call upon Gaia's wrath, unleashing a powerful nature damage attack against a target. The earth itself rises against the Ranger's enemy. The damage is terrain-based and deals significantly more damage when the Ranger is fighting in their primary terrain. This is one of the most powerful offensive spells available to a Ranger and costs a great deal of spell points to use. The damage scales with wisdom and guild level.

**************************************************************************** * * * EXPERIENCE * * * **************************************************************************** If you are planning to do a guild or have a guild already, all guild levels must cost 25% of regular experience. This includes guilds with true guild levels and guilds that determine guild level by regukar level. Rax -- 3/29/94

docs.text: Rogue Help Doc cabal roguehelp cabal for more info. emotes roguehelp emotes for more info. roguehist Rogue channel history. rogue/erogue <msg> The rogue guild line. roguehelp This screen. rogues A listing of the rogues online. setrogue Set various rogue features. 'help setrogue' for more info. powers 'help powers' for more info. pra(ctice) <skill> roguehelp practice for more info. skills Give a listing of your skills. You can get help on each of these with "help <power> or <skill>"

docs.title: Rogue Cabal Doc
docs.text: Rogue Cabal Doc Rogues are split up into 3 seperate Cabals: Assassin, Basher, and Thieves. All Cabals can practice every power, but only the Cabal that power was designed for can practice it more then once. Until a Rogue chooses a Cabal with "setrogue" (help setrogue for more info), that Rogue can only practice a power once. Assassin The Assassin Cabal is the hitmen of the Rogues. Their purpose is to get in without being seen, do as much damage as they can to their target, hopefully killing it, and then get out. Basher The Basher Cabal is more of a bouncer, brute force type of Rogue. He isn't subtle about what he's trying to do, and would rather take someone on head-on. He has spent enough time around the other Cabals though to make him tricky, and not just some mindless Fighter. Thieves As the name implies, the Thief Cabal's purpose is to rob, cheat, and steal whatever the Rogues need. The Thieves may not make the best fighters, but when cornered, they do have a few options available to them.

docs.title: Once, there were two guilds almost constantly at war. The Ninjas
docs.text: Once, there were two guilds almost constantly at war. The Ninjas and the Thieves' guild were bitter enemies. Periodically, they would halt their fighting for a time, and band together against a common enemy. As soon as that enemy fell, and it always did against their combined might, the two sides would once again return to killing each other. One day, a mighty force arrived, Timoban. More than a man, but surely not a god, he took on both the thieves and the ninjas, and defeated their mightiest leaders. The remaining thieves and ninjas, unable to join forces, ever bickering and mistrustful of each other, fell like sheep to the Solon. Timoban, however, was impressed with the skill and powers of the thieves and ninjas. He set about cleansing the two guilds, making them one at their very core. He recruited some locals, and showed them the new way, and then left, to conquer other worlds. The new Rogues, as Timoban called them, learned to keep to the shadows, and not draw undue attention to themselves as did the old Ninjas and Thieves, flaunting their power. To find, and join them, you will need to look hard, or make subtle inquiries, and perhaps they will find you instead. The following races are restricted from Rogues: Desert Dwarf, Stone Dwarf, Rift Duergar, Ice Ogre, and Barbarian.

docs.title: Rogue Practice Doc
docs.text: Rogue Practice Doc Each guild level, you will receive new skills. Not all skills will be designed for your Rogue Cabal. You can still practice any skill to the max allowed for your Cabal. You can practice a skill anywhere by typing "practice <skill>" or "pra <skill>". Also, skills have a chance to improve as you use them, so you can conceivably max out all skills given time. Since it is by using your skills, and gaining experience that you advance, you can "practice level" when you have gained enough training to increase your guild level.

docs.title: Skill name: Charge
docs.text: Skill name: Charge Cost: 50 Guild level: 6 Syntax: charge <target> Description: This skill comes from your past training, where you learned to charge past your opponent's guard and slap his hand, causing him to drop his weapon.

docs.title: Commands that all Samurai have access to.
docs.text: -=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=- Commands that all Samurai have access to. -=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=- "sams" = Gives a listing of all the Samurai on. "schat" = Allows you to talk on the Guild line. "eschat" = Allows you to emote on the Guild line. "myhonor" = Gives you your current Honor ranking. "pledge" = Changes your Giri (guild title) on the Sam who. "wimpy" = Now null. You gotta love me! "sambug" = Allows you to report any Samurai bugs. -=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-

docs.title: Skill name: Compromise
docs.text: Skill name: Compromise Cost: 45 Guild level: 10 Syntax: compromise Description: This skill allows you to stop the fight with your opponent(s) and try to form a peace treaty with them. Though, be aware, they might just notice the fine print on your little deal and find that it was too good to be true.

docs.title: Skill name: Mind's Eye
docs.text: Skill name: Mind's Eye Cost: 35 Guild level: 8 Syntax: eye <target> Description: This skill allows you to leave your physical body and travel out with your soul to find your target's location. Though, you do run a risk that your target will catch you in the act.

docs.title: Skill name: Harden Ki
docs.text: Skill name: Harden Ki Cost: 40 Guild level: 7 Syntax: harden Description: You draw upon your inner energies to focus along your soul, thereby increasing your "density" and making you tougher physically.

docs.title: Samurai Houses
docs.text: -=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=- Samurai Houses -=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=- Right now, there are 3 (possibly 4) Houses in the Samurai guild. Here's the low down: -1.) House BlackBlade - (Lord Cadet) -2.) House WildFury - (Lord Mati) -3.) House StormThrown - (Lord Shadez) -4.) ???????????? Right now, the entire details of each House (such as alignment requirements outside of the Lawful global requirement, PK/non-PK, etc..) are determined by the House Lord. Please inquire with the appropriate Lord of your requirements. -=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-

docs.title: Skill name: Hamstring
docs.text: Skill name: Hamstring Cost: 95 Guild level: 14 Syntax: hstring <target> Description: Utilizing your extroidinary fighting skills, you manuever around your opponent and come up "beneath" him. Just close enough to slice the inside of his leg, severing his hamstring and opening a large, gushing artery causing him to bleed profusely for a bit.

docs.title: Skill name: Meditation
docs.text: Skill name: Meditation Cost: 55 Guild level: 2 Syntax: meditation Description: You are able to close your eyes and enter a state of Nirvana, thereby, calming your body and allowing it to heal faster.

docs.title: Skill name: Quick Draw (also known as Ikiado)
docs.text: Skill name: Quick Draw (also known as Ikiado) Cost: 35 Guild level: 12 Syntax: qdraw <target> Description: This is a talent you've practiced for many years. It's one that a Samurai relies on - the ability to draw your sword faster then the eye can perceive it. Using this skill, you bring your sword to your target's throat faster then he can say 'Um.', forcing him to face his greatest challenge - cowardice. You see, he has a choice. He can either fight you and be free, or he can sit there (like the coward that he is). Be aware, if he chooses to fight you, then he is no longer held.

docs.title: Hello, and welcome to the Samurai guild!
docs.text: Hello, and welcome to the Samurai guild! -=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=- I, Acer, as the GM of the Samurai am glad to have you with us. As you will soon find out in these docs, you've just joined one of the most unique and different guilds in Darkwind. The Samurai is a warrior from cultures based on the medieval Japanese civil- ization. He lives by a very strict code of honor and behavior, called... Bushido (or it translates to "The Way of the Warrior"). This code demands: 1.) Honor is above everything. 2.) Absolute obedience to his/her lord. 3.) Readiness to die for honor or for his lord at any time. 4.) Eagerness to avenge any dishonor to his lord, his family, or himself. 5.) Willingness to repay all debts honorably. 6.) And, most important, the unwillingness to demonstrate the most dishonorable trait - Cowardice. As you have probably already found out, within the Samurai guild are three families or houses. Each one headed by a player GM, or a Lord. This person has the ability to promote/demote you in rank, issue/take from you honor, or to banish you from the house and from the Samurai all together. As you can see, you MUST treat the Lord with honor and respect he/she is due. And as you can probably see, the Samurai guild makes for some great roleplaying if you choose to do so. See also: 'commands', 'skills', 'houses' and 'emotes'. Syntax: shelp <topic> -=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-

docs.title: Skill name: Surrounded Fighting
docs.text: Skill name: Surrounded Fighting Cost: 140 Guild level: 13 Syntax: sfight Description: Calm, cool and collected - That's what Samurai were known for. Using this skill, you center yourself within a crowded room of enemies and begin to hack your way out, methodically. NOTE: A flat 140 sps is taken despite the number of monsters in the room.

docs.title: Skill Name: Soul Focus
docs.text: Skill Name: Soul Focus Cost: Guild level * 7 Guild level: 1 Syntax: sfocus <target> Description: With this skill, you are able to focus your attention to your soul and it's attributes, increasing a few at will.

docs.title: Skill name: Size Up
docs.text: Skill name: Size Up Cost: 20 Guild level: 4 Syntax: size <target> Description: This skill allows you to recall your enhanced training and size up your opponent. This allows you to compare yourself to your target.
